channel.description: 模型压缩 / ML 编译 / HPC / 边缘计算 / 低功耗计算方向最新论文（arXiv / 顶会 PDF），正文含中文省流版。

item.title: Where Rounding Happens Matters: Rounding-Location Alignment Stabilizes LLM Reinforcement Learning
item.description:
发表方：（未标注）　发布：2026-10-23　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 LLM 强化学习常用独立推理与训练系统，即便权重与 BF16 张量一致，实现差异也会使本应在策略的更新偏离策略、训练不稳定——能否只对齐部分执行栈就稳定 BF16 RL？

方法 把训练侧舍入位置与推理对齐三个区域：RoPE、SwiGLU 与残差 RMSNorm，方法是在其 BF16 输出前将选定中间量保留为 FP32；推理引擎、矩阵乘/注意力 kernel 与学习目标均保持不变。

关键数字 在四个 Qwen 系列模型上，对齐全部三个区域防止了默认 BF16 基线下的训练崩溃；单对齐 RoPE 路径在实验中也已足够，尽管仍有数值差异残留。

为什么值得看 "舍入位置对齐"而非全局精度升级来稳定 BF16 RL，代价极小，RL 训练工程可直接采用。

item.title: When Does Dynamics Randomization Test Context Inference?
item.description:
发表方：（未标注）　发布：2026-10-23　分类：论文PDF

Environments with randomized dynamics are widely used to ask whether world models need explicit context inference. However, randomization can leave little predictive information fo...

Environments with randomized dynamics are widely used to ask whether world models need explicit context inference. However, randomization can leave little predictive information for a context encoder to add, because distinct latent parameters may produce similar transitions at visited states, or those states may already reveal the active context. We formalize the remaining one-step information as predictive headroom and compare kernels under fixed and visited state--action distributions to distinguish changes in query coverage from changes in context weights. We analyze discrete and continuous environments and find low headroom both when kernels differ little and when visitation reduces an otherwise large discrepancy. At the same time, resetting state components increases headroom, showing that context evidence accumulates in state. We propose reporting this headroom alongside the randomized parameters, so that gains from explicit context inference can be interpreted relative to the information missing from the current state and action.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: TranSAGE: Automating Spatial Accelerator Generation for Large-Scale Transformer Models
item.description:
发表方：（未标注）　发布：2026-10-23　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 大规模 Transformer 推理的计算与内存需求高，空间加速器在片上带宽与能效上有优势，但为大型模型设计加速器昂贵耗时；现有生成器通常只支持单算子，忽略多算子流水线收益。

方法 提出 TranSAGE，基于编译器的框架：在多算子流水线调度下联合优化大型 Transformer，并自动生成加速器实现；集成设计空间探索引擎、多算子数据流优化与基于动态规划的图划分算法，找出适合流水线的算子簇与最优数据流参数；提供空间架构原语与 lowering pass 自动生成 RTL 实现。

关键数字 摘要未给出具体性能数值；核心贡献是多算子流水线联合优化的自动加速器生成。

为什么值得看 编译器驱动+多算子流水线的 Transformer 空间加速器自动生成，芯片设计自动化方向可参考。

item.title: Toward Open ISA Supercomputing: A Comparative Study of RISC-V, Arm, and x86 Architectures on HPC Workloads
item.description:
发表方：（未标注）　发布：2026-10-23　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 RISC-V 能否挑战 HPC 领域成熟的 x86 与 Arm？现有研究平台、负载与方法各异、罕有考虑能效，难以公平对比。

方法 用统一软件栈与方法论对比当代 HPC RISC-V、Arm 与 x86 处理器：刻画 Sophgo SG2044，与 NVIDIA Grace CPU Superchip、Intel Xeon Platinum 8480+ 在四个 HPC 基准（STREAM、HPL、HPL-MxP、HPCG）与四个代表应用（iPIC3D、PLUTO、OpenFOAM、llama.cpp）上对比；所用 OpenBLAS 版 HPL-MxP 以开源形式发布。

关键数字 SG2044 单核 FP64 8.02 GFLOP/s、内存带宽 7.8 GB/s，64 核时升至 294 GFLOP/s 与 107 GB/s；L2 缓存感知的进程放置使扩展到 16 核近线性，其后受内存带宽饱和限制。

为什么值得看 统一方法下的 RISC-V/Arm/x86 HPC 能效横评，开放指令集超算路线的重要数据点。

item.title: Sustainability of TSFM Deployment and Pretraining: From Carbon Footprint Analysis to Mitigation via Pruning
item.description:
发表方：（未标注）　发布：2026-10-23　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 时序基础模型（TSFM）零样本预测强但预训练成本高——相比需周期性重训的监督单模型，前置投入在全生命周期内是否划算？

方法 建模不同方案在现实工业场景中的累计碳排放：对比 Chronos-2 与经典监督模型的部署生命周期碳成本；针对需要降低 TSFM 自身成本的情形，用无梯度剪枝准则移除单个编码器块，评估其对 FLOPs、CO2、延迟与零样本性能的影响。

关键数字 移除单编码器块（7.9% 参数）带来一致的 6–9% FLOPs/CO2/延迟下降，25 任务基准上零样本预测性能基本无损；大型或高频查询部署中 Chronos-2 数月内摊薄预训练成本，小型或低频场景经典模型长期更便宜。

为什么值得看 从全生命周期碳成本看 TSFM 值不值得用，可持续 AI 的成本核算样例。

item.title: Sparsity-driven emergence of functional modularity in multitask neural networks
item.description:
发表方：（未标注）　发布：2026-10-23　分类：论文PDF

Neural networks can learn multiple tasks, but how learning organizes shared computation into specialized and reusable components remains poorly understood. In this work, we show th...

Neural networks can learn multiple tasks, but how learning organizes shared computation into specialized and reusable components remains poorly understood. In this work, we show that sparsity inducing regularization promotes functional modularity in multitask networks without predefined module boundaries. Using functional profiling in multilayer perceptrons and a lightweight transformer, we identified compact, task-selective subnetworks, termed functional tokens. Across rule-based task families, selectively retaining these tokens preserves their associated functions while reducing performance on other tasks. Such specialization develops preferentially in deeper layers during training, while earlier layers retain shared computation. Regularization strength and form shape module compactness and specialization, while task weighting alters functional allocation. Moreover, extracted functional tokens can be recombined through alternative pathways to reconstruct a learned composite computation without retraining, preserving their connectivity and learned weights. Our results suggest that sparsity-constrained optimization shapes not only parameter use but also the organization and reuse o…

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Searching with Sparse Histories: Cross-Task Architecture Search from Incomplete Search Logs and Zero-Cost Proxies
item.description:
发表方：（未标注）　发布：2026-10-23　分类：论文PDF

Neural architecture search (NAS) is expensive, but cross-task transfer can reduce costs by reusing knowledge from previous tasks. However, existing methods struggle with sparse sea...

Neural architecture search (NAS) is expensive, but cross-task transfer can reduce costs by reusing knowledge from previous tasks. However, existing methods struggle with sparse search histories and task-specific transfer failures. We propose a method, a risk-robust strategy that combines sparse source logs with zero-cost proxies through champion-based initialization and joint pairwise-ranker pretraining. On TransNAS-Bench-101, the proposal mitigates severe worst-case failures, reducing worst-10% ranks from 290 to 43 for Micro autoencoding and from 465 to 45 for Macro room layout. Across 13 cell-space targets, it outperforms a proxy-only ranker on 10 targets in both mean and worst-case performance, while maintaining competitive average performance.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: RobustRLlib: A Unified Library and Benchmark for Robust Reinforcement Learning Algorithms
item.description:
发表方：（未标注）　发布：2026-10-23　分类：论文PDF

Robust reinforcement learning (RL) is critical for reliable real-world deployment, where policies may fail under diverse shifts and disruptions. Existing robust RL algorithms offer...

Robust reinforcement learning (RL) is critical for reliable real-world deployment, where policies may fail under diverse shifts and disruptions. Existing robust RL algorithms offer a rich set of mechanisms and principles, yet two major barriers limit their broader potential: limited algorithm reusability and an unclear empirical capability boundary. We introduce RobustRLlib, an algorithm-centric library and benchmark that addresses both challenges. It integrates 17 representative robust online, offline, and safe RL algorithms under a unified interface for substantially improved reusability, together with an enhanced evaluation platform spanning diverse real-world shifts and advanced humanoid and vision-language-action tasks. Systematic evaluation over 273 perturbation configurations provides an up-to-date capability map of current robust RL algorithms, revealing where they remain effective and where substantial robustness gaps persist. As an open-source, user-friendly platform, RobustRLlib offers a reproducible and extensible codebase for applying existing methods to new problems and developing new robust RL algorithms.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

阅读原文 ↗

item.title: Rethinking LoRA Initialization for Robust Asymmetric Learning Rates
item.description:
发表方：（未标注）　发布：2026-10-23　分类：论文PDF

Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) is often highly sensitive to learning-rate (LR) choices. Recent empirical studies suggest that, once LRs are carefully tuned, vanilla LoRA can remain com...

Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) is often highly sensitive to learning-rate (LR) choices. Recent empirical studies suggest that, once LRs are carefully tuned, vanilla LoRA can remain competitive with many proposed LoRA variants. This shifts the central practical question from designing ever more variants to reducing the cost and brittleness of LR selection. LoRA+ addresses this issue with asymmetric LRs, using a larger LR for the up-projection matrix $B$ than for the down-projection matrix $A$. However, the ratio $η_B / η_A$ itself becomes an additional hyperparameter: large ratios can improve adaptation, but under the standard LoRA initialization they can also cause unstable training and ratio-dependent performance collapse. We identify the source of this brittleness through a signal--noise decomposition of LoRA dynamics. Under standard \initA, the update contains an initialization-induced noise term whose magnitude can be affected by the LR for $B$, $η_B$, the initialization scale $β$, and the adapter rank $r$. In practical LLM fine-tuning, this non-vanishing noise can limit the performance gains expected from LoRA+ style asymmetric LRs. To suppress this effect, we propose \initAA, a s…

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Reinforcement Learning with Multi-Step Transition Predictions: A Bellman Theory
item.description:
发表方：（未标注）　发布：2026-10-23　分类：论文PDF

Multi-step predictions of future transition realizations can improve reinforcement learning, but their value remains difficult to quantify. Directly including these predictions in ...

Multi-step predictions of future transition realizations can improve reinforcement learning, but their value remains difficult to quantify. Directly including these predictions in the state can lead to exponential state-space growth, making direct dynamic programming computationally expensive. We study discounted finite MDPs under a block-feedback protocol: at the start of each K-period block, the decision maker observes $K$-step probabilistic transition predictions for a subset of actions and adapts decisions to observed states within the block. We show that the optimal value satisfies a Bayesian Bellman equation on the original state space. This representation reveals that predictive information creates value by recursively changing the local order of maximization and expectation in the Bellman expansion. We formalize this effect through a Bellman--Jensen analysis and quantify the effects of prediction horizon, error, action coverage, and within-block feedback. We propose block-feedback Bayesian offline learning with online adaptation (BF--BOLA), a model-based algorithm for learning near-optimal policies, and establish upper and lower sample-complexity bounds that match up to log…

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: ReMedI: Inference-Time Refinement and Self-Distillation for Controllable Molecular Optimization
item.description:
发表方：（未标注）　发布：2026-10-23　分类：论文PDF

In drug development, lead optimization must improve competing properties, such as increasing permeability and reducing toxicity, while limiting scaffold changes that could compromi...

In drug development, lead optimization must improve competing properties, such as increasing permeability and reducing toxicity, while limiting scaffold changes that could compromise the lead's potency. RL-based post-training, such as C-MORAL, addresses this problem by fine-tuning molecular language models to directly optimize molecular leads for objectives of interest, which relies on expensive task-specific datasets and faces challenges in achieving multi-objective optimization (MOO). We argue a pre-trained model may already contain useful molecular edits that zero-shot generation cannot efficiently reach. Motivated by the limited search capabilities of zero-shot generation, we develop an efficient Metropolis-Hastings search strategy to better explore the proposal distribution. We propose ReMedI, which uses the molecular language model as a base proposer for inference-time alignment. Given a lead and a set of multi-objective tasks, the model proposes edits conditioned on the current molecule, while Metropolis--Hastings refinement guides sequential edits under an objective for property improvement, preservation, and lead similarity. On both C-MuMOInstruct and SMDD benchmarks, refi…

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

In drug development, lead optimization must improve competing properties, such as increasing permeability and reducing toxicity, while limiting scaffold changes that could compromise the lead's potency. RL-based post-training, such as C-MORAL, addresses this problem by fine-tuning molecular language models to directly optimize molecular leads for objectives of interest, which relies on expensive task-specific datasets and faces challenges in achieving multi-objective optimization (MOO). item.title: Quantum Cadence: Post-Quantum Consensus with Multiple Concurrent Proposers

发表方：（未标注）　发布：2026-10-23　分类：论文PDF

The consensus protocols of most high-performance blockchains use quorum certificates, which bundle the signatures of a quorum of validators. Signature schemes such as BLS can aggre...

The consensus protocols of most high-performance blockchains use quorum certificates, which bundle the signatures of a quorum of validators. Signature schemes such as BLS can aggregate the signatures of a whole quorum into a single short signature, which keeps these certificates small. A large-scale quantum computer would break these schemes, and no post-quantum scheme with comparable aggregate size and aggregation time is known. Without aggregation, a certificate holds one large post-quantum signature per member of the quorum, so it becomes infeasible for each validator to broadcast certificates, as modern consensus protocols often require. We present Quantum Cadence, a post-quantum consensus protocol with multiple concurrent proposers that avoids certificates altogether: every validator counts quorums among the messages it has received itself. Its safety and liveness do not even depend on signatures, although we add signatures to obtain accountability. Quantum Cadence builds on Cadence and replaces its slot consensus, Chorus, with Quantum Chorus, which keeps the optimal fast-path latency of Chorus: dissemination followed by two rounds of votes. item.description:
发表方：（未标注）　发布：2026-10-23　分类：论文PDF

Several formal theories have been developed to characterize the capabilities and limitations of the transformer architecture, each employing different abstractions that capture dif...

Several formal theories have been developed to characterize the capabilities and limitations of the transformer architecture, each employing different abstractions that capture different features of the architecture. Due to the differences in their underlying assumptions and conceptual frameworks, these theories can disagree in their predictions about what tasks transformers find easy or hard. We map out seven theories of transformer capability (Star-free, $\mathsf{AC}^0$, $\mathsf{TC}^0$, C-RASP, MPC, BAPO, and Sensitivity) and translate their results into a common matrix of predictions across a suite of tasks covering different computational structures. We provide new theoretical results to complete this matrix. We then evaluate theoretical predictions through controlled experiments measuring in-distribution sample complexity, length generalization, and pretrained language model performance. We find that no single theory explains the observed pattern of successes and failures. item.title: PlayerEmbed: Learning Behavioral Fingerprint Representations from Raw Input Sequences
item.description:
发表方：（未标注）　发布：2026-10-23　分类：论文PDF

Raw player input sequences in video games contain fine-grained behavior, but are high-dimensional and noisy, which makes large-scale analytics challenging. To address this, we intr...

Raw player input sequences in video games contain fine-grained behavior, but are high-dimensional and noisy, which makes large-scale analytics challenging. To address this, we introduce PlayerEmbed, a framework that learns compact and discriminative player embeddings using deep metric learning. Our approach uses a hybrid CNN-LSTM encoder trained on raw input sequences from 1,000 players. We evaluate the model on held-out sequences from these players and on sequences from 1,000 players entirely unseen during training to assess generalization to unseen identities. For player identification, a nearest-centroid classifier built from reference embeddings achieves strong performance, reaching balanced accuracies of 0.950 for players seen during training and 0.879 for players unseen during training. Systematically increasing the number of training players substantially improves generalization to unseen players, indicating a transition from simple fingerprinting to learning transferable behavioral patterns.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: PRISM: Promoting Sampling Diversity of Large Language Models with Implicit Stochastic Modulation
item.description:
发表方：（未标注）　发布：2026-10-23　分类：论文PDF

Large language models (LLMs) exhibit mode collapse, where their output distribution concentrates on familiar semantic modes. When diversity disappears, repeated sampling becomes se...

Large language models (LLMs) exhibit mode collapse, where their output distribution concentrates on familiar semantic modes. When diversity disappears, repeated sampling becomes semantic repetition rather than discovery, making rare but stronger solutions unlikely to surface and leaving self-evolution and continual learning difficult to sustain. Most remedies intervene only at inference time, shaping sam- ples without making diversity a model capability. We propose PRISM, a training-time framework that internalizes diversity within the model. PRISM combines (i) submodular curation that pairs each prompt with diverse-yet-correct multi-teacher solutions, and (ii) stochastic embedding modulation, which turns special-token perturbations into implicit signals for sampling distinct outputs. A theoretical analysis establishes the stability of this mechanism. On WritingPrompts and BookMIA, PRISM moves the quality-diversity frontier outward, achieving the best generation quality in all model-benchmark settings while maintaining the strongest or near-strongest semantic diversity across two open-weight model families. It also improves sampling efficiency on math and code benchmarks. Beyond in…

item.title: PARIS: Parallel Arithmetic Reduction and Integrated Selection for MSDF Inner Products
item.description:
发表方：（未标注）　发布：2026-10-23　分类：论文PDF

Existing most-significant-digit-first (MSDF) accelerators serialize input-term processing, causing inner-product latency to increase with fan-in. This paper presents PARIS, an MSDF...

Existing most-significant-digit-first (MSDF) accelerators serialize input-term processing, causing inner-product latency to increase with fan-in. This paper presents PARIS, an MSDF architecture that eliminates input-term serialization through parallel bit-plane reduction and shared carry-save residual selection. For $B$-bit operands, PARIS processes $B^2$ bit-position pairs, independent of fan-in within the supported tile, while generating exact MSDF outputs. Synthesized in 45\,nm at 100\,MHz, the 784-lane INT8 core occupies 0.008701\,mm$^2$ and completes an inner product in 88 cycles. Evaluation on two MNIST multilayer perceptrons demonstrates arithmetic-workload speedups of 240.44$\times$ and 180.47$\times$ over a matched reused-MSDF implementation, reducing arithmetic energy by 98.89\% and 98.58\%, respectively. A synthesized 16-engine accelerator occupies 0.90273\,mm$^2$ and meets the 100\,MHz timing constraint. Assuming immediate weight availability, it delivers a projected throughput of 24.33\,GOPS and an estimated energy efficiency of 1,581.14\,GOPS/W at unchanged mapped power. Bias-aware ReLU detection further reduces modeled arithmetic cycles by 5.52\% and 4.86\%. A separa…

item.title: Online Continual Learning in Edge-Cloud Applications
item.description:
发表方：（未标注）　发布：2026-10-23　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 部署在 IoT/边缘-云系统中的机器学习模型面对非平稳数据流需要在线自适应，且无法访问完整原始训练集——OOD 输入与灾难性遗忘会严重损害性能。

方法 提出面向 IoT 应用的边缘-云方法论，将持续学习（CL）与 OOD 检测、概念漂移检测整合：用 ODIN 与 ECDD 作为识别可标注信息样本、触发基于回放的模型更新的替代机制；在汽车、医疗与农业数据集上验证。

关键数字 摘要未给出具体性能数值；结论是该方法论支持模型自适应并缓解灾难性遗忘。

为什么值得看 持续学习×OOD/漂移检测的端到端边缘云方法论，IoT 模型运维可参考。

item.title: On the Limits of Sparse Linear Model with Shuffled Differential Privacy
item.description:
发表方：（未标注）　发布：2026-10-23　分类：论文PDF

Sparse linear regression is a fundamental problem in high-dimensional statistics, and its private counterparts leave a large gap between the central and the local model of differen...

Sparse linear regression is a fundamental problem in high-dimensional statistics, and its private counterparts leave a large gap between the central and the local model of differential privacy. Shuffled differential privacy (SDP) sits between the two, offering accuracy closer to the central model without the trust requirement of a central curator. This paper studies sparse linear regression under both non-interactive and interactive SDP protocols. In the non-interactive setting, any non-interactive $(ε,δ)$-SDP protocol is shown to incur an $\ell_2$-norm estimation error of $Ω( \frac{\sqrt{dk}}{nε} )$ with dimension $d$, sparsity $k$, and $n$ users, revealing an inherent dimensionality barrier. In addition, a non-interactive algorithm is proposed that achieves an $\ell_2$-norm upper bound of $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}( \sqrt{\frac{k}{n}} + \frac{d\sqrt{k}}{nε})$. To overcome this barrier, we turn to the interactive user-level setting, where each user holds $m$ samples. item.title: On the Expressive Power of Hook-Indexed State Comprehending State in the React UI Library
item.description:
发表方：（未标注）　发布：2026-10-23　分类：论文PDF

React is currently the most popular JavaScript library for front-end web development. It endows UI components with state via the useState construct, through a mechanism that we nam...

React is currently the most popular JavaScript library for front-end web development. It endows UI components with state via the useState construct, through a mechanism that we name hook-indexed state. However, React's implementation of hook-indexed state is both fragile and poorly understood. Programmers frequently experience unexpected behavior, and the benefits of programming in this paradigm are wholly unclear. We define Lambda-React-Hook, a core calculus that captures the essence of hook-indexed state, and give it a type system to statically rule out unexpected behavior. We then translate Lambda-React-Hook into a calculus Lambda-React-Ref based on ML-style references, and prove that this translation preserves typability and semantics, thus showing that hook-indexed state is expressible in terms of standard references. The translation is local and admits a compositional definition, but involves significant code duplication. As well as illuminating the essence of state in React, our observations can inform the design of future reactive programming systems.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: On Latency-Optimal Implementations of the Timestamp Object
item.description:
发表方：（未标注）　发布：2026-10-23　分类：论文PDF

Timestamps are widely used in distributed algorithms to order operations. In this paper, we study the timestamp object (TS), which provides a single operation that returns strictly...

Timestamps are widely used in distributed algorithms to order operations. In this paper, we study the timestamp object (TS), which provides a single operation that returns strictly increasing integers. We ask two questions: What is the maximum resilience and the minimum latency of TS implementations in asynchronous message-passing systems, where latency is measured by worst-case message delay? We answer these questions under various types of failure: crash failures, and Byzantine failures with and without digital signatures. To do so, we give lower bounds and algorithms that determine (1) the optimal resilience of TS implementations under each type of failure, and (2) the optimal latency in all cases but one. Along the way, we introduce a new lower-bound proof technique called a cyclic chain argument, which constructs a cycle of indistinguishable schedules along which the returned timestamps must strictly increase, yielding a contradiction.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Migration as a Steady-State Execution Primitive: A Runtime for Virtual Stationarity in Low-Earth Orbit
item.description:
发表方：（未标注）　发布：2026-10-23　分类：论文PDF

Low Earth Orbit (LEO) satellite mega-constellations enable orbital edge computing for latency-critical geocentric applications, but satellite motion compresses line-of-sight commun...

Low Earth Orbit (LEO) satellite mega-constellations enable orbital edge computing for latency-critical geocentric applications, but satellite motion compresses line-of-sight communication windows to mere minutes. To maintain logical geographic proximity, a paradigm termed Virtual Stationarity (VS), applications must continuously migrate across passing satellites in the constellation. Traditional live migration mechanisms optimize individually initiated relocations or replication, but not the continuous handover between successive hosts that orbital motion requires. We reformulate live migration as a steady-state execution model and introduce a novel virtual stationarity runtime paradigm. We formalize the viability of continuous migration through a lightweight model capturing latency and availability service-level objectives (SLOs), continuous migration overhead, and the convergence bound of state replay. To satisfy these constraints, we derive a Virtual Stationarity Runtime (VSR) framework whose Migration Membrane combines Capability Virtualization and Continuous State Projection to rebind host resources and reconstruct evolving execution on a successor. item.title: Measuring the Energy Cost of Completing Tasks with Quantized Language-Model Agents
item.description:
发表方：（未标注）　发布：2026-10-23　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 量化省内存与能耗，但现有研究要么在单请求上对比量化模型、要么在单一精度下测 agent——精度变化在完整 agent 任务上的能耗权衡从未被刻画。

方法 首次刻画本地部署 agent 的"任务级"量化能耗权衡：构建 29 个带自动 pass/fail 检查的 agent 任务（6 个家族，从单答案 SQL 分析到多步仓库 bug 修复），在裸金属 NVIDIA A100 节点上用 llama.cpp 测量两个开源模型 4-bit 与 8-bit 版本每输出 token 与每完成任务 的 CPU/GPU 能耗。

关键数字 29 个任务、2 个模型、4-bit/8-bit 两档精度、A100 裸金属实测；结果显示 4-bit 的能耗收益（摘要未给出完整数值结论）。

为什么值得看 量化收益的评估口径从逐 token 升级到任务级，agent 能耗评估方法论参考。

发表方：（未标注）　发布：2026-10-23　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 量化省内存与能耗，但现有研究要么在单请求上对比量化模型、要么在单一精度下测 agent——精度变化在完整 agent 任务上的能耗权衡从未被刻画。

方法 首次刻画本地部署 agent 的"任务级"量化能耗权衡：构建 29 个带自动 pass/fail 检查的 agent 任务（6 个家族，从单答案 SQL 分析到多步仓库 bug 修复），在裸金属 NVIDIA A100 节点上用 llama.cpp 测量两个开源模型 4-bit 与 8-bit 版本每输出 token 与每完成任务 的 CPU/GPU 能耗。

关键数字 29 个任务、2 个模型、4-bit/8-bit 两档精度、A100 裸金属实测；结果显示 4-bit 的能耗收益（摘要未给出完整数值结论）。

为什么值得看 量化收益的评估口径从逐 token 升级到任务级，agent 能耗评估方法论参考。

item.title: KnitTrans: Coordinated Trajectory Transfer for Effective and Efficient LLM Reinforcement Learning
item.description:
发表方：（未标注）　发布：2026-10-23　分类：论文PDF

Trajectory transfer from rollout to training affects both learning quality and system efficiency in large language model reinforcement learning (RL). Enforcing batch-wide training ...

Trajectory transfer from rollout to training affects both learning quality and system efficiency in large language model reinforcement learning (RL). Enforcing batch-wide training requirements can delay the admission of completed trajectories, resulting in higher architectural staleness: the additional parameter-version gap from disaggregated pipelining relative to colocated execution. Beyond admission, misalignment between data access and training consumption causes redundant movement and unnecessary waiting when transferring large trajectory payloads. We present KnitTrans, a system that coordinates the rollout-to-training path through three designs. First, constraint-preserving mini-batch admission allows flexibility in early mini-batch composition, while checking that enough capacity remains to satisfy the remaining quotas. Second, on-demand trajectory data access matches storage units to consumer assignments and overlaps micro-batch data preparation with computation. Third, multimodal encoding deduplication supports reuse across a mini-batch while preserving gradient contributions from all backbone micro-batches. Experiments show up to 93% lower architectural staleness than wit…

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Interpretable sparse fine-tuning with TopKLoRA enables faithful circuit discovery
item.description:
发表方：（未标注）　发布：2026-10-23　分类：论文PDF

Fine-tuning on datasets of unknown origin can create a backdoor in the trained model when the data includes poisoned examples. Difficult to localise and remove, backdoors can persi...

Fine-tuning on datasets of unknown origin can create a backdoor in the trained model when the data includes poisoned examples. Difficult to localise and remove, backdoors can persist through safety training. While parameter-efficient fine-tuning methods capture the full parameter changes introduced during training, they are not easily interpretable. We present the full method of TopKLoRA, extending the preliminary proposal of Masiak et al. (2025), an interpretable-by-design LoRA variant in which only the $k$ largest adapter latents are active at each token. Unlike SAEs, TopKLoRA is trained purely on downstream loss, where optimisation pressure incentivises learning functionally causal latents. We demonstrate this sparse LoRA adapter in a sleeper-agent backdoor case study where we create model organisms by fine-tuning gemma-2-2b, Qwen2.5-1.5B, and Qwen2.5-7B on a poisoned instruction-following dataset. For each organism, we identify and ablate a circuit that is both necessary and sufficient to implement the backdoor. Furthermore, our new fine-tuning method produces sparse circuits that are up to an order of magnitude smaller than a dense LoRA baseline, allowing surgical ablation of …

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: InferSlice: A Reference Architecture for SLO-driven LLM Inference over a Telco Wide-Area Network
item.description:
发表方：（未标注）　发布：2026-10-23　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 主权、合规、延迟与资源就近要求使集中式云不适合部分 LLM 推理服务——电信运营商有地理分布的算力与网络，但现有 serving 框架是为紧耦合数据中心设计的。

方法 提出 InferSlice 参考架构：面向电信基础设施的 SLO 驱动 LLM 推理，整合网络切片、GPU 分区、弹性服务与可观测性；由 BT 牵头、布里斯托大学与 NVIDIA 合作，在英国国家规模 WAN（JOINER）上落地，评估服务分层差异化、弹性扩容、客户端-边缘带宽瓶颈及张量/流水线/数据并行与 prefill-decode 分离的可达性。

关键数字 摘要未给出具体性能数值；架构已在英国国家级 WAN 上实现并评测。

为什么值得看 电信广域网上的 SLO 驱动 LLM 推理参考架构，边缘推理部署新场景。

item.title: Head Dimension Matters in Language Models for Long-Context Retrieval
item.description:
发表方：（未标注）　发布：2026-10-23　分类：论文PDF

Multi-head attention retrieves and combines context representations through query--key interactions and value aggregation, with head dimension constraining the per-head representat...

Multi-head attention retrieves and combines context representations through query--key interactions and value aggregation, with head dimension constraining the per-head representation space. In long-context processing, it remains unclear whether allocating a fixed parameter budget to fewer, wider heads improves information retrieval. In this paper, we investigate how head dimension affects the performance of long-context retrieval tasks. Our empirical studies reveal that pretraining loss and short-context non-retrieval task performance are not affected much by head dimension, while long-context retrieval performance improves with wider heads at fixed model sizes. We find that models with wider heads have a higher proportion of retrieval heads, associating more parameters with retrieval. Our ablation studies also show that the retrieval performance improves with wider heads even when the projection weights in attention modules are frozen during long-context continual pretraining, suggesting that wider heads not only benefit updates in attention modules but lead to more effective adaptation of components such as embeddings and MLPs.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: GS-MoE: Training-Free MoE Compression via Groupwise Subspace Sharing and Pruning
item.description:
发表方：（未标注）　发布：2026-10-23　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 MoE 通过稀疏激活省计算，但专家参数存储仍是主要内存瓶颈——能否免训练地压缩 MoE？

方法 提出 GS-MoE，沿两个压缩轴处理专家间与专家内冗余：分组低秩表示捕获跨专家共享结构同时保留专家特定投影，Nyström 神经元压缩缩减专家内部宽度；用重建误差约简指导专家分组，用无梯度层重要性分数做层级预算分配，特征值与 leverage 再将其分布为组间非均匀秩与专家间宽度。

关键数字 摘要未给出具体数值；实验显示两轴压缩在细粒度场景的高压缩率下收益互补。

为什么值得看 免训练 MoE 压缩的"跨专家+专家内"双轴方案，专家存储优化可参考。

item.title: From Parameter Rebasin to Functional Transfer Across Heterogeneous Transformers
item.description:
发表方：（未标注）　发布：2026-10-23　分类：论文PDF

Adapting pretrained Transformers to downstream tasks produces task-specific updates that are expensive to reproduce for every model variant. Reusing these updates across different ...

Adapting pretrained Transformers to downstream tasks produces task-specific updates that are expensive to reproduce for every model variant. Reusing these updates across different depths and widths is challenging because their parameters have incompatible shapes and do not share a canonical coordinate system. We introduce Ariadne, a training-free method that transfers task-specific behavior across heterogeneous Transformers without resizing the source model or transporting its parameters. Rather than treating the source task vector, i.e. the difference in parameter space between the fine-tuned and the base models, as the object to move, Ariadne characterizes fine-tuning by the activation changes it induces at matched blocks. First, it aligns these effects to a target base through local Procrustes maps. Then, it directly synthesizes a native target update by closed-form ridge regression. Across Transformer expansion, reduction and language-model transfer, Ariadne improves target-model performance while substantially reducing the time and memory required to construct an update relative to previous cross-architecture rebasin approaches. These results show that local functional effects…

item.title: Embodied Emissions of 2.5D and 3D Scaling in Chipletized GPUs for Low-Carbon AI
item.description:
发表方：（未标注）　发布：2026-10-23　分类：论文PDF

GPU compute resources are scaling to support growing AI workloads, leading to further rises in the climate change impact of hyperscale data centers that rely on high-performance GP...

GPU compute resources are scaling to support growing AI workloads, leading to further rises in the climate change impact of hyperscale data centers that rely on high-performance GPUs. To model how packaging decisions impact the carbon footprint we have estimated the embodied emissions (EE) of a chiplet-based GPU that has been scaled in 2.5D and 3D using the imec.netzero modelling platform. We doubled the number of compute units and high bandwidth memory (HBM) capacity in the 2.5D and 3D scaled systems and found that 3D scaling results in an 89% increase in EE, as compared to an increase of 141% for 2.5D scaling, positioning 3D scaling as an attractive solution to limit the embodied emissions due to GPU scaling.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Democratizing LLM Training with the Edge: Challenges, Systems, and the Road Ahead
item.description:
发表方：（未标注）　发布：2026-10-23　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 LLM 集中式训练依赖少数巨头的数据中心，规模不可持续，也把持有私有数据但缺乏算力的小机构挡在门外——如何民主化 LLM 训练？

方法 围绕预训练与微调范式系统梳理分布式 LLM 训练路线：联邦学习、拆分学习与去中心化方法，评估其在异构硬件、不可靠连接的跨地域场景下的就绪度；提出统一系统架构——云托管参数服务器经出站 gRPC 协调异构客户端，预训练与一系列微调方法共用同一套通信、压缩与容错栈。

关键数字 在 GPT-2 Medium 与 Llama3-1B 上做真实跨地域实验验证设计（摘要未给出具体性能数字）。

为什么值得看 把边缘设备纳入 LLM 训练的完整系统综述+统一架构，边缘智能方向必读。

item.title: Data Quality Audit and Bivariate Temperature-Humidity Analysis of a Long-Term LoRaWAN Network: Anomaly Detection, PCA, Clustering and Machine Learning
item.description:
发表方：（未标注）　发布：2026-10-23　分类：论文PDF

Long-term environmental IoT/LPWAN deployments often aggregate heterogeneous data streams from diverse devices without systematic auditing of each variable's actual coverage prior t...

Long-term environmental IoT/LPWAN deployments often aggregate heterogeneous data streams from diverse devices without systematic auditing of each variable's actual coverage prior to analysis-an increased risk when multiple sensor types coexist within the same network. This work proposes a C++17 processing pipeline applied to the Tour Perret LoRaWAN dataset (421 937 frames, June 2021--June 2023, 5 devices). A systematic coverage audit integrated into the extraction phase reveals that CO2 is completely missing (0% coverage) and pressure is reported only by an isolated base module (Wyres, 4.24% of the corpus), invalidating the initial hypothesis of a joint four-variable analysis. The analysis is refocused on the Temperature--Humidity pair, jointly available across 205{,}005 frames (95.76%) from 4 Elsys EMS sensors. The pipeline sequentially performs anomaly detection (modified Z-score, Isolation Forest), bivariate Principal Component Analysis, clustering (K-means, DBSCAN), and a multilayer perceptron predicting humidity from temperature and time, whose residuals serve as a detector for slow drift. item.title: DRIVE: Fine-tuning via Data Contribution- and Diversity-aware Weighting with Prior Regularization
item.description:
发表方：（未标注）　发布：2026-10-23　分类：论文PDF

Single-stage fine-tuning is pervasive, yet catastrophic forgetting persists when the source pre-training data is inaccessible. Data weighting affords a natural lever to modulate sa...

Single-stage fine-tuning is pervasive, yet catastrophic forgetting persists when the source pre-training data is inaccessible. Data weighting affords a natural lever to modulate sample influence. Yet existing weighting methods lack a principled mechanism to explicitly arbitrate knowledge retention against new-task adaptation, and provide no unified differentiable objective to accommodate auxiliary signals such as sample diversity and sample characteristics. This is because current schemes privilege one goal over the other, and no explicit gradient-compatible encoding exists for such signals. To address this, we propose DRIVE, a principled and efficient weight assignment framework. It derives per-sample weights via a unified differentiable objective where three coupled signals co-evolve: Shapley additivity splits contribution into anti-forgetting and adaptation components, which are reshaped by a covariance-based diversity term and stabilized by a sample-characteristic prior. Far from a mere combination, this yields an end-to-end gradient-based scheme balancing stability against plasticity. Theoretically, we prove that DRIVE enjoys superior stability-plasticity guarantees over exist…

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

Multimodal healthcare data contain relational information that extends beyond individual patient observations. Effective clinical outcome prediction therefore requires not only integrating information from multiple modalities, but also modeling the relationships between them. Standard fusion approaches do not explicitly capture these interactions, while existing graph-based approaches typically model only a subset of them. We propose DIGOM (Disentangled Interaction Graphs for Outcome prediction in Multimodal healthcare), a graph-based framework that jointly models three complementary interaction types: Intra-patient cross-modal, Cross-patient same-modal, and Cross-patient cross-modal interactions. DIGOM learns a sparse multiplex graph with disentangled views, each encoding interactions between pairs of modalities across patients. Discrete adjacency matrices with patient-adaptive connectivity are sampled via a differentiable mechanism, enabling end-to-end learning and allowing the model to select informative relationships without imposing a fixed number of neighbors. A regularization objective maintains overall graph sparsity, while message passing integrates this relational context…

item.title: Controlled Evaluation of EEG Foundation Models: Random Initialisation, Band-Power and Validation-Selected Probes
item.description:
发表方：（未标注）　发布：2026-10-23　分类：论文PDF

EEG foundation models report downstream gains, yet their protocols seldom include three controls. These are the same encoder untrained, spectral features fitted on the same data, a...

EEG foundation models report downstream gains, yet their protocols seldom include three controls. These are the same encoder untrained, spectral features fitted on the same data, and a layer picked without looking at test scores. We therefore evaluate five publicly released EEG foundation models and an in-house JEPA-style model under one protocol with all three controls and several seeds, on five benchmarks and four added task families. The controls change the reading in three ways. First, picking the probed layer by its test score raises the layer-wise peak by an average of +0.034 and reverses the peak-versus-output gap in 9 of 36 cells. Second, with the layer picked on validation, random initialisation matches or beats pretraining for half of the models on sleep and emotion, and no model beats a five-band log-power baseline on emotion or motor imagery. Third, after full fine-tuning only 5 of 30 pairs gain beyond twice their seed spread, and the one clear loss of -0.290 AUROC persists under matched learning rates. From these results we draw four reporting practices, and we release every cell for re-analysis.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Bounding Queue Waits for Fair Scheduling of Bursty HPC Workloads via Hierarchical Algorithms
item.description:
发表方：（未标注）　发布：2026-10-23　分类：论文PDF

HPC clusters are shared among many projects, each holding an allocation of node-hours, and ensuring fairness is becoming harder. Foundation models workflows and automated pipelines...

HPC clusters are shared among many projects, each holding an allocation of node-hours, and ensuring fairness is becoming harder. Foundation models workflows and automated pipelines have made job submissions bursty and concentrated among a few heavy users, so occasional users absorb queueing delays created by frequent ones, with no indication of how long their jobs will wait. Existing schedulers either forget past usage, protect only the job at the head of the queue, or assume that running jobs can be preempted. We propose HyDRA, a Hybrid Deadline and Ranking-Aware scheduler that enforces fairness among users while bounding the queue wait of every job. HyDRA assigns each job a deadline on arrival based on its size, the priorities of its project and user, the current backlog, and how far its project and user are from their entitled share. It ranks waiting jobs by a priority score that grows with waiting time, serves jobs close to their deadlines first, and backfills a job only when no deadline, or fairness limit is violated. We evaluate HyDRA on workloads derived from a year of ALCF Polaris job traces, against conventional schedulers and variants inspired by PCS, Themis, and the PBS …

item.title: BiLoCo: Binary Low-Rank Corrections for Post-Training Quantization
item.description:
发表方：（未标注）　发布：2026-10-23　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 FP4 后训练量化（PTQ）在 Blackwell 原生 FP4 张量核上降低 LLM 推理成本，但仍有明显精度差距；SVDQuant 用高精度低秩校正弥补，但每 rank 位宽高、且与 FP4 GEMM 争用同一张量核。

方法 提出 BiLoCo：低秩校正的左右因子以 {±1} 二值符号向量存储而非 BF16——每个 rank-one 分量存储减少 16×，校正变成纯加减、可在 CUDA 核上与 FP4 张量核 GEMM 并发执行；在 B300 上实现为融合单 kernel。

关键数字 在 4B–72B LLM 上匹配或超越同内存的 SVDQuant。

为什么值得看 二值低秩校正把精度补偿的硬件开销压到极低，Blackwell FP4 推理落地参考。

item.title: Beyond Hotness: High-Resolution Memory Characterization of Cloud and LLM Workloads for Tiered Memory with ARM SPE
item.description:
发表方：（未标注）　发布：2026-10-23　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 云与数据中心内存成本飙升，多层内存（tiered memory）是平衡性能与成本的方案——但需要深入理解负载的内存行为才能用好它。

方法 面向数据中心日益增多的 ARM 处理器，基于 ARM 统计剖析扩展（SPE）实现高分辨率内存刻画方法：刻画 CloudSuite 与 LLM 应用中 8 个内存密集负载，识别区域特定访问模式，评估面向云的缓存层级有效性，并基于内存空闲期与延迟剖面提出新指标以决定分层内存的数据放置。

关键数字 覆盖 8 个内存密集负载（CloudSuite + LLM 应用）；摘要未给出具体性能数值。

为什么值得看 ARM SPE 实现的高分辨率内存画像，为分层内存数据放置提供方法论与新指标。

item.title: Beyond Data Schedule: Fast LLM Pretraining on Data Mixtures by Loss-Reweighting
item.description:
发表方：（未标注）　发布：2026-10-23　分类：论文PDF

Large language models often acquire specialized capabilities through successive pretraining stages, but these gains can come at the cost of forgetting earlier knowledge. In this wo...

Large language models often acquire specialized capabilities through successive pretraining stages, but these gains can come at the cost of forgetting earlier knowledge. In this work, we investigate whether such trade-offs can be improved by changing how strongly each domain contributes to learning while keeping its data exposure fixed. We find that, in controlled knowledge--mathematics experiments, loss reweighting produces a single checkpoint that surpasses the best knowledge and reasoning scores attained along either stage trajectory. This reveals an independent control that data-mixture ratios alone do not capture. Building on this finding, we propose LARE (Loss-Adaptive Reweighting under fixed Exposure), which automatically adjusts domain weights from running loss statistics. Motivated by a theoretical analysis of gradient noise, its normalized inverse-square-root rule balances relative loss scales without changing the sampled mixture or requiring additional runs to search for weights. Across knowledge, mathematics, and code, \Method{} improves all five evaluated benchmarks for a 1.5B model trained on 240B tokens, averaging +7.84 pp over a matched direct mixture, including gai…

item.title: Automated Multi-Line Bug Repair Using Model Checker Aided LLMs: A Case Study on RISC-V Processors
item.description:
发表方：（未标注）　发布：2026-10-23　分类：论文PDF

Functional verification of Register-Transfer Level(RTL) designs has become a critical bottleneck in modern semiconductor development, often consuming the majority of project resour...

Functional verification of Register-Transfer Level(RTL) designs has become a critical bottleneck in modern semiconductor development, often consuming the majority of project resources. Debugging, in particular, remains an especially time-consuming task, requiring careful analysis of simulation traces or counterexamples. Recent work has explored applying Large Language Models (LLMs) to RTL debug and repair with great promise. However, the existing approaches typically are for single-line bugs, operate in open-loop, rely heavily on prompts or retrieval, lack scalability, and often produce incorrect fixes. In this paper, we propose a novel automated RTL bug repair methodology that combines LLMs, assertions, and a model checker to provide scalable, trustworthy semantic grounding and formal guarantees. Concretely, the methodology leverages failing assertions to guide the LLM in generating patches for multi-line bugs. Each candidate patch is formally verified using a model checker (JasperGold), ensuring only valid repairs are accepted. We evaluate the efficacy and scalability of our methodology on the BRISC-V RISC-V core using mutation testing, introducing several mutation types, and dem…

item.title: Amortized Thompson Sampling and Efficient Information-Directed Sampling for Simulator-Based Design
item.description:
发表方：（未标注）　发布：2026-10-23　分类：论文PDF

Thompson sampling is a widely used strategy for sequential decision-making under uncertainty, offering a principled way to balance exploration and exploitation. This strategy invol...

Thompson sampling is a widely used strategy for sequential decision-making under uncertainty, offering a principled way to balance exploration and exploitation. This strategy involves maximizing a target objective under a single sample drawn from the current belief over unknown quantities. Conventionally, this optimization is performed once the belief has been inferred from data, and it becomes computationally burdensome when many Thompson samples are required, especially in continuous action spaces. In this work, we introduce an approach that amortizes this process ahead of time, before any data is collected, so that an approximation of the full Thompson sampling distribution is available immediately once observations arrive. We employ this approach to solve the multi-round setting, involving sequential data acquisition and Thompson-sample recommendation across rounds. Beyond accelerating Thompson sampling, our approach enables efficient estimation of expected information gain about the optimal action. This can be used to select more informative Thompson samples or to obtain maximally informative designs with optimization. Combining this estimate of expected information gain with …

item.title: Accordion: Elastic-Depth Inference via Fixed-Prefix Layer Looping
item.description:
发表方：（未标注）　发布：2026-10-23　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 不同应用有不同推理预算，但为每个预算单独训练维护模型成本高昂——能否一个模型支持多种推理深度？

方法 提出 Accordion，基于 MoE 的固定前缀层循环模型，支持五种推理预算：每个预算走预定义执行路径，最小预算保留无循环原模型；联合预训练每个 micro-batch 采样一个预算并优化其 next-token 损失，无需额外跨预算一致性目标；通过参数组融合与预算匹配的多教师在线策略蒸馏把三个领域专家整合进一个模型。

关键数字 3.6T token 预训练后，增加推理深度使 Accordion-6B-A0.5B 在 37 个任务上五类宏平均提升（摘要未给完整数值）。

为什么值得看 弹性深度推理的完整训练流水线（预训练+微调+RL），服务多预算场景可参考。

item.title: uGDS: A User-Space Development Kit for High-Performance GPU Direct Storage
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-22　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 GPU Direct Storage（GDS）三大局限：控制路径每次 I/O 都过内核、流有序路径强加全序、闭源用户态引擎难诊断难定制。

方法 uGDS 开源用户态 GPU Direct Storage 库：宿主机 CPU 在用户态管理整个 NVMe 命令生命周期，payload 走 PCIe P2P DMA 不占用 GPU 计算；统一跨厂商抽象（CUDA/AMD HIP）、负载感知调度、端到端透明；最小内核模块仅用于一次性特权设置。

关键数字 A100 + Samsung 990 PRO 上批量读带宽最高 12.12× GDS、批量写 30.69×；4KiB 同步写延迟降 84.1%；单流 5.49 GiB/s（GDS 仅保留 40.8%）；LMCache 中 TTFT 中位降 62.7%、goodput 提升 2.63×。

为什么值得看 开源 + 用户态 + 跨厂商，数据密集型 GPU 应用的实用加速层，已用于 LMCache。

item.title: When to Follow the Teacher: Advantage-Based On-Policy Distillation
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-22　分类：论文PDF

Online Policy Distillation (OPD) often outperforms offline methods such as Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) by training on trajectories sampled directly from the student.

Online Policy Distillation (OPD) often outperforms offline methods such as Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) by training on trajectories sampled directly from the student. However, standard OPD trains the student to follow the teacher at every state of the trajectory, assuming that teacher guidance is always beneficial. We instead distinguish between what the teacher prefers and what actually helps the current student succeed. We introduce Advantage-Based On-Policy Distillation (AOPD), which weights teacher actions by their counterfactual advantage under the student. Teacher actions that improve the student's expected outcome are reinforced, while those that do not are downweighted. Directly computing these advantages requires trying alternative teacher actions at each step and running new rollouts from each. Instead, we show that the AOPD objective can be estimated using only standard student rollouts and their terminal rewards. Our estimator uses teacher importance weights on the student-sampled actions to provide unbiased advantage-weighted supervision, without any additional rollouts or reward evaluations. This allows AOPD to focus teacher supervision on actions that help the curren…

item.title: When News Gets Old: Portfolio Allocation with Reinforcement Learning and Large Language Models
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-22　分类：论文PDF

Financial news can influence investment decisions long after publication.

Financial news can influence investment decisions long after publication. Timely news may reach an investor before prices fully adjust, whereas older news may already be reflected in prices. We examine two ways to handle aging signals: retain them and give a portfolio policy timing information, or filter them out before portfolio selection. A fixed large language model (LLM) extracts signals from public SEC disclosures. We compare these treatments in reinforcement learning (RL) policies and LLMs that choose portfolios directly. We evaluate returns after trading costs in historical tests over 2023-2025. RL choices respond to timing information in a controlled test, but historical returns show no consistent benefit from adding it. For the LLM, filtering old news produced the highest average net return, reaching 18.43% per year when news delivery was delayed by four weeks. This exceeded the returns of all RL strategies that used news.

item.title: When Forgotten Facts Return: Relearning-Aware Unlearning of Knowledge Graph Embeddings via Tangent Kernels
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-22　分类：论文PDF

Approximate unlearning answers a deletion request on a knowledge-graph embedding by editing entity embeddings instead of retraining from scratch.

Approximate unlearning answers a deletion request on a knowledge-graph embedding by editing entity embeddings instead of retraining from scratch. These embeddings keep being updated as new facts arrive. Under this ordinary continued training, forgotten facts recover more than in the exact-unlearning baseline, a model retrained without them and given the same continued training. We trace this relearning to entity embeddings shared by forgotten and new facts. To our knowledge, this is the first study of relearning in knowledge-graph embeddings. Relearning-robust methods developed for deep networks do not account for the graph structure underlying this recovery. We propose Kernel-Anticipated Unlearning (KAU), which uses the tangent kernel to model how continued training changes forgotten facts' scores through these shared parameters. KAU expresses this first-order response in closed form and differentiates through it inside the forgetting loss. The objective steers edits toward directions that continued training reverses less. item.title: Transformers with CoT Discover Heavy-Ball Acceleration Through Training
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-22　分类：论文PDF

Modern transformers often solve complex tasks by generating and refining intermediate reasoning steps.

Modern transformers often solve complex tasks by generating and refining intermediate reasoning steps. To develop a theoretical understanding of chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning, a notable recent study by Huang et al. (2025) viewed transformers as algorithm executors, and showed that when transformers' CoT steps are supervised by a gradient-descent teacher, they can learn to implement gradient descent for in-context weight prediction in linear regression. In this paper, we study the same in-context weight prediction task but ask whether CoT reasoning can go beyond merely imitating the teacher algorithm. We show that, after initial supervision from a gradient-descent teacher, further trajectory-level supervision using the true regression weights leads the model to implement the Heavy-Ball method, thereby achieving acceleration over the original teacher. Notably, this accelerated algorithm emerges without supervision from any Heavy-Ball teacher. Our results provide a concrete theoretical example in which transformer reasoning can discover new algorithms through training, rather than merely imitate the algorithm used for supervision.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Training Small Language Models for Transferable Tool Selection
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-22　分类：论文PDF

As LLM agents operate over corpora of more than ten thousand tools, selecting the right tool for a complex multi-step user instruction becomes a central bottleneck.

As LLM agents operate over corpora of more than ten thousand tools, selecting the right tool for a complex multi-step user instruction becomes a central bottleneck. Tool descriptions cannot all fit in context, and relevance-based retrievers only rank tools without knowing which are actually needed. Recent work instead leverages proprietary commercial LLMs like Claude or ChatGPT to drive a retriever, decomposing the instruction and selecting over retrieved candidates. We show that a small, open model can be trained via reinforcement learning to perform the same functionality. On ToolBench, a Qwen3-8B model post-trained with our recipe outperforms Llama-4-Maverick (402B). In addition, the trained model transfers directly to different retrievers and generalizes to new tool corpora in different domains.

item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-22　分类：论文PDF

Large language models trained on data generated by other models can sometimes inherit traits unrelated to that data, a phenomenon called subliminal learning.

Large language models trained on data generated by other models can sometimes inherit traits unrelated to that data, a phenomenon called subliminal learning. We study both hard label distillation, where students train on numbers generated by a biased teacher, and on-policy soft label distillation, where students generate the data and the teacher's logits provide the learning signal. Using Pythia, PolyPythia, and DataDecide OLMo models, we find that transfer persists in both settings across differences in weight initialization, pretraining data order, pretraining corpus, model size, and architecture. Across pretraining checkpoints, the ability to transmit a preference and the ability to acquire one develop separately: some checkpoints are more effective teachers but weaker students, and vice versa. Consistent with this distinction, cross-model transfer can be strongly asymmetric in magnitude when teacher and student roles are reversed. Wearable inertial measurement unit (IMU) systems for construction worker human activity recognition (HAR) routinely report aggregate accuracies above 95 %, rarely under genuine subject-independent (leave-one-subject-out (LOSO)) evaluation, masking the per-individual variance that determines real-world deployment performance. item.title: Towards Adversarially Robust Multigraph Neural Networks for Financial Crime Analysis
item.description:
发表方：（未标注）　发布：2026-10-22　分类：论文PDF

Financial transaction networks are naturally represented as multigraphs, where repeated transactions between the same pair of accounts are modeled as distinct edges. Recently propo...

Financial transaction networks are naturally represented as multigraphs, where repeated transactions between the same pair of accounts are modeled as distinct edges. Recently proposed multigraph neural network architectures leverage this structure explicitly to achieve a strong performance on anti-money laundering (AML) tasks. However, their robustness to adversaries that manipulate transaction structures to evade detection remains largely unexplored. We present the first scalable framework for structural attacks and adversarial training of multigraph neural networks using node-edge incidence matrices, adapting projected gradient descent and projected randomized block coordinate descent methods to optimize structural perturbations over such matrices. We further introduce a cycle-based regularizer that penalizes changes in the global counts of directed 2- and 3-cycles, providing a structural measure of attack plausibility. Experiments on synthetic pattern-detection and realistic AML datasets show that our learned attacks substantially outperform non-learnable perturbation baselines in reducing detection performance (PR-AUC), while adversarial training consistently improves robustnes…

item.title: Topological Equivalence of Spectral and Density Cluster Hierarchies
item.description:
发表方：（未标注）　发布：2026-10-22　分类：论文PDF

We compare two canonical ways to recover hierarchical clustering from an underlying density $f$: the \emph{density cluster tree} given by connected components of superlevel sets $\...

We compare two canonical ways to recover hierarchical clustering from an underlying density $f$: the \emph{density cluster tree} given by connected components of superlevel sets $\{f\geλ\}$, and a \emph{spectral hierarchy} obtained by applying single linkage to diffusion distances induced by a Laplacian operator. We give conditions under which, at an appropriate diffusion time, the diffusion hierarchy is \emph{topologically equivalent} to the density cluster tree up to a monotone rescaling of heights. It further shows that a $k$-NN graph implementation inherits this equivalence from uniform approximation of diffusion distances, yielding a finite-sample reduction from spectral graph constructions to density-level-set topology.

item.description:
发表方：（未标注）　发布：2026-10-22　分类：论文PDF

Speculative decoding is a technique that accelerates the inference speed of autoregressive large language models (LLMs) by sampling from a faster, lower quality draft model. Tradit...

Speculative decoding is a technique that accelerates the inference speed of autoregressive large language models (LLMs) by sampling from a faster, lower quality draft model. Traditionally, a fundamental characteristic of speculative decoding is that it is lossless with respect to the verifier distribution, guaranteeing speed without sacrificing quality. This differs from recently developed diffusion LLMs (dLLMs), which are notably able to achieve substantial speedups by degrading the quality of their outputs with less diffusion effort. Because diffusion models are able to sample faster than autoregressive models by generating tokens in parallel, they are considered strong candidates for draft models in speculative diffusion. While it is widely understood that diffusion models can sacrifice quality for speed, speculative decoding itself can also be generalized to generate lossy samples faster using more lenient acceptance criteria with respect to the verifier distribution. Presented with the two parameters of diffusion effort and speculative decoding leniency, this paper explores the full achievable Pareto frontier via joint variations of these parameters. item.title: SnakeCharmer: Orchestrating Utility, Timeliness, and Placement in GPU Prefetching
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-22　分类：论文PDF

GPUs rely on massive thread-level parallelism to tolerate long memory latency, yet they still suffer severe stalls when many warps simultaneously wait for data from the memory system.

GPUs rely on massive thread-level parallelism to tolerate long memory latency, yet they still suffer severe stalls when many warps simultaneously wait for data from the memory system. Address-prediction-based GPU prefetchers can mitigate such stalls, but accurate prediction alone does not guarantee performance improvement: a predicted prefetch becomes beneficial only if it is worth issuing, arrives at the right time, and is retained without harmful interference. Because these requirements interact, optimizing any single dimension in isolation can simply move the bottleneck to another. We capture these requirements with a predicted-prefetch-to-realized-benefit perspective and propose SnakeCharmer, a unified backend prefetch-control framework for address-prediction-based GPU prefetchers. SnakeCharmer separates address prediction from prefetch realization: the frontend predictor generates prefetch candidates, while the backend control path jointly controls utility, timeliness, and placement by determining whether each candidate should be issued, when it should be issued, and where the returned data should be retained. SnakeCharmer realizes this control path with zero-value-aware filte…

Energy-Based Models (EBMs) are a flexible class of generative models that decouple probabilistic modeling from the generation process. This decoupling directly enables compositiona...

Energy-Based Models (EBMs) are a flexible class of generative models that decouple probabilistic modeling from the generation process. This decoupling directly enables compositional generation and inference-time scaling, where sample quality can be refined simply by increasing sampling steps. However, severe challenges in high-dimensional sampling and training instabilities with deep architectures have restricted EBMs to low-dimensional regimes. To resolve these bottlenecks, we introduce the Transformer Energy-Based Model (TEM), a scalable transformer energy function operating entirely within a latent space. On top of this backbone, we extract energies at multiple layers and sum them, composing complementary constraints from local texture to global semantics. Furthermore, two components make this high-quality at scale: Positive Representation Alignment (PRA), which supervises TEM's intermediate representations with a vision foundation model, and advanced sampling strategies that improve sample quality at inference. item.title: Same molecule, Different Knowledge: Cross-Identifier Binding Failures in LLMs For chemistry
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-22　分类：论文PDF

Chemical AI workflows routinely represent the same molecule through multiple co-referring identifiers, including trivial names, IUPAC names, and SMILES, implicitly assuming that these representations provide interchangeable access to an LLM's knowledge.

Chemical AI workflows routinely represent the same molecule through multiple co-referring identifiers, including trivial names, IUPAC names, and SMILES, implicitly assuming that these representations provide interchangeable access to an LLM's knowledge. To test this assumption, we first introduce a controlled benchmark and show that it does not hold. Across foundation models spanning 7B to 72B parameters, even chemistry-specialized models, co-referring molecular identifiers consistently expose different subsets of the model's knowledge. We then conduct a series of controlled behavioral, representational, and causal analyses to characterize this failure. We show that even when a model can identify a molecule from its SMILES and retrieve a fact through the corresponding name, the same fact can remain inaccessible directly from SMILES. We term this phenomenon \emph{cross-identifier binding failure}. Further analysis of internal representations, conflicting identifiers, and parameter editing shows that neither improved chemical representation competence nor modification of individual facts is sufficient to establish reliable access across identifiers. item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-22　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 格基向量量化在低比特 LLM 上有强率失真权衡，但其在量化感知训练（VQ-QAT）下的行为仍缺乏理解。

方法 SQuAT，shape-gain VQ-QAT：权重分解为方向与幅度，方向用 E8 派生球面码本量化、幅度用低比特标量量化器独立量化；方向与幅度使用分离的直通估计器，隐式产生切空间更新、实现球面（黎曼）优化；配分布式精确最近邻分配以支持扩展。

关键数字 VQ-QAT 训练时间降低 12.8×，可扩展到 10B token；在 LLaMA-3.2-1B/3B、Qwen3-4B、Qwen3-1.7B 上一致优于标准 VQ-QAT STE，达 SOTA 精度。

为什么值得看 首个将球面优化视角引入 VQ-QAT 的可扩展方案，附 12.8× 训练加速。

item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-22　分类：论文PDF

Complex objects such as engineering designs and proteins are often difficult to optimise because their design spaces exhibit high-dimensional structure and objective evaluations are expensive.

Complex objects such as engineering designs and proteins are often difficult to optimise because their design spaces exhibit high-dimensional structure and objective evaluations are expensive. Generative models provide continuous latent representations, but their latent spaces can have thousands to tens of thousands of dimensions, creating a regime where the latent dimension $D$ greatly exceeds the evaluation budget. We introduce SABLE, a Bayesian optimisation method for high-dimensional latent spaces with an isotropic distribution and limited budget. SABLE uses a Bayesian affine surrogate for prediction and acquisition, treating higher-order structure as surrogate discrepancy. After $N$ observations, the slope update has dimension at most $N-1$, yielding a decomposition of each query into an in-span component optimised by expected improvement (EI) in at most $N$ dimensions and an off-span component governed by a scalar norm. item.title: RheOPT: Few-Shot Non-Newtonian Flow Prediction via Newtonian Pretraining of RheOFormer
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-22　分类：论文PDF

Despite advances in numerical methods, non-Newtonian flow simulations remain computationally expensive because velocity and stress must be advanced together through rate- and history-dependent constitutive dynamics.

Despite advances in numerical methods, non-Newtonian flow simulations remain computationally expensive because velocity and stress must be advanced together through rate- and history-dependent constitutive dynamics. Neural-operator surrogates reduce inference cost after training, but their training data require the same expensive simulations they aim to replace, making data-efficient learning essential when only a few non-Newtonian simulations can be afforded. Here, we introduce the Rheological Operator Pretrained Transformer (RheOPT), which pretrains a transformer-based neural operator on inexpensive Newtonian simulations and fine-tunes it on a small number of non-Newtonian samples. Rather than transferring the Newtonian constitutive response itself, RheOPT reuses geometry-conditioned transport structure that remains useful after the stress model changes. We evaluate RheOPT in two geometry-matched settings: a $4{:}1$ contraction channel for Giesekus, Oldroyd-B, and Bingham fluids, and the oscillatory wake behind a triangular obstacle for Oldroyd-B flow. item.title: Reverse-KL Policy Distillation: Statistical Guarantees and Limits
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-22　分类：论文PDF

Reverse Kullback-Leibler (KL) distillation has shown empirical promise for training language models, but its statistical guarantees and limits remain poorly understood.

Reverse Kullback-Leibler (KL) distillation has shown empirical promise for training language models, but its statistical guarantees and limits remain poorly understood. In particular, the effects of two design choices remain unclear: Does access to the teacher's full action distribution provide an advantage over observing only the probability it assigns to the sampled action? Must training trajectories come from the student (online distillation), or can teacher-generated trajectories (offline distillation) suffice? Our work takes a first step toward understanding the theory underlying these questions. We study the sample complexity of online reverse-KL distillation under two feedback models: the teacher reveals either its full action distribution or only the probability of the student-generated action. We establish minimax bounds for the former and show that substantially more data may be required for the latter. In contrast, offline reverse-KL distillation can attain the same minimax rate whether the teacher reveals its full distribution or only its probability of the teacher-generated action. The key distinction is that teacher-generated actions themselves reveal the teacher's pr…

item.title: Rethinking Sequence Compression with Test-time Regression
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-22　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 序列压缩是高效语言/多模态模型的关键信息瓶颈，但基于池化或学习投影的现有方法表现欠佳。

方法 测试时回归视角：输入 token 定义回归问题，拟合系数构成压缩表示；回归通过反向传播端到端学习，系数在前向中以闭式高效计算，形成 TTR-Compressor。

关键数字 块稀疏注意力上 RULER 性能大幅优于基于注意力的压缩器；视觉 token 合并持续胜过标准 MLP merger，且少用 55.6% 视觉 token 即达到相同性能。

为什么值得看 把序列压缩重新定义为测试时回归，为压缩器设计提供新原语。

item.title: Repair Changes Which Layers to Remove: Exact Optima for Depth Pruning of Language Models
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-22　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 深度剪枝中"移除哪些层"由启发式分数决定，其与最优选择的差距未知。

方法 精确评估所有层组子集（四个模型族约 53,000 个剪枝模型，含/不含 repair），发现最佳移除层取决于 repair：线性 repair 吸收相邻层交互，使最优布局从分裂式变为连续块；据此改为"在将应用的 repair 下选层"，贪心搜索成本与 SLEB 相同。

关键数字 相对 ReplaceMe，5 个模型（最大 27B）上困惑度降低 20%–66%；带任务目标时同数据下准确率高最多 25 分。

为什么值得看 首次给出深度剪枝最优层选择的精确基准，纠正"先选层再 repair"的普遍做法。

Ray tracing (RT) generates photorealistic images by simulating the physical behavior of light as it interacts with surfaces in a virtual scene.

Ray tracing (RT) generates photorealistic images by simulating the physical behavior of light as it interacts with surfaces in a virtual scene. In film production and high-end rendering pipelines, this technique computes global illumination, reflections, refractions, and soft shadows by tracing millions of light rays per frame and accurately modeling their bounces and attenuation. Contemporary GPUs incorporate specialized ray tracing hardware to accelerate key operations in the traversal pipeline. By accelerating these stages in hardware, the unit enables real-time ray tracing for complex scenes that previously required offline computation. However, ray tracing introduces substantial control and data divergence. Each ray may traverse a different set of nodes in the acceleration structure, encounter distinct materials, or terminate at varying depths. This irregularity reduces thread coherence and exposes a fundamental disparity between the GPU SIMT and per-thread execution model of dedicated RT units, where each ray progresses independently. item.title: Random Remasking Scales Masked Diffusion Inference
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-22　分类：论文PDF

Masked diffusion models (MDMs) generate sequences by progressively unmasking tokens, but errors introduced during decoding are typically irreversible.

Masked diffusion models (MDMs) generate sequences by progressively unmasking tokens, but errors introduced during decoding are typically irreversible. Recent work has shown that iterative correction can improve sample quality, yet existing theory fails to explain this given a learned, imperfect denoiser model. We re-formulate MDM inference as a Markov chain on the clean sequence space, defined by a remask-denoise kernel that randomly re-introduces masks and then denoises. This helps us analyze the actual denoising trajectory towards the data distribution. The analysis motivates Random Remask-Denoise (R$^2$D) inference, a purely test-time, finetuning-free, reward-free procedure. To further improve performance, we propose Trajectory Correction Training (TCT), a denoiser-training procedure that exposes the model to its own errors along the generation trajectory. On logical tasks, our approach exhibits a striking near-log-linear test-time scaling, achieving over 97% accuracy on hard Sudoku puzzles and over 99% accuracy on 3-SAT. Our approach also applies to pretrained models on actual language tasks, beating iterative correction baselines and the official Q-mode accuracy of LLaDA2.1-mi…

item.title: QuaNAS: Uncertainty-Aware Reuse of Earlier Searches for Query-Efficient Neural Architecture Search
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-22　分类：论文PDF

Neural architecture search (NAS) on a new dataset often affords only tens of short training runs, so what the search knows before its first evaluation decides its efficiency.

Neural architecture search (NAS) on a new dataset often affords only tens of short training runs, so what the search knows before its first evaluation decides its efficiency. Yet most NAS methods start from scratch, guided at best by zero-cost proxies that are unreliable across tasks. QuaNAS treats a library of earlier searches in the same search space as explicit knowledge of uncertain reliability. Main effects of design decisions learned from this library and, secondarily, zero-cost proxies become priors over candidate architectures without any label of the new dataset. A Gaussian process starts at the prior optimum and re-estimates after every evaluation how far each prior is trusted. Under a protocol frozen before any confirmation data were seen, QuaNAS was evaluated once on 12 new image, time-series, text and tabular datasets. It lowered anytime regret on the short-training objective 2.7- to 3.9-fold relative to five pre-specified NAS baselines that start from scratch (Holm-adjusted p = 0.0012 each). Its final models matched (non-inferiority margin 0.5 pp) or exceeded matched-recipe reference models on nine datasets, as did the prior optimum, selected without a single evaluati…

item.title: Pipelining vs. Combining in Aggregation Tasks
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-22　分类：论文PDF

We study the aggregation task (convergecast) in networks in the case that the values to be aggregated do not fit in a single message.

We study the aggregation task (convergecast) in networks in the case that the values to be aggregated do not fit in a single message. We assume that every node starts with an input value, and there is an aggregation operator that is commutative, associative, and length-preserving, i.e., the result of aggregating two values has the same length as each of the input values. Since values do not fit in a message, they are transferred in a ``train'' of pipelined messages, which must be terminated whenever we want to aggregate values. The goal is to minimize the makespan time of aggregating all values. We present general lower bounds on the problem and optimal algorithms for several prevalent parallel computing architectures, including the hypercube and complete bipartite graphs, under both the splittable and unsplittable flows models. We also present an $O(\log n)$ approximation for general graphs in the unsplittable flows model.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: OpenAttention: One Percent Is Enough with Tail Proxies
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-22　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 稀疏注意力只读取 KV cache 的一小部分，未读尾部如何处理：直接丢弃会引入偏差，按采样处理在 5% 以下读取率时失效。

方法 关键观察：单 token 的 count-aware mean 代理即可折叠整个尾部；据此构建 OpenAttention 流水线（聚类 + ErrorGate + top-k 选择 + count-aware mean 代理），并设计训练无关的 Query-Geometry 聚类与选择器，ErrorGate 按各簇估计权重误差分配精确读取。

关键数字 RULER-32K HARD + Llama-3.1-8B 上 1% 读取保留 99% 稠密精度；定制 kernel 在 1% 读取时 decode 比稠密注意力快 10×。

为什么值得看 证明"1% 读取足够"，为极低读取率下的长上下文注意力提供新范式。

为什么值得看 证明"1% 读取足够"，为极低读取率下的长上下文注意力提供新范式。

item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-22　分类：论文PDF

On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) improves reasoning by training a model on its own trajectories with dense token-level supervision from a privileged copy conditioned on a reference solution.

On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) improves reasoning by training a model on its own trajectories with dense token-level supervision from a privileged copy conditioned on a reference solution. Existing methods typically use a single teacher distribution conditioned on the complete reference. We identify a limitation of this formulation: a reference is only one realization of the reasoning process. Although it provides evidence about the answer, it also encodes an ordering, phrasing, and solution path. Full-reference conditioning can therefore produce correct targets that depend excessively on information unavailable to the student at inference. We show that replacing one valid reference with another, while holding the problem and student state fixed, can substantially alter the teacher distribution, a phenomenon we call reference-induced target instability. To address this instability, we introduce Monte Carlo Privileged Distillation (MCPD), which models privileged context as a distribution over partial reference views and distills the marginal teacher distribution. MCPD evaluates the teacher under multiple views and averages the resulting next-token distributions. We show that thi…
