item.title: One Pretrained Decision Model Is Enough for Training-Free Generalist Graph Anomaly Detection
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-22　分类：论文PDF

Graph anomaly detection (GAD) aims to identify irregular entities in graph-structured data, yet heterogeneous anomaly patterns and distributional differences across graphs challenge generalizable detection.

Graph anomaly detection (GAD) aims to identify irregular entities in graph-structured data, yet heterogeneous anomaly patterns and distributional differences across graphs challenge generalizable detection. Existing training-free approaches avoid task-specific optimization but primarily rely on predefined numerical scoring rules, leaving the semantic interpretation of heterogeneous anomaly evidence largely unexplored. In this paper, we propose Jev-GAD, a training-free generalist graph anomaly detection framework that bridges heterogeneous numerical evidence and pretrained decision mechanisms. To address heterogeneous anomaly patterns, we construct complementary structural, attribute, and neighborhood evidence and transform heterogeneous statistics into graph-relative anomaly percentiles. To move beyond predefined numerical scoring rules, we leverage a single frozen pretrained language model for evidence-conditioned anomaly assessment. To bridge the semantic gap between numerical evidence and pretrained models, we design a semantic Graph-to-State (G2S) transformation that organizes graph context and semantically labeled node evidence into structured decision states for non-generativ…

item.title: OP-Print: Tracing Membership Imprints in On-Policy Self-Distillation
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-22　分类：论文PDF

On-policy distillation has been widely adopted for alleviating the distribution mismatch of off-policy distillation.

On-policy distillation has been widely adopted for alleviating the distribution mismatch of off-policy distillation. Self-distillation further removes the need for an external teacher by using the student's own outputs, enhanced with extra context or demonstrations, as supervision. This teacher-free design makes on-policy self-distillation practical, yet its privacy risks remain largely unexplored. In particular, using two coupled views of the same training example may strengthen its memorization. Motivated by this, we present the first study of membership inference attacks against on-policy self-distillation. We investigate both gray-box and black-box threat models and propose a unified attack framework, named OP-Print. OP-Print builds on our finding that the supervision imprint in on-policy self-distillation is sparse and structured, concentrating on uncertainty-sensitive correction sites rather than across the entire rollout. Exploiting this property, we construct attack signals tailored to the two access levels: in the gray-box setting, OP-Print directly aggregates the privileged teacher-student residual correction along the same rollout; in the black-box setting, it measures r…

item.title: Not All Retained Clients Are Equal: Client Selection for Federated Unlearning
item.description:
发表方：（未标注）　发布：2026-10-22　分类：论文PDF

Federated unlearning (FU) aims to remove a designated target client's influence from a trained model without the prohibitive cost of retraining from scratch. Existing methods large...

Federated unlearning (FU) aims to remove a designated target client's influence from a trained model without the prohibitive cost of retraining from scratch. Existing methods largely treat unlearning as a post-hoc, stateless operation, overlooking that client influence is path-dependent: contributions made during training, particularly during critical learning periods (CLPs), can have disproportionate and persistent effects. Moreover, knowledge overlap and intermittent client availability make relying on all retained clients inefficient and impractical. We introduce PDF, a path-dependent client-selection framework based on the insight that retained clients are not equally valuable for unlearning. During training, PDF maintains lightweight, target-agnostic, CLP-weighted histories summarizing each client's accumulated update direction and global-model alignment. Upon an unlearning request, these histories identify and rank retained clients that are globally informative yet weakly coupled to the target, enabling retraining-based unlearning with only the top-$k$ clients over a small number of rounds. Experiments on FMNIST, CIFAR-10, and CIFAR-100 under IID and non-IID settings show tha…

item.title: Neural Spectral Capacity with Residual Context for Heterogeneous Resource Allocation within Transformers
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-22　分类：论文PDF

Predicting relative trained performance from architectural specifications can guide design when training costs limit experimentation.

Predicting relative trained performance from architectural specifications can guide design when training costs limit experimentation. Neural Spectral Capacity (NSC) provides such a heuristic, but scores projections independently and assigns identical scores to compatible reorderings of the same layer configurations. We introduce Residual-Aware Neural Spectral Capacity (ResNSC) for Transformers, using a specification-derived statistical reference for accumulated residual updates to determine the input and residual-state statistics in each projection's capacity calculation, while retaining additive evaluation without data or instantiated weights. When residual widths vary, earlier choices affect later scores, so we augment NSC's allocator (NSC-DP) with residual history beyond its layer-and-budget state. ResNSC-DP jointly allocates residual and feed-forward widths under a resource budget, with certified bounds on the best numerically evaluated ResNSC score within a specified finite candidate set. At the 121M and 374M pretraining scales, selected architectures achieve lower mean perplexity than uniform, variable-width, and tapered allocations on FineWeb-Edu, WikiText-2, and LAMBADA at …

item.title: Nested Sparsity for Scalable Pretraining and Continual Learning
item.description:
发表方：（未标注）　发布：2026-10-22　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 MoE transformer 通过稀疏激活降低计算，但条件计算只发生在 MoE 算子中——能否在注意力算子侧也引入可与之嵌套的稀疏机制？

方法 提出 Nestor：一种类似 MoE 的注意力算子条件计算机制，其稀疏性与 MoE 算子的稀疏性自然嵌套（层级组合）；在同等计算量与稀疏度下与常规 MoE transformer 对比语言模型预训练，并评估持续预训练场景。

关键数字 摘要未给出具体数值；结果显示 Nestor 在等计算等稀疏度下优于常规 MoE，且更适合持续预训练：能更有效地扩展到长上下文、更快适应新领域并对旧领域遗忘更少。

为什么值得看 把"条件计算"从 MoE 推广到注意力，可扩展预训练与持续学习的新结构方向。

item.title: Multi-Token Prediction and Alternative Tokenization Improve Learning Latent Multi-Hop Graph Search at Scale
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-22　分类：论文PDF

Given an unseen graph, a start node, $s$, and an end node, $t$, can a language model generate the shortest path from $s$ to $t$?

Given an unseen graph, a start node, $s$, and an end node, $t$, can a language model generate the shortest path from $s$ to $t$? Prior work has found that models fail to learn this task as the graphs scale. We show that this failure has two causes: the supervision signal and the tokenization. First, we theoretically establish and empirically demonstrate the effectiveness of multi-token prediction (MTP), and show that the benefits of MTP are topologically agnostic. Second, we introduce alternative tokenizations and show that the two causes are orthogonal. Using these methods, we break through the scaling wall observed by prior work, consistently and stably learning to solve the task at scales far beyond previous limits.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: MOER: Mix-Policy Optimization under Expert Prefix Guidance with Selective Rollback
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-22　分类：论文PDF

Mix-policy optimization incorporates off-policy expert data into the reinforcement learning (RL) loop to transcend the capability boundary of on-policy RL.

Mix-policy optimization incorporates off-policy expert data into the reinforcement learning (RL) loop to transcend the capability boundary of on-policy RL. However, existing methods either provide static full-trace guidance that suppresses self-exploration, or adopt expert prefix guidance without correctness guarantees, leading to suboptimal performance or even training collapse. In this paper, we propose MOER, a mix-policy optimization framework that harmonizes expert guidance with self-exploration. MOER injects a decaying expert chain-of-thought prefix into the prompt and lets the model complete the remaining reasoning, with the prefix length progressively annealed to encourage self-exploration. A selective rollback mechanism replaces failed completions with the original full expert trace, guaranteeing the correctness of every off-policy trajectory. Furthermore, a harmonized mix-policy objective optimizes on-policy tokens with a GRPO loss while supervising both expert prefix and completion tokens with a trust-region SFT loss, substantially stabilizing training. Extensive experiments show that MOER achieves the highest average scores in mathematical and general domain reasoning ta…

item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-22　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 太空数据中心以太阳能供电运行 MoE LLM，但专家激活偏斜导致供需不匹配：活跃专家受功率约束、空闲专家的采集功率被浪费。

方法 SpaceWPT 框架：用星间激光无线功率传输重分配采集功率；推导简化 WPT 控制的设计原则，以平均推理延迟的可处理代理刻画权衡，最小化得到双端 water-filling 策略，决定每个活跃专家捐出、保留还是接收功率。

关键数字 Mixtral-8x7B 与 Phi-3.5-MoE 模拟中推理延迟最高降低 29.25%，紧凑编队与高传输效率下增益更大。

为什么值得看 太空 LLM 推理这一新兴场景下的功率调度与延迟联合优化，思路新颖。

item.title: Local Discrimination of Binary Classifiers via Localized AUC Functional
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-22　分类：论文PDF

Risk prediction models are frequently evaluated with AUC, which means that during evaluation we are blind to performance heterogeneity, which could lead to bad decision-making in clinics.

Risk prediction models are frequently evaluated with AUC, which means that during evaluation we are blind to performance heterogeneity, which could lead to bad decision-making in clinics. In this work, we aim to change that by identifying patient cohorts for whom the risk prediction model might not be an accurate predictor. To separate these cohorts, we use a version of the weighted AUC, which we call Localized AUC or LAUC. Using this metric, we build a method that we coin LOCATOR. This method is able to identify cohorts of patients for whom the risk prediction model is inaccurate. We test this method both in real-world data and in simulations. We also build a statistical background for the use of Localized AUC for our purposes.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.description:

研究问题 学习稀疏+低秩表示能让单 checkpoint 弹性压缩到多个内存预算，但参数量减少不等于推理变快——非结构化稀疏的索引开销与不规则访存会抵消计算收益。

方法 提出 S-SALAAD 统一框架，在训练中联合学习模型权重及其低秩与结构化稀疏分量；支持一族硬件兼容的结构化稀疏模式，将结构学习与预算感知压缩、专用 CPU/GPU kernel 结合，面向边缘设备本地部署。

关键数字 摘要未给出具体量化数字；核心主张是统一学习权重与结构可同时获得可压缩性与高效推理。

为什么值得看 直面"压缩≠加速"的部署瓶颈，结构化稀疏+低秩联合训练的端侧大模型部署路线。

研究问题 长上下文 LLM 服务的 KV cache 超出 GPU/主机内存后，前缀检索把存储 I/O 推上推理关键路径——节点本地 NVMe 独扛所有检索，已挂载的并行文件系统/云文件存储几乎没有推理流量。

方法 提出 KVStream KV 缓存引擎，把前缀检索建模为跨存储层的聚合带宽调度：批量合并一步内的读、把写延迟到前向之后、每块在各层复制、空闲层自适应认领下一个未读块；性能模型显示该路由无需预测或调优即可达到聚合带宽上界，而任何静态切分都会因层带宽漂移而偏离。

关键数字 接入 LMCache 后在四个模型、六个数据集、最多 128 GPU 上评测，检索与最优方案的差距在 5% 以内（TTFT 增益随负载增长，主机内存或到达顺序保住复用时会消失）。

为什么值得看 给出多级存储下 KV 缓存检索的自适应调度方案，长上下文推理系统可参考。

item.title: Joules-to-GDP: How Much Economic Value Do AI Systems Produce per Unit of Energy?
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-22　分类：论文PDF

An AI system can produce more economically valuable work while delivering less value for the energy it consumes.

An AI system can produce more economically valuable work while delivering less value for the energy it consumes. We therefore ask: How much economic value does an AI system create per unit of energy consumed? We formalize economic value in two ways: (1) net dollar value, the output's dollar value minus AI-system execution cost, and (2) time saving, the expert's completion time minus the AI system's completion time. Dividing each by measured end-to-end energy yields Net Value per Joule (NVJ) and Time Saving per Joule (TSJ), reported in USD/MJ and hours/MJ. We study 220 public GDPval tasks across 44 occupations, serving five open-weight models locally and evaluating four accelerator types. First, the occupation groups where AI systems succeed most often, deliver the greatest dollar value, or save the most time do not necessarily provide the greatest economic return per joule. For example, among the tested tasks, engineering work delivers about 10% more net dollar value per task than software development. Yet software development delivers about 27% more net value per joule. Second, GLM 5.2 delivers the highest average net dollar value, at $72.27 per task using 0.430 MJ, equivalent in …

item.title: Is spectral predictability enough? Testing Ω-matching for synthetic pretraining under distribution shift
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-22　分类：论文PDF

Synthetic pretraining under distribution shift requires deciding what synthetic data to use.

Synthetic pretraining under distribution shift requires deciding what synthetic data to use. A natural criterion is to match the spectral predictability $Ω$ of the source to the target, but is $Ω$ sufficient? We test this hypothesis, which we call predictability-aware pretraining, across three architectures (LSTM, PatchTST, TCN) and three seeds. Under ideal synthetic-to-synthetic conditions, $Ω$-matched pretraining can outperform even an oracle baseline (+46.8% MSE reduction, LSTM), though the benefit is already architecture-dependent. On the real-world ETTm1 benchmark, however, this relationship does not hold: sine-plus-noise pretraining at matched $Ω$ yields only a marginal mean improvement +2.3% averaged over all three architectures, up to +65.5% on individual channels), whereas $Ω$ matched chaotic ODE trajectories systematically degrade performance -13.2%). The two sources agree on the direction of transfer for only 53% of configurations across all three architectures (Pearson r=-0.02), indicating that $Ω$ carries little information about which source will transfer beneficially. item.title: Is High Local Accuracy Enough? Geometric Consensus with Support-Adaptive Statistical Personalization for Federated Learning
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-22　分类：论文PDF

Real-world deployment of personalized federated learning (PFL) requires adapting to heterogeneous clients while preserving recognition performance beyond local distributions.

Real-world deployment of personalized federated learning (PFL) requires adapting to heterogeneous clients while preserving recognition performance beyond local distributions. However, high local accuracy can conceal failures on locally rare or absent classes. Effective personalization should therefore strengthen global recognition while raising the personalization floor. We propose an evaluation protocol that complements local accuracy with global, rare-class, and unseen-class evaluations to reveal generalization obscured by local scores, and assesses personalization floors among the worst-performing clients to expose weaknesses hidden by aggregate performance. To meet these deployment challenges, we propose FedGRC, a unified PFL framework integrating generalization and personalization through (i) Consensus-Guided Representation Learning (CGRL), which learns discriminative representations through shared directional and magnitude guidance; (ii) Multilayer Metric Synthesis (MMS), which constructs a shared covariance metric from these multilayer representations for statistical classification; and (iii) Support-Adaptive Shrinkage Personalization (SASP), which adapts class means within …

item.title: Harmful Responses Are Jailbreak Templates: Transferring Autoregressive Jailbreaks to Diffusion Language Models
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-22　分类：论文PDF

Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) enable flexible masked generation through bidirectional context modeling, but this capability also introduces a distinct jailbreak attack surface.

Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) enable flexible masked generation through bidirectional context modeling, but this capability also introduces a distinct jailbreak attack surface. We find that a harmful response to a given query naturally serves as an effective jailbreak template: simply masking a subset of its tokens can induce a dLLM to reconstruct harmful content. Based on this observation, we propose RMT-Jailbreak, a general framework that transfers existing autoregressive (AR) jailbreak attacks to dLLMs through their induced harmful responses. RMT-Jailbreak converts an AR-generated harmful response into a high-mask-ratio template using uniform token retention, and further applies prompt-based safety filtering to mask any remaining visible harmful content. The refined template is then provided to the target dLLM for bidirectional reconstruction. Extensive experiments across multiple AR jailbreak methods and target dLLMs demonstrate the effectiveness and generality of RMT-Jailbreak, revealing strong cross-paradigm transferability of jailbreak attacks.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: HDLouvain: High-Throughput Incremental Clustering for Hyperdimensional Data
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-22　分类：论文PDF

Modern shotgun proteomics generates tens of thousands of tandem mass spectra per hour, producing hundreds of gigabytes of data that strain conventional clustering pipelines.

Modern shotgun proteomics generates tens of thousands of tandem mass spectra per hour, producing hundreds of gigabytes of data that strain conventional clustering pipelines. DBSCAN and hierarchical agglomerative clustering (HAC) offer flexible similarity search, but DBSCAN is unstable across varying data densities, HAC costs $O(n^2)$, and both yield poor cluster quality. Graph-based methods such as Louvain produce high-quality clusters but scale poorly on streaming data. We observe that Louvain's poor scalability can be resolved without sacrificing its quality, and present HDLouvain, which combines Louvain community detection with the bit-parallel similarity computation of hyperdimensional computing (HDC). HDLouvain partitions a bootstrap fraction of the stream into precursor-mass buckets, applies Louvain to each bucket's kNN similarity graph, and condenses each community into a single binary hypervector by bitwise-majority bundling rather than iterative centroid recomputation. New spectra are assigned by a GPU-accelerated Hamming distance lookup against representatives in their mass bucket, or seed a new cluster when no match meets a similarity threshold $τ$, so the partition grow…

item.title: Ground-Truth-First Benchmarking of Reinforcement Learning via Converse Optimality: From Smooth, Fully Observed Systems to Non-Smooth or Partially Observed Tasks
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-22　分类：论文PDF

Benchmarking in reinforcement learning is usually relative: algorithms are ranked by returns on environments with unknown optima.

Benchmarking in reinforcement learning is usually relative: algorithms are ranked by returns on environments with unknown optima. Distance to optimality remains unobservable, while conclusions may depend on reward design, stochasticity, hyperparameters, environment selection, and simulator details. We develop a ground-truth-first framework based on converse optimality, constructing each task with a certified optimal value function and policy withheld from learners and used only for evaluation. The framework unifies two modes: sensitivity benchmarking samples certified environments from continuous-time generators to assess robustness to task variation, while oracle-referenced comparison uses native discrete-time generators to evaluate policies via optimality gap, regret, and policy error. Continuous-time models support physically interpretable sensitivity studies but introduce dependence on the simulator step ($Δt$) and numerical scheme. Native discrete-time models align the environment, oracle, and learner on the same transition law, eliminating external integration choices as a confounder. We reproduce quantitative results covering optimizer sensitivity and oracle-referenced compa…

item.title: Gandalf: Flash Shall Not Die! Increasing Flash Storage Lifetime for KV Cache Offloading in LLM Serving
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-22　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 LLM 服务用 SSD 扩展 KV cache 容量，但多轮对话与 agent 等生产负载的 KV 写入总量远超 SSD 容量，寿命从数年缩短到数月。

方法 Gandalf，首个 SSD 寿命感知的 KV offloading 系统：仅按历史访问模式门控写入会伤命中率——不同注意力类型的 KV 可能访问模式相同但未来模式不同；Gandalf 据此优先把 full-attention KV 准入 SSD。

关键数字 平均延长 SSD 寿命 7.3×，缓存命中率影响可忽略；设计可扩展到 High Bandwidth Flash 等闪存。

为什么值得看 把应用层注意力类型纳入 KV offload 决策，直面生产级闪存磨损这一真实成本问题。

item.title: GIFT: Gradient Informed Filtering for Distillation Augmented Reasoning RL
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-22　分类：论文PDF

Training large language models for complex reasoning tasks relies on two complementary signals: sparse, outcome-grounded reinforcement learning (RL) for correctness, and dense, token-level distillation for guidance.

Training large language models for complex reasoning tasks relies on two complementary signals: sparse, outcome-grounded reinforcement learning (RL) for correctness, and dense, token-level distillation for guidance. However, complementarity in supervision does not guarantee compatibility in optimization; imitation-focused distillation can conflict with the outcome-driven RL objective, and existing hybrids lack a principled resolution. We propose \textbf{GIFT} (\textbf{G}radient-\textbf{I}nformed \textbf{F}il\textbf{T}ering for Distillation-Augmented Reasoning RL), a novel method that directly addresses the allocation problem of which teacher updates to apply. GIFT performs a token-level geometric analysis, decomposing the distillation gradient into a component \textbf{parallel} to the RL gradient, which measures first-order conflict and provides a \textbf{safety} filter, and a component \textbf{orthogonal} to it, which quantifies novel directional guidance and provides a measure of \textbf{value}. This decomposition yields a principled scoring rule to rank token-level guidance. We combine this with a progressive \textbf{coverage annealing} schedule that shrinks the budget of tokens…

item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-22　分类：论文PDF

Graph Retrieval-Augmented Generation (GraphRAG) leverages centralized knowledge graphs to enhance large language models with structured knowledge retrieval.

Graph Retrieval-Augmented Generation (GraphRAG) leverages centralized knowledge graphs to enhance large language models with structured knowledge retrieval. However, real-world knowledge is inherently distributed across multiple organizations rather than being centrally accessible. Privacy constraints further prohibit sharing entire local knowledge graphs, preventing GraphRAG from effectively retrieving and utilizing distributed knowledge. To this end, we propose Federated GraphRAG (FedGRAG), a unified framework for distributed graph retrieval and knowledge-enhanced generation over multiple clients with knowledge graphs. Specifically, we address two fundamental challenges in federated GraphRAG. First, the absence of a global knowledge graph makes unified retrieval impossible. To address this, we develop a Federated Knowledge Routing mechanism that efficiently identifies relevant clients through lightweight knowledge indices without exposing local graph structures. Second, local graph memory cannot be shared directly because it contains sensitive entities and knowledge information. We therefore propose a controlled-disclosure evidence construction method. item.title: Federated Differentially Private Optimization via Low-Rank Preconditioning
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-22　分类：论文PDF

We consider differentially private (DP) optimization in the federated setting, where a DP estimate of the feature covariance matrix serves as a Hessian approximation for generalized linear models.

We consider differentially private (DP) optimization in the federated setting, where a DP estimate of the feature covariance matrix serves as a Hessian approximation for generalized linear models. Existing central DP methods for covariance estimation have communication cost that grows quadratically in the data dimension, while existing baselines with linear communication cost are only locally private and degrade as the number of clients increases. As a remedy, we propose a federated DP-PCA framework that achieves linear communication cost while providing central DP guarantees under secure aggregation. It consists of a DP rank selection step, a DP power method, and a noisy release of the covariance projected onto the selected low-dimensional subspace. We give error bounds for this covariance estimate and for the resulting low-communication preconditioned DP gradient descent. Empirically, our proposed DP optimization method matches a centralized baseline with quadratic communication cost at a fraction of the communication.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

研究问题 Per-Layer Embeddings（PLE）占 Gemma 4 E4B 参数的 35.2%，需要极端压缩；常规量化在如此压缩率下每个 token-层向量只有几字节码字。

方法 OPTIC：每个 token 只存一个量化码元组，每层用层专属仿射解码器解码；码与解码器拟合 PLE 输出路径而非存储向量本身。

关键数字 约 100× PLE 压缩（BF16 E4B）保留 97.8% 聚合性能（最强的产品量化基线仅 66.3%）；594×/1002× 压缩保留 90.5%/84.1%；W4A16 版 100× 压缩保留 96.9%；推理时 GPU 显存少 29.7%，速度最多慢 0.40%。

为什么值得看 把量化范式从"逐 token 逐层各配码字"翻转为"token 共享索引码"，极端压缩率下损失极小。

item.title: Evolving Federated Density Peak Clustering with Shuffler-Based Anonymization
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-22　分类：论文PDF

In this paper, we present a novel one-shot federated clustering approach based on evolving fuzzy clustering and shuffler-based anonymization.

In this paper, we present a novel one-shot federated clustering approach based on evolving fuzzy clustering and shuffler-based anonymization. In federated clustering, each round reveals additional model information to the server and can increase the opportunity to infer properties of local datasets, even when raw samples are never shared. Consequently, fewer client-server exchanges and unlinkability are important, so transmitted information cannot be attributed to any single client. Data-stream clustering algorithms, which learn in a single pass over the data, align well with the one-shot federated learning paradigm, where a single communication round can be sufficient. The proposed Evolving Federated Density Peak Clustering (eFDPC) method combines evolving fuzzy data-stream clustering and density peak clustering in a federated setting. Each client independently evolves micro-clusters from private data mini-batches through cluster addition and merging. To limit communication, density peak clustering is applied to the learned micro-clusters and only the selected peaks are transmitted, rather than the full local models. A shuffler-based layer is introduced between the clients and the…

item.title: Evaluating the Applicability of LLM Inference Optimizations on Apple Silicon
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-22　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 Apple Silicon 是最广泛的本地 LLM 推理平台之一，但几乎所有推理优化都在服务器级 NVIDIA GPU 上设计与验证——哪些优化迁移后仍有效？

方法 评估四类优化（KV cache 剪枝、推测解码、移植 GPU kernel、后训练量化），覆盖 4 台 Apple 机器，并在可比条件下对照 RTX 4090。

关键数字 KV 剪枝在 Apple 上端到端吞吐最高 1.75×，但在桌面 NVIDIA GPU 上反而降吞吐；全部推测解码方法在 Apple 上降吞吐（服务器 GPU 上报 2–6× 增益）；可移植 kernel 组件最高带来 1.20× decode 吞吐。

为什么值得看 结论"加速不是技术本身的便携属性，而是技术×运行时×硬件契约×负载的联合函数"，对端侧优化有直接指导。

item.title: Energy-Aware Performance Characterization of Kokkos Kernels Across Precision Levels
item.description:
发表方：（未标注）　发布：2026-10-22　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 GPU 加速 HPC 应用中，FP32/FP64/混合精度如何影响核的算术强度、吞吐与 GPU 能耗？

方法 对两个应用的 Kokkos 核做精度级刻画：引入能量感知 Roofline 模型把能耗纳入性能分析，提出热感知核间能量模型将能耗与时长、GPU 温度、执行顺序一并可视化；采用 Kokkos Performance Tools PAPI 连接器的应用级细粒度插桩，以及厂商电源管理组件的专用核基准粗粒度 PAPI 插桩两种方式。

关键数字 摘要未给出具体数值；结论是精度影响随应用、核与负载而异——混合 FP32/FP64 核通常达到接近 FP32 的算术强度、吞吐略降、多数情况能耗小幅增加；FP64 核能耗普遍最高。

为什么值得看 把能耗纳入 Roofline 分析框架，为 HPC 精度选型提供可复用的刻画方法论。

item.title: Energy and Latency First: How Deployment Constraints Reverse Time-Series Model Selection
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-22　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 时序模型通常按精度排名，但真实部署存在排名不包含的硬约束——蜂窝网络切换预测要求每 40ms 测量周期内完成推理，且能量是设备寿命级的累计预算。

方法 按尾部而非均值筛选 deadline 可行性，再对可行模型按实测推理能量排序，并计入前向传播前的特征计算成本。

关键数字 梯度提升树 F1=0.974 且运行成本最低；精度基准会排第一的 CNN-1D（F1=0.914）在真实 duty-cycled 部署下每次推理能耗高出 3 倍以上。

为什么值得看 证明精度导向基准不仅低估部署成本，还可能把无法部署的模型排第一；并给出可推广到电信之外的三个条件。

item.title: End-to-End Differentiable Diffusion Conditioning for Physics-Informed Optimization
item.description:
发表方：（未标注）　发布：2026-10-22　分类：论文PDF

Optimizing high-dimensional physical systems under expensive evaluations and complex constraints is a central challenge in science and engineering. In offline model-based optimizat...

Optimizing high-dimensional physical systems under expensive evaluations and complex constraints is a central challenge in science and engineering. In offline model-based optimization (MBO), methods must improve designs using only a fixed dataset and no test-time access to the true objective. However, existing methods typically suffer from conservatism, unconstrained surrogate exploitation, or function as static inference-time samplers that cannot refine candidates against precise physical objectives. In this paper, we propose Differentiable Diffusion Conditioning (D2C) for offline MBO, which leverages the fact that deterministic sampling makes the reverse denoising chain differentiable with respect to the conditioning signal. D2C turns a frozen conditional diffusion model into an end-to-end gradient-based optimizer by directly optimizing conditioning variables at test time via gradients from frozen surrogate objectives and physics-informed penalties backpropagated through the reverse chain. We implement this idea in a composed proposer-evaluator framework and evaluate it on laser pulse optimization for inertial confinement fusion, sustainable data-center workload scheduling, and f…

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Efficient and Optimal Learning of Discrete Distributions with Person-Level Privacy
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-22　分类：论文PDF

We study learning a discrete distribution under person-level differential privacy in the batched setting.

We study learning a discrete distribution under person-level differential privacy in the batched setting. Given $n$ users, each contributing $m$ i.i.d. samples from an unknown distribution $μ$ over $[k]$, we seek an estimate of $μ$ with total-variation error $α$. We give polynomial-time algorithms under both pure and approximate differential privacy. Under pure $(\varepsilon,0)$-DP, we achieve $n = \widetilde O(k/(α^2 m)+k/(α\sqrt{m}\varepsilon)+k/\varepsilon)$, the first polynomial-time pure-DP guarantee matching the information-theoretic optimum up to logarithmic factors. Under approximate $(\varepsilon,δ)$-DP, we achieve $n = \widetilde O(k/(α^2 m)+k/(α\sqrt{m}\varepsilon)+k+\log(1/δ)/\varepsilon)$. At $δ=2^{-Θ(k)}$, this is $\widetilde O(k)$ for fixed $α,\varepsilon,m$ and failure probability. Our algorithms use a new degree-6 sum-of-squares estimator for learning from untrusted batches. Its key ingredient is a trace-bounded diagonal majorizer for the difference between the empirical covariance of the repaired batch averages and the multinomial covariance predicted by their mean. We prove that clean data admit this certificate through semidefinite-programming duality and a new …

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Efficient Omni-modal Large Language Model Inference via Per-Query Modality Selection
item.description:
发表方：（未标注）　发布：2026-10-22　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 Omni 多模态大模型推理成本高，但不同查询对额外模态的收益不一——固定模态配置是否低效？

方法 研究查询级（query-wise）模态选择：保持底层 Omni-LLM 不变，为每个查询自适应选择提供哪些模态；将问题形式化为精度-成本优化，提出成本敏感的学习方法。在 WorldSense 上用 Qwen2.5-Omni 与 Qwen3-Omni 评估三种推理成本口径：输入 token、延迟与货币成本。

关键数字 Qwen2.5-Omni 上成本敏感选择达到或超过全模态精度，输入 token 仅需约 41%。

为什么值得看 不做模型改动、仅按查询裁剪模态即可改善精度-成本权衡，多模态服务降本可借鉴。

item.title: Effectiveness of Curriculum Learning Depends on Reward Sparsity and Competing Optima
item.description:
发表方：（未标注）　发布：2026-10-22　分类：论文PDF

While animals and people tend to learn a task more quickly and reliably when they first train on simpler versions of it, curriculum learning's effectiveness in artificial settings ...

While animals and people tend to learn a task more quickly and reliably when they first train on simpler versions of it, curriculum learning's effectiveness in artificial settings varies, and appears substantially greater in reinforcement learning than in supervised learning. In this work, we construct and analyze a minimal model of policy learning to better understand why. We consider an open-loop, episodic target interception task whose parameters---especially how close the agent must be to the target to receive an informative reward signal---can be chosen so that the agent either receives informative rewards frequently ('dense' rewards) or rarely ('sparse' rewards). We mathematically and numerically analyze the dynamics of REINFORCE-based policy learning in both cases. In the dense reward case, curricula have only marginal benefits; in the sparse case, curricula can be required for learning to occur at all. We find that this is especially true when the agent has the conflicting goals of minimizing effort and accumulating high reward, since this can produce distinct reward landscape optima which compete with one another. Our characterization of useful curricula in this setting in…

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Drift Says When, Budget Says How Much: Rate-Controlled KV Re-selection for Long-Form Multimodal Generation
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-22　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 多模态 LLM 长形式生成中，KV 压缩通常在 prefill 一次性选定视觉 token 并全程复用，但生成过程中模型读取的证据持续移动，one-shot 选择严重受限。

方法 RCR：由漂移决定何时/何处重选，每样本控制器调节重选频率；配合低秩漂移检测器、候选受限重选与 GPU 上决策，单一设置适配所有模型与任务。

关键数字 6 个 model-task 设置中 5 个比逐部检索的 InfiniGen 高 1.6–3.8 ROUGE-L，距精确逐步重选仅差 1.7 分；GPU 驻留检测器小 4×；DetailCaps 上漂移定时比随机定时高 2.0–5.0 分。

为什么值得看 指出"固定漂移阈值"系统性失效并给出按样本预算调控的可迁移方案。

item.title: Diffusion Language Models for Perplexity-Aware Black-Box Attacks
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-22　分类：论文PDF

\emph{Continuous-space} attacks find prompts that trigger malicious behaviors, such as overthinking, in black-box LLMs by sampling or optimizing over a low-dimensional Gaussian latent space and decodi

\emph{Continuous-space} attacks find prompts that trigger malicious behaviors, such as overthinking, in black-box LLMs by sampling or optimizing over a low-dimensional Gaussian latent space and decoding it to text through a \emph{random mapping} and nearest-token lookup. Because the random mapping is not learned from language, its prompts can be highly unnatural, and as such easily detectable through input guardrails, and the risk estimates they yield are not grounded in natural prompts. We find that character-level perplexity drops from $10^3$--$10^7$ to 3--5 in RareTrap and from 20--28 to 4.3--5.4 in ThinkTrap. item.title: Decode Late, Multiply Once: Rethinking the Dot Product for Quantized Weights
item.description:
发表方：（未标注）　发布：2026-10-22　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 1-4 bit 量化权重的神经网络推理中，点积仍按每元素一次乘法计算——能否把乘加（MAC）大幅压缩？

方法 提出"延迟解码、一次相乘"重构：长度为 n 的点积只需 n+2^k 次加法、至多 2^k 次解码与 2^k 次乘法；每个权重码直接作为地址偏移选择 2^k 个累加器之一，累加结果最后统一做融合的解码-相乘，解码后的权重向量从不显式成形。对整数算术精确成立，支持整数/浮点操作数与非线性解码器，可扩展到分组缩放与矩阵/张量积；配套设计 SA-PE 处理单元替换脉动阵列中的 MAC。

关键数字 乘法次数降为原来的 n/2^k 分之一；总算术能耗改善受成本模型量化的有界因子约束。

为什么值得看 从算法层面重构量化点积的运算结构，对低比特推理硬件设计有直接参考价值。

item.title: Cost-Aware Abstention for LLM-Based IT Ticket Classification
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-22　分类：论文PDF

Wrong automatic routing of an IT support ticket can cost more than human triage.

Wrong automatic routing of an IT support ticket can cost more than human triage. We evaluate cost-aware abstention as an offline, cost-conditional readiness assessment: select a routing policy on calibration data under explicit costs, then evaluate that frozen policy once on held-out test data. On a public 47,837-ticket, eight-class corpus, we compare four trained non-LLM classifiers with four large language models under zero- and few-shot prompting. Under the illustrative cost model (c_ok, c_triage, c_wrong) = (0, 1, 5), TF-IDF with logistic regression and a threshold of 0.60 selected on calibration reduces test cost from 0.763 to 0.472, a 38.1% relative reduction (paired ratio-bootstrap 95% CI [35.7%, 40.4%]), while lowering wrong routes from 15.3% to 3.5%. Frozen calibration-selected policies also beat both always-route and always-defer on held-out test data in 14 of 16 settings in a post-hoc cost-parameter analysis. The strongest prompted configuration reaches 0.477 accuracy on a stratified 1,000-ticket test subset, versus 0.879 for fine-tuned DistilBERT on the same tickets. Isotonic lowers expected calibration error without reliably improving discrimination: GPT-4o-mini few-sh…

item.title: ConsMSA: Semantic Distribution Consistency Learning for Multimodal Sentiment Analysis
item.description:
发表方：（未标注）　发布：2026-10-22　分类：论文PDF

Multimodal sentiment analysis (MSA) aims to predict human sentiments by integrating signals from different modalities such as text, video, and audio. However, raw multimodal sequen...

Multimodal sentiment analysis (MSA) aims to predict human sentiments by integrating signals from different modalities such as text, video, and audio. However, raw multimodal sequences often suffer from semantic inconsistency--exhibiting redundancy or conflicts within and across modalities--which hinders robust understanding and increases computational cost. To this end, we introduce ConsMSA, which explicitly formalizes semantic distribution consistency across both $\textit{intra}$- and $\textit{inter}$-modality, providing a consistency-aware mechanism for robust and efficient multimodal sentiment prediction. Specifically, ConsMSA projects multimodal token features into a shared sentiment space to compute an Intra- and Inter-modality Consistency Score ($I^2CS$). By coupling this score with predictive relevance, we formulate consistency-aware importance signals that are utilized: (i) as a consistency regularizer to align latent distributions during training, (ii) to derive semantic-aware weights for adaptive multimodal token reweighting, and (iii) as a practical criterion to prune redundant or conflicting tokens. item.title: Causal Chain of Thought: Mitigating Attention Leakage via Context Isolation
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-22　分类：论文PDF

Chain-of-thought (CoT) prompting elicits step-by-step rationales that appear to explain model predictions, but there is no guarantee these steps causally drive the final answer.

Chain-of-thought (CoT) prompting elicits step-by-step rationales that appear to explain model predictions, but there is no guarantee these steps causally drive the final answer. In standard autoregressive generation, dense attention allows each reasoning step to attend to the full context, enabling the model to derive answers through direct lookup while generating plausible-sounding but post-hoc justifications. We introduce CausalCoT, an inference framework that enforces causal transparency by decomposing problems into a directed acyclic graph of atomic sub-questions, evaluating each node in an isolated context containing only its direct causal parents. This Markovian structure removes attention pathways to non-parent content, making downstream predictions sensitive to local reasoning rather than global context leakage. Across a diverse suite of reasoning benchmarks, CausalCoT preserves competitive predictive performance while improving explanation faithfulness, increasing causal sensitivity of intermediate reasoning steps by an average of 12 and up to 21 percentage points over the strongest baseline. The structured dependency graph additionally enables test-time interventions in w…

item.title: CRANE: Post-Hoc Counterfactual Retrieval for Multimodal Classifiers
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-22　分类：论文PDF

Counterfactual explanation methods have been introduced for unimodal settings, with dedicated frameworks for tabular, timeseries, text, and image data, yet no post-hoc method has been designed for classifiers that learn from multimodal inputs.

Counterfactual explanation methods have been introduced for unimodal settings, with dedicated frameworks for tabular, timeseries, text, and image data, yet no post-hoc method has been designed for classifiers that learn from multimodal inputs. Existing explainability methods for multimodal classifiers apply modality-specific attribution independently to each input, which fails to yield coherent explanations and does not transfer to arbitrary pre-trained multimodal architectures. To address these shortcomings, we present CRANE (Counterfactual Retrieval via Agnostic Nearest-neighbour Explanations), the first post-hoc, model-agnostic framework for nearest-neighbour multimodal counterfactual generation that retrieves real training examples from the target class as candidate explanations, ensuring plausibility by construction. Across four heterogeneous datasets and three fusion strategies, we show that Multimodal Consensus Retrieval (MC-R), which intersects per-modality neighbour sets to identify instances jointly close to the query in every modality, emerges as the strongest multimodal strategy, achieving the best or joint-best outcome on three of four datasets while grounding every ex…

item.title: Bridging the Data Gap: Source-Informed Task-Space Transport for Few-Shot Diffusion
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-22　分类：论文PDF

Many deployments require a model to move rapidly from a data-rich source to a related target observed only sparsely.

Many deployments require a model to move rapidly from a data-rich source to a related target observed only sparsely. This is especially consequential where target data are difficult to collect, as in healthcare settings with persistent population or acquisition imbalances. Retraining or fine-tuning a high-capacity generator for every target is costly and can be statistically unreliable when target data are scarce. We introduce Meta-Diff, which instead learns a recurring source--target relation once in a compact task space. A shared encoder maps each distribution to a low-dimensional coordinate; a learned relation transports a new source coordinate to its predicted target, and a shared diffusion backbone generates from that prediction without target-specific retraining. Controlled Gaussian-mixture experiments identify when this works: task identity must survive the representation, the relation must generalise across tasks, and the source--target shift must leave useful headroom for transport. On held-out CIFAR-100 validation tasks, correct source $+$ transport achieves 13.9% lower mean SW than transport from the wrong source. With validation-selected adaptation settings in the final…

item.title: Beyond Local Accuracy: Benchmarking the Rollout Reliability of PDE Foundation Models
item.description:
发表方：（未标注）　发布：2026-10-22　分类：论文PDF

PDE foundation models enable data-efficient adaptation but are deployed autoregressively, so short-horizon accuracy need not imply reliable simulation. We ask whether the short-hor...

PDE foundation models enable data-efficient adaptation but are deployed autoregressively, so short-horizon accuracy need not imply reliable simulation. We ask whether the short-horizon advantage of a foundation-model recipe persists when its predictions are repeatedly fed back as inputs for a long horizon. We define error amplification as G=E(H_f)/E(H_s), which measures full-horizon error relative to short-horizon error. We evaluate seven models on seven two-dimensional time-dependent PDE datasets: scratch-trained FNO and DeepONet; fine-tuned DPOT, GPhyT, Poseidon, and Walrus; and frozen in-context VICON. We report VRMSE, relative L_2, and relative MAE. Six datasets provide paired short- and full-horizon scores, while CE-RM contributes short-rollout sweeps only. At least one fine-tuned foundation model outperforms both scratch baselines in 26 of 30 short-rollout dataset--budget cells under every metric. Nevertheless, full-horizon VRMSE exceeds short-horizon VRMSE in 140 of 144 paired trained configurations, with a median error amplification of $2.04$. item.title: Benchmarks Are Surprisingly Compaction-Friendly
item.description:
发表方：（未标注）　发布：2026-10-22　分类：论文PDF

Long horizon agentic tasks are now pushing LLM agents past their context window. To continue the task, the agent scaffold has to free up the context window, a process known as cont...

Long horizon agentic tasks are now pushing LLM agents past their context window. To continue the task, the agent scaffold has to free up the context window, a process known as context compaction. Compaction is generally lossy by design: agents can silently lose task constraints, instructions, or their reasoning behind earlier decisions. Although compaction is a standard component of coding agent scaffolds, it has not been studied systematically with frontier models on realistic, long horizon agentic tasks. Previous work evaluate smaller open weight models on toy or synthetic trajectories. We fix the agent scaffold (OpenCode), implement five compaction strategies inside it, and evaluate three frontier models on three long horizon benchmarks (PaperBench, ProgramBench, PostTrainBench). For the two 1M context models, the compaction threshold does not measurably affect the task performance, whereas GPT-5.3-Codex, the model with the smallest context window, performs worse at lower thresholds on PaperBench and, less clearly, on PostTrainBench. No compaction method outperforms default self-summarization, and methods that discard more content cost some models up to 20 points while leaving o…

item.title: BeNice! Closing Looping's Inference-Memory Gap via KV-Sharing
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-22　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 循环架构推理时每次循环生成独立 KV cache，显存线性增长；既有 KV-sharing 方案可行但机制不明，同配置训练的模型也未必具备该性质。

方法 两阶段方案：预训练阶段用 stochastic depth 诱导收缩残差动力学，使表示跨循环趋于共同极限；后训练阶段 BeNice! 把最终循环的 KV cache 广播到首个循环，训练其产生兼容残差并保持原质量。

关键数字 模拟低显存长上下文推理中，cache 命中率最高提升 31.4%、吞吐最高 23.6%、p90 TTFT 最高降低 83.6%；可与 MLA、低精度 KV 量化等方法组合使用。

为什么值得看 首次系统理解并主动"开启"循环模型的 KV-shareability，且与既有压缩手段正交可叠加。

item.title: Autoregressive Multimodal Anomaly Detection with Large Language Models for Microservice Systems
item.description:
发表方：（未标注）　发布：2026-10-22　分类：论文PDF

Microservice systems have become a dominant architecture for large-scale cloud applications, enabling rapid deployment and elastic scaling. However, ensuring the reliability and av...

Microservice systems have become a dominant architecture for large-scale cloud applications, enabling rapid deployment and elastic scaling. However, ensuring the reliability and availability of microservice systems critically relies on effective anomaly detection, as failures and performance anomalies can quickly propagate across services and severely impact end-to-end system behavior. Existing multimodal anomaly detection approaches for microservice systems often struggle with two fundamental limitations: (i) the neglect of modality-specific characteristics in favor of cross-modality fusion, and (ii) the "identity-shortcut" problem that affects the feature reconstruction process. To address these issues, we propose LLMMAD, an autoregressive multimodal anomaly detection framework for microservice systems based on Large Language Models (LLMs). Initially, to reconcile cross-modality fusion with modality-specific preservation, LLMMAD embeds and recombines multimodal data into a unified sequence for LLM processing to model inter-modality relationships, while employing modality-wise reconstruction heads to retain modality-specific information. Subsequently, to eliminate the identity-sho…

Microservice systems have become a dominant architecture for large-scale cloud applications, enabling rapid deployment and elastic scaling. However, ensuring the reliability and av...

Microservice systems have become a dominant architecture for large-scale cloud applications, enabling rapid deployment and elastic scaling. However, ensuring the reliability and availability of microservice systems critically relies on effective anomaly detection, as failures and performance anomalies can quickly propagate across services and severely impact end-to-end system behavior. Existing multimodal anomaly detection approaches for microservice systems often struggle with two fundamental limitations: (i) the neglect of modality-specific characteristics in favor of cross-modality fusion, and (ii) the "identity-shortcut" problem that affects the feature reconstruction process. To address these issues, we propose LLMMAD, an autoregressive multimodal anomaly detection framework for microservice systems based on Large Language Models (LLMs). Initially, to reconcile cross-modality fusion with modality-specific preservation, LLMMAD embeds and recombines multimodal data into a unified sequence for LLM processing to model inter-modality relationships, while employing modality-wise reconstruction heads to retain modality-specific information. Subsequently, to eliminate the identity-sho…

item.title: Almost tight distributed approximation for domination in sparse graph classes
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-22　分类：论文PDF

We study distributed approximation of Minimum Dominating Set in a very general class of sparse graphs, extending near-optimal approximation results from the minor-free setting to bounded expansion.

We study distributed approximation of Minimum Dominating Set in a very general class of sparse graphs, extending near-optimal approximation results from the minor-free setting to bounded expansion. In more detail, for fixed $d$ and $\varepsilon>0$, we give a new deterministic constant-round LOCAL algorithm for Minimum Dominating Set on graphs of maximum average degree at most $d$ and bounded depth-one shallow-minor density. Its approximation ratio is $d+1+\varepsilon$, which is optimal up to $\varepsilon$ for every even integer $d\geq 2$. This improves on the recent results of Amiri and Siebertz by extending beyond proper minor-closed classes. From this algorithm, we derive almost-tight constant-round approximations for a number of graph classes. We get $(7+\varepsilon)$-approximations for planar graphs and graphs of bounded Euler genus, and $(5+\varepsilon)$-approximations for their triangle-free subclasses. This answers the $7+\varepsilon$ question of Wawrzyniak positively, and matches the recent results of Amiri and Siebertz. We also apply our algorithm to classes of bounded queue-number or stack-number, obtaining bounds that are tight up to $\varepsilon$. Additionally, we answe…

item.title: Aligning Large Language Models with Human Feedback: Mathematical Foundations and Algorithm Design
item.description:
发表方：（未标注）　发布：2026-10-22　分类：论文PDF

This article provides an introduction to the mathematical foundations and algorithmic frameworks used to align Large Language Models (LLMs) with human intentions, preferences, and ...

This article provides an introduction to the mathematical foundations and algorithmic frameworks used to align Large Language Models (LLMs) with human intentions, preferences, and values. We discuss standard alignment techniques, such as fine-tuning (SFT), reinforcement learning with human feedback (RLHF), and direct preference optimization (DPO). We also explore the theoretical underpinnings of learning from human preferences, drawing connections to inverse reinforcement learning (IRL) and discrete choice models. We present state-of-the-art algorithms in a tutorial style, discuss their advantages and limitations, and offer insights into practical implementation. Our exposition is intended to serve as a comprehensive resource for researchers and practitioners, providing both a foundational understanding of alignment methodologies and a framework for developing more robust and scalable alignment techniques.

item.title: Agreement rather than normalisation keeps depth reusable in looped language models
item.description:
发表方：（未标注）　发布：2026-10-22　分类：论文PDF

Looped language models apply one block of layers repeatedly, and the design pays off only if depth is reusable: loop steps beyond the trained budget must remain usable at inference...

Looped language models apply one block of layers repeatedly, and the design pays off only if depth is reusable: loop steps beyond the trained budget must remain usable at inference. We ask whether that rests on normalising the state between loop steps, as the released Ouro models do, or on agreement between the loop a model is trained with and the loop it is run with. On released weights this loop-boundary normalisation can be removed without adding parameters and with the readout path bit-identical, and the operation is an identity at one loop step, which serves as an implementation check. Removing it takes Ouro-1.4B and Ouro-2.6B to zero accuracy by the trained budget on a balanced binary task (chance 0.500). State-norm growth, the failure that prior accounts predict, is not the cause: the norm stays within a factor of 2.021 while the head commits to a single wrong token. Yet in 19M-parameter models trained from scratch on two synthetic tasks, 16 seeds per configuration, training without the normalisation is never worse than training with it and extrapolates better: the two are closest at the trained depth and separate on both sides of it (Cliff's delta up to 0.867 beyond the bud…

item.title: Adaptive Deadline- and Energy-Aware Caching Algorithms in Dynamic Multi-UAV Edge Networks
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-22　分类：论文PDF

Content caching via unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) becomes one of the solutions to maintain content delivery when terrestrial infrastructure is unavailable or disrupted.

Content caching via unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) becomes one of the solutions to maintain content delivery when terrestrial infrastructure is unavailable or disrupted. However, existing caching approaches often focus primarily on cache-hit performance or average delivery delay, without jointly addressing spatially heterogeneous and time-varying demand, content-specific deadlines, and uneven communication-energy consumption across UAVs. To address these challenges, we formulate a dynamic deadline- and energy-aware cache placement and replacement problem that jointly considers deadline misses, UAV-side communication energy, and inter-UAV energy imbalance. To achieve this, we first develop deadline- and energy-aware UBAC (DE-UBAC), an interpretable hierarchical rule-based realization that incorporates deadline-aware prioritization, cooperative placement, energy-aware coordination, and cache-update cost. However, predefined priorities and thresholds limit its adaptability under dynamically coupled network conditions. item.title: A Computationally Efficient and Rate-Optimal Algorithm for Adversarial Linear MDPs with (Aggregate) Bandit Feedback
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-22　分类：论文PDF

We study episodic linear Markov decision processes with unknown transitions, adversarial losses, and bandit feedback.

We study episodic linear Markov decision processes with unknown transitions, adversarial losses, and bandit feedback. The state-of-the-art result for this setting (Liu et al., 2024) either achieves $\sqrt{K}$ regret with a computationally inefficient algorithm or achieves suboptimal $K^{3/4}$ regret, where $K$ is the number of episodes. Our work gives the first $\sqrt{K}$ regret with a polynomial-time algorithm. Our method reduces adversarial linear MDPs to adversarial linear bandits whose action set consists of policies' expected feature vectors. The central challenge is that this action set is unknown and can be estimated only through exploration. We address this challenge by constructing an approximate separation oracle for the action set that either generates executable policies from queried features, or refines an outer approximation of the action set. This approach draws inspiration from the reduction of van Erven et al. (2025) for linear contextual bandits and the oracle-efficient linear bandit algorithm of Ito et al. (2019), but additionally deals with the imprecision of the oracle. The resulting algorithm requires only aggregate loss feedback, and to our knowledge. This is…

item.title: Your Benchmark Is an Empirical Measure Over Difficulty
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-21　分类：论文PDF

A benchmark is not merely a collection of test questions; it naturally induces an empirical measure over difficulty.

A benchmark is not merely a collection of test questions; it naturally induces an empirical measure over difficulty. In this work, we develop this measure-based view of benchmark evaluation. This perspective allows us to identify and formalize two central failure modes: measure mismatch, where the benchmark difficulty distribution differs from the intended difficulty distribution, and coverage gaps, where uncovered regions along the difficulty axis prevent benchmarks from detecting meaningful localized training progress. We propose two diagnostic metrics that capture these two failure modes and provide rigorous theoretical guarantees. Empirically, we analyze 25 popular benchmarks spanning 7 domains using carefully estimated item difficulties. Our results show that many benchmarks implicitly overweight certain difficulty regions, so their leaderboard conclusions should be interpreted with caution; others leave substantial portions of the difficulty axis uncovered, limiting their ability to monitor the model improvement process. Finally, we turn diagnosis into action by introducing BenchFill, a simple difficulty-targeted item rewriting algorithm that effectively reduces local coverag…

item.title: YingLan: A Multimodal Ocean Foundation Model for Unified Representation Learning from Heterogeneous Observations
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-21　分类：论文PDF

Multimodal ocean modeling remains challenging due to substantial heterogeneity in data structures, physical semantics, and spatiotemporal characteristics across satellite imagery, gridded oceanographic fields, and buoy observations.

Multimodal ocean modeling remains challenging due to substantial heterogeneity in data structures, physical semantics, and spatiotemporal characteristics across satellite imagery, gridded oceanographic fields, and buoy observations. Existing approaches largely focus on task-specific ocean modeling, while learning transferable representations from heterogeneous observations remains an open problem. To address this challenge, we propose YingLan, a multimodal ocean foundation model that integrates physics-attribute-conditioned dynamic encoding, Spatiotemporal Increment Coupling (STIC), and ocean-state evolution-aware pretraining. Specifically, the dynamic encoding mechanism generates adaptive input projections conditioned on physical semantics and observation characteristics, enabling flexible representation of heterogeneous ocean variables. STIC models multiscale spatiotemporal dependencies through cross-scale interactions of latent temporal increments. The pretraining strategy further combines masked observation reconstruction with temporal evolution objectives to facilitate the learning of coherent ocean-state representations across different prediction horizons. item.description:

Learned representations of high-dimensional multimodal health records are increasingly used to adjust for confounding, yet they are usually trained to reconstruct the data rather than preserve the information that causal identification requires.

Learned representations of high-dimensional multimodal health records are increasingly used to adjust for confounding, yet they are usually trained to reconstruct the data rather than preserve the information that causal identification requires. We study counterfactual outcomes under alternative treatments, including phenotype-specific effects and patient-level counterfactual risk profiles of the kind digital twins provide, and interventional direct and indirect effects under exposure-induced intermediate confounding. We give conditions under which a representation preserves identification and show that interventional mediation is more demanding than counterfactual comparison. We prove that no covariate-only training objective, whether reconstruction, contrastive, or physics-informed, can certify that a representation is sufficient, and that, in a linear structural model, a representation can lose arbitrarily little reconstruction accuracy yet induce arbitrarily large bias. item.title: WRDO: Weighted Refusal Direction Optimization in Aligned Language Models
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-21　分类：论文PDF

Aligned large language models are trained to comply with benign requests while refusing harmful ones.

Aligned large language models are trained to comply with benign requests while refusing harmful ones. However, recent work shows that this refusal behavior is fragile and can often be disrupted by simple activation- or weight-space interventions. In particular, refusal has been shown to be largely mediated by a single residual-stream direction, typically computed as a difference-of-means vector between harmful and harmless prompts. However, this standard construction aggregates heterogeneous harmful prompts into one uniform average, potentially conflating distinct refusal-related phenomena. In this work, we study whether refusal interventions can be strengthened by learning how to combine prompt-specific refusal directions. We propose Weighted Refusal Direction Optimization (WRDO), a procedure that constructs a composite refusal direction from a bank of per-prompt directions using learned aggregation weights. This approach allows different harmful prompts to contribute unequally to the final intervention direction. We evaluate WRDO against prior single-direction methods on three open-weight language models using three guard judges and HarmBench as an external evaluator. We further …

item.title: Verified DRAM Address Mapping Reverse Engineering with Threshold Sweep
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-21　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 嵌入式 LPDDR5 系统上如何求解并验证 DRAM 地址映射函数？

方法 端到端软件流水线：由地址对延迟数据构建直方图，阈值扫描获得候选同 bank 地址对；对每个阈值用 Knock-Knock 式线性约束求解器恢复 bank 掩码，GF(2) 行简化阶梯形计算最终掩码；再经组验证与单函数验证两级校验，系统性记录每个候选阈值的求解结果与验证指标。

关键数字 在 ARM 嵌入式平台上完成实例化，支持更稳健的 bank 掩码选择；未给出具体加速数字。

为什么值得看 可复现的"求解+验证"闭环，为 Rowhammer 分析等内存安全研究提供可靠逆向基础。

item.title: Value-Rectified Distillation for Flow-based Offline Reinforcement Learning
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-21　分类：论文PDF

We aim to address the problem of Out-of-Distribution (OOD) Mode Averaging, a critical problem that emerges when distilling Flow Matching (FM) based behavior policies in offline Reinforcement Learning

We aim to address the problem of Out-of-Distribution (OOD) Mode Averaging, a critical problem that emerges when distilling Flow Matching (FM) based behavior policies in offline Reinforcement Learning (RL): When learning over multi-modal datasets, standard distillation inadvertently forces the policy to interpolate across different behavioral modes, causing the generated actions to collapse into invalid, OOD regions. To resolve this, we propose Value-Rectified Distillation (VRD), a novel framework that reformulates offline policy distillation as a value-guided generative trajectory alignment problem. By employing a dynamic coupling mechanism, VRD actively rectifies flow dynamics to explicitly decouple distinct behavioral modes, cleanly isolating high-value actions. Specifically, we instantiate VRD through two complementary algorithms: VRD-Q, which utilizes value-quantile behavior distillation to statistically filter out low-value behaviors, and VRD-R, which reorganizes the latent space to geometrically isolate high-value generative trajectories from the FM-based behavior policy. Extensive empirical evaluations demonstrate that VRD improves existing generative baselines across divers…

研究问题 长上下文使 LLM 推理中 KV cache 内存成本大增；稀疏注意力虽降低计算与内存流量，但保留的 KV cache 必须在后续解码步骤持续可用，管理复杂。

方法 UlaCache 围绕统一逻辑地址空间构建：跨越 GPU KV 池与可选 CPU 内存，稳定逻辑引用让分配与物理放置解耦；统一分配与稀疏访问接口支持数据并行（DP）与张量并行（TP）attention；启用 CPU 存储时用 Parallel Bucketed LRU（PB-LRU）并行管理共享 GPU 池。

关键数字 匹配 CPU/GPU 内存预算+推测解码下，H200 峰值解码吞吐较最先进基线 DP 1.16x/TP 1.70x，B300 上 DP 1.73x/TP 2.51x。

为什么值得看 稀疏注意力 serving 的 KV 管理基础设施，逻辑寻址思路简洁，DP/TP 双支持覆盖主流部署。

item.title: The End of Consensus Research?
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-21　分类：论文PDF

Consensus is a fundamental problem in distributed computing and at the core of state machine replication (SMR).

Consensus is a fundamental problem in distributed computing and at the core of state machine replication (SMR). Despite decades of active human research, discovering practical low-latency solutions to the problem is still open, as it requires combining protocol knowledge, correctness reasoning, implementation, and experimental evaluation. We report on how AI helped us discover A-greement, a new consensus protocol for geo-replicated state machines that significantly outperforms state-of-the-art solutions. Averaged across six deployments with 5 or 9 replicas, A-greement reduces the mean latency of a geo-distributed key-value store over the fastest baseline by 12.2% and 33.3% on write-heavy and read-heavy workloads, respectively, and matches the fastest baseline on read-only workloads. A-greement combines lease-authorized local reads, direct client learning for leader-ordered writes, and a fast fixed-quorum per-key write path, selected according to network topology and workload. At the heart of our discovery lies AI-greement, an agent harness for the "autonomous" discovery, implementation, experimentation, and verification of candidate protocols. item.title: Structure-Aware Message Passing on Petri Nets through Directed Walks and Incidence Diffusion
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-21　分类：论文PDF

A common application of the process mining discipline is to connect observed event data with Petri nets, which are bipartite, directed graphical process models with rich formal underpinnings.

A common application of the process mining discipline is to connect observed event data with Petri nets, which are bipartite, directed graphical process models with rich formal underpinnings. Recent work learns vector representations of Petri nets to retrieve process models and relate them to event logs, but leaves implicit two key aspects hidden within the net's structure: directed cycles (process loops) and invariants recorded by the net's incidence matrix. We expose both of these to message-passing graph neural networks, through a positional encoding built from return probabilities of directed place-transition walks (PNRWPE), and through same-type messages gated by diffusion kernels of the incidence matrix (DA-PNGNN). Our constructions raise macro balanced accuracy in predicting the generation factors of the 96 Process Discovery Contest 2023 models from 0.751 to 0.796 with PNRWPE, which nearly doubles accuracy on process loops, and to 0.830 with DA-PNGNN, which, without retuning, also improves net-to-tree retrieval top-1 accuracy on the self-supervised ProcRosetta benchmark by 4.1 to 5.9 points.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Stochastic Pruning of the DPO Computation Graph: 1.4x Faster Training and Lower Peak Memory
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-21　分类：论文PDF

Direct preference optimization (DPO) incurs training costs in output scoring, sequence execution, and backpropagation, so reducing supervision alone does not necessarily save computation.

Direct preference optimization (DPO) incurs training costs in output scoring, sequence execution, and backpropagation, so reducing supervision alone does not necessarily save computation. We introduce a unified framework for stochastic pruning of the DPO computation graph that independently samples response positions for scoring, response prefixes for execution, and preference branches for backpropagation. By making these selections before the corresponding operations, the framework omits computation at each stage of a training step. Our analysis characterizes the objective changes induced by position and sequence pruning and uses inverse-probability weighting to obtain a conditionally unbiased single-branch gradient estimator for the sampled objective. Controlled measurements show that position and sequence pruning primarily reduce peak memory, with most output-memory savings attributable to an implementation that retains full response supervision. Branch pruning yields a $1.426\times$ step-time speedup over a concatenated DPO baseline and reduces training time by about 30\% relative to stock DPO across two model families, with slightly lower mean accuracy and benchmark-dependent …

item.title: Spike-Aware Gradient-Based Mixed-Precision Quantization of Spiking Neural Networks for Vision Applications
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-21　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 SNN 因事件驱动与稀疏计算被视为高能效范式，但低精度部署下的精度保持缺乏探索；现有 Hessian 法（如 HAWQ-V2）因跨 timestep 时间展开带来巨大显存与计算开销。

方法 提出脉冲感知的梯度式混合精度量化框架：用一阶梯度信息自适应分配位宽，规避二阶 Hessian 计算；覆盖 ANN-to-SNN 转换与直接训练两类来源的 VGG、ResNet、ViT 架构。

关键数字 ResNet-34/ImageNet 上 73.30% 精度、4.78× 压缩，与 HAWQ-V2 相当；显存降低 2.31×、位分配运行时间降低 100×；附带混合精度 SNN 能量分析。

为什么值得看 为 SNN 提供低开销混合精度量化路径，能效部署不必牺牲性能。

item.title: Spectral Uncertainty Decomposition for Sparse Bayesian Learning
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-21　分类：论文PDF

Estimating distributed neural sources from M/EEG measurements is an ill-posed inverse problem where principled uncertainty quantification remains challenging.

Estimating distributed neural sources from M/EEG measurements is an ill-posed inverse problem where principled uncertainty quantification remains challenging. The usual conditional Gaussian posterior covariance does not explicitly distinguish uncertainty along likelihood-visible source directions from uncertainty that is invisible to the measurements. We propose a spectral framework based on the singular value structure of the prior-preconditioned forward operator, which provides an exact, interpretable decomposition of the posterior covariance into data-informed and indeterminacy epistemic components. This formulation identifies uncertainty contributions that are reducible by better measurements from those that are fundamentally irreducible by sensing geometry. We further derive an equivalent subtractive decomposition that expresses the prior covariance as the sum of posterior and data-driven reduction terms, enabling precise accounting of uncertainty reduction through Bayesian learning. Together, these complementary representations offer both theoretical insight and practical tools for interpretable uncertainty quantification in M/EEG source imaging for linear-Gaussian Bayesian i…

item.title: Shortcut-Resistant CAM Distillation for Long-Tailed Recognition
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-21　分类：论文PDF

Real-world datasets often follow a long-tailed distribution, making generalization to tail classes difficult.

Real-world datasets often follow a long-tailed distribution, making generalization to tail classes difficult. We revisit this problem through the lens of shortcut learning, where models prefer the easiest predictive cues (e.g., background or textures) over object-centric semantics, especially under scarce and biased supervision. We find that this tendency is amplified for tail classes: limited examples often share similar contexts, making non-semantic signals highly correlated and thus tempting shortcuts, whereas head classes with diverse appearances and environments encourage more stable object-focused representations. Motivated by this observation, we propose Shortcut-Resistant CAM Distillation (SRCD), a plug-and-play framework that transfers object-focused explanations from head to tail classes. SRCD operates in the Class Activation Map (CAM) space, where a CAM provides a class-specific spatial evidence map for a prediction. SRCD aggregates CAMs from a small set of head-class candidates into a shortcut-resistant teacher using an energy-model weighting based on coherence and concentration, and distills it to the tail-class CAM. We provide a theoretical analysis that quantifies sh…

item.title: Semantic-Aware Update Admission and Adaptive Byzantine Redundancy for Secure Computation Offloading in COIN-Enabled Metaverse Systems
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-21　分类：论文PDF

Computing in the network (COIN) supports latency-sensitive Metaverse services, but blockchain commitment of persistent shared-state updates competes with application execution for limited resources.

Computing in the network (COIN) supports latency-sensitive Metaverse services, but blockchain commitment of persistent shared-state updates competes with application execution for limited resources. We consider the joint problem of deciding which updates to commit, how much Byzantine redundancy to provision, and where to execute Metaverse application tasks. We formulate this problem under resource, latency, and practical Byzantine fault tolerance (PBFT) constraints, accounting for update persistence and semantic significance. We develop a hierarchical redundancy-aware PBFT (R-PBFT) approach that decomposes the decision process into slot-wise computation offloading and sequential update-admission and redundancy control. We formulate the former as an identical-interest game and address the latter using a feasibility-filtered double deep Q-network (DDQN). Analytical downlink allocation accounts for the energy and delivery-feasibility effects of consensus latency. For fixed slot state and redundancy, we establish the game's exact-potential property and finite termination of strict sequential improvements. Feasible-action filtering enforces configured Byzantine redundancy and blockchain…

item.title: SWE-VERIFIER: Selective Verification for Cost-Efficient Coding Agents
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-21　分类：论文PDF

Coding agents spend substantial computation generating actions and processing long interaction histories.

Coding agents spend substantial computation generating actions and processing long interaction histories. Poor action choices can steer agents into low-value states, wasting computation and increasing API costs. Sampling and verifying alternative actions can improve the agent's decisions, but applying this procedure at every step adds substantial overhead. We introduce SWE-Verifier, a lightweight generative model that selectively triggers candidate sampling and verification. It scores the coding agent's proposed action to determine when additional candidate sampling is needed, then ranks the resulting actions before execution. We train SWE-Verifier from Qwen3.5-4B using preference data that groups contrasting actions with their resulting environment observations and rubric-guided teacher scores. Using the mini-swe-agent harness, SWE-Verifier improves resolution from 75.47% to 77.20% on MiniMax-M2.7 at 1.09 times cost and generalizes to DeepSeek-V4-Flash without training on its actions, improving resolution from 72.60% to 74.27% at 1.13 times cost. Across both models, SWE-Verifier verifies fewer than 4% of steps and achieves comparable or higher resolution than the trajectory and al…

item.title: SPARE: Sparsity Allocation via Routing Entropy for Efficient MoEs
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-21　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 MoE 专家剪枝大多只关注剪哪些专家且对每层均等修剪，忽略了各层路由分散程度的差异，剪枝内存收益有提升空间。

方法 SPARE 免训练、选择器无关：用校准数据上 token 归一化 Top-K 门控权重的路由熵决定每层移除多少专家——路由越分散说明删掉一个活跃专家损失越小，剪得越激进；随机剪枝下的扰动界形式化该直觉，并用固定选择器的受控干预验证。

关键数字 同一选择器与预算下，50% 专家剪枝时 Qwen3-30B-A3B 八任务平均从 57.2% 提升到 63.8%，DeepSeek-R1 数学/代码/科学平均从 80.1 提升到 82.8。

为什么值得看 免训练、即插即用的逐层稀疏分配，对 MoE 部署内存优化有直接实用价值。

item.title: Resuming Vision-Language Inference across Onboard Interruptions
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-21　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 低轨卫星上执行 VLM 推理时，请求可能跨多个执行窗口：功耗/热约束、故障重启、竞争载荷都会中断推理，断电即丢弃激活与 KV cache，未保护请求重启后被迫重复劳动。

方法 OrbitWeaver 协调检查点与恢复：阶段感知检查点按视觉编码、语言 prefill、解码的状态生命周期与计算特征选择恢复边界，平衡存储流量与重算；依赖感知动态恢复跨层与 token 块维度调度；检查点与权重读取和重算重叠以降低重启延迟。

关键数字 恢复规划器在 100ms 内计算最优执行顺序；卫星载荷硬件+在轨遥测轨迹实验端到端加速最高 4.07x、SSD 写入量降 3.56x；两颗低轨卫星 72 小时部署验证跨多次总线强制关机的恢复。

为什么值得看 太空边缘 AI 的务实工程，检查点/恢复设计对各类受限设备的长期运行都有借鉴。

方法 OrbitWeaver 协调检查点与恢复：阶段感知检查点按视觉编码、语言 prefill、解码的状态生命周期与计算特征选择恢复边界，平衡存储流量与重算；依赖感知动态恢复跨层与 token 块维度调度；检查点与权重读取和重算重叠以降低重启延迟。

关键数字 恢复规划器在 100ms 内计算最优执行顺序；卫星载荷硬件+在轨遥测轨迹实验端到端加速最高 4.07x、SSD 写入量降 3.56x；两颗低轨卫星 72 小时部署验证跨多次总线强制关机的恢复。

为什么值得看 太空边缘 AI 的务实工程，检查点/恢复设计对各类受限设备的长期运行都有借鉴。

item.title: Reorienting the Vector Axis: Restructuring FlashAttention for Long-Vector Processors
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-21　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 FlashAttention 及其后续工作几乎都面向 GPU；长向量处理器（单向量寄存器可容 512 个单精度数）上向量化哪条循环是一阶决策，GPU 内核移植后性能大幅损失。

方法 将 PyTorch CPU FlashAttention 移植到 2KB 向量寄存器的 RISC-V CPU 后提出两项技术：转置 score tile 与运行输出使 query 沿连续轴（单参数即可匹配机器向量长，且两类 reduction 消失）；把 softmax 多项式系数移入标量寄存器消除溢出。

关键数字 原移植仅达峰值浮点吞吐的 16.2%；两项技术联合使整核周期减少 1.84-2.08x（head=64），浮点利用率升至 29.7%，softmax 向量内存指令减少 78.7%；同设计 FPGA 评分更高，达 2.71x。

为什么值得看 非 GPU 长向量架构的 attention 优化稀缺，对 RISC-V/边缘向量处理器有直接参考。

item.title: Reliability-Aware Probabilistic Fusion for Multimodal Learning with Incomplete Evidence
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-21　分类：论文PDF

Multimodal inputs may be missing or degraded, raising distinct questions of evidence availability and trust.

Multimodal inputs may be missing or degraded, raising distinct questions of evidence availability and trust. We introduce a reliability-aware Gaussian Product-of-Experts (PoE) in which an input-dependent reliability weight tempers each modality's latent precision, while missing experts are omitted. We characterize how reliability and availability affect posterior information and expert influence. Across two clinical multimodal tasks, the full framework remains competitive with complete inputs and achieves its clearest mean-AUROC advantage under modality absence, particularly on HAIM-MIMIC-MM. Ablations show a substantial gain from missing-aware training and an additional HAIM improvement from reliability weighting under matched PoE, missing-aware, and consistency training. Unseen test-time corruptions are used diagnostically and reveal modality-dependent reliability-weight and latent-uncertainty responses, including failure under severe degradation. Thus, reliability weighting provides an explicit evidence-control mechanism, while learning dependable quality signals remains an open challenge.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。
