item.title: Scaling Graph Reasoning in Language Models with Learnable Graph Positional Encodings
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-20　分类：论文PDF

Solving reasoning tasks supported on graphs typically requires providing a Language Reasoning Model (LRM) with a serialized description of the graph.

Solving reasoning tasks supported on graphs typically requires providing a Language Reasoning Model (LRM) with a serialized description of the graph. This approach results in the input length growing with the number of edges, which limits the size of the problems that can be solved. Furthermore, even when graphs fit in context, performance sharply decays as the graphs grow. We propose to address this by augmenting LRMs with scalable and permutation equivariant graph positional encodings that modulate attention logits. An additional post-fusion-style module incorporates structural information into hidden states. We compute these positional encodings using a GNN followed by a Graph Transformer. This eliminates the need for serialized adjacencies, reducing the context burden to $O(N)$. We jointly fine-tune the positional encoder and the LRM LoRA adapters using optimal solutions generated by graph-theoretic solvers, resulting in a computationally efficient method. Trained on small graphs, the model exhibits improved size-generalization across graph-theoretic tasks on graphs with up to 1,000 nodes, and produces fewer tokens than a conventional LRM. item.title: STAR-XPC: Set Transformer for Estimating X-ray Transmission in Polymer Composites
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-20　分类：论文PDF

Evaluating the energy transmission ratio of an X-ray beam through a polymer composite is a challenging task in radiation shielding studies.

Evaluating the energy transmission ratio of an X-ray beam through a polymer composite is a challenging task in radiation shielding studies. The reference solution with Monte Carlo transport simulation is highly accurate but computationally expensive: each of our reference simulations is capped at $4\times10^9$ photon histories and a 20,000 s (over 5 hours) time limit, while closed-form analytical methods fail to represent such complex scenarios. We present an artificial neural network model that maps the unordered multi-set of molecular constituents, their mass fractions, and four bulk physical descriptors directly to the transmission ratio $I(t)/I_0$ in 1-3 milliseconds. The model is a Set Transformer, which makes it permutation invariant by construction and accepts mixtures of different sizes up to 11 constituents within a fixed-size padded set. Each constituent is embedded with a chemistry-pretrained transformer language model, ChemBERTa. In our proposed method, training data are produced by an automated PENELOPE/penEasy pipeline using the radiation source at 30, 80, 100, and 120 kV tube voltages over polyethylene-based shielding composite slabs of thicknesses spanning 0.15-2.5 …

item.title: Rethinking Time Series Tokenization from a Frequency Perspective
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-20　分类：论文PDF

Tokenization that partitions time series into subsequences has become a foundational paradigm in modern time series modeling.

Tokenization that partitions time series into subsequences has become a foundational paradigm in modern time series modeling. However, we find that current tokenization strategies inherently introduce spectral distortions, forcing the learned representations to diverge from the true underlying patterns such as trend, periodicity, and seasonality, thereby impairing model performance. Through theoretical analysis from a frequency perspective, we derive the boundary conditions under which such distortions occur. To overcome this distortion, we propose TimeFT, a nearly distortion-free frequency-based tokenizer for time series data. TimeFT obtains tokens through frequency-domain partitioning, frequency shifting, and Nyquist sampling. The method is parameter-free, incurs negligible computational complexity, and can serve as a drop-in replacement for existing tokenizers. Our extensive experiments on diverse tasks such as forecasting, classification, and anomaly detection demonstrate that TimeFT consistently and significantly improves performance.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Relative Representations Enable Portable White-Box Monitoring Across Language Models
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-20　分类：论文PDF

Independently trained autoregressive language models often acquire similar capabilities, but it remains unclear whether their internal representations organize behaviorally relevant information in compatible ways.

Independently trained autoregressive language models often acquire similar capabilities, but it remains unclear whether their internal representations organize behaviorally relevant information in compatible ways. We show that models do in fact organize information similarly by using specific behavioral probes that operate on compatible representations. This unlocks portable white-box monitoring: a probe developed and validated on one model can be reused when the model changes, without requiring labeled target data. To overcome incompatible native activation coordinates, we express each example through its angular distances to a shared set of anchors. We introduce a global anchored construction that summarizes information from all transformer layers and removes model-specific layer selection, so the same frozen probe can be straightforwardly applied to another model. We evaluate cross-model probe transfer across monitoring tasks on trivia datasets, safety monitoring, and mathematical reasoning. On average, transferred global anchored probes preserve at least 85% of same-model probe AUROC over chance. Anchored probes also support transfer to related datasets, remain robust across mo…

item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-20　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 强化学习如何在 FPGA 与集成电路平台上做硬件加速与系统级优化？现状、架构模式与开放挑战是什么？

方法 综述 100+ 项研究，按 RL 家族（基于模型的 MDP、经典值方法、深度 RL、actor-critic、策略梯度、多智能体）组织，并从抽象层次、硬件实现策略、应用域三维分类，统一分析加速、可重构架构、能效控制与系统级优化，对比资源利用率、延迟、吞吐、功耗与性能增益。

关键数字 覆盖超过 100 项 FPGA/IC 平台上的 RL 实现研究。

为什么值得看 区别于单算法或单平台的综述，提供统一分析框架，适合 FPGA/IC+RL 方向入门与定位。

item.title: ReAPO: Retry-Aware Policy Optimization for Efficient Exploration in LLM Reasoning
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-20　分类：论文PDF

RLVR improves language-model reasoning, but commonly relies on independent stochastic rollouts for exploration, which can repeatedly sample similar failed strategies.

RLVR improves language-model reasoning, but commonly relies on independent stochastic rollouts for exploration, which can repeatedly sample similar failed strategies. Prior work has seen success with approaches that guide exploration by introducing dependence into the sampling process by including incorrect solutions in the context for subsequent attempts. Still, these methods introduce the additional question of how to assign credit to each attempt. We propose to view the credit assignment through the lens of Stochastic Shortest Paths, a framework in classical reinforcement learning that seeks to minimize the expected cumulative cost to reach a terminal state (in our case, a verified successful response). We show that, under suitable simplifying assumptions, this perspective naturally leads to a simple modification to GRPO, which we call Retry-Aware Policy Optimization (ReAPO). ReAPO allocates additional generation to failed trajectories, allowing successful retries to be reinforced without rewarding preceding failures, and assigns credit in a theoretically principled way to each attempt. Floorplanning with rectilinear soft modules improves area utilization and wirelength by allowing modules to adapt to rectilinear polygon (RPoly) shapes. Existing methods typically construct rectilinear polygons through incremental refinement after obtaining a rectangular global solution, which confines polygon exploration to the neighborhood induced by the initial floorplan. This paper presents RPolyPlan, a unified framework for outline-free and fixed-outline floorplanning that directly incorporates continuously deformable rectilinear polygons into global floorplanning. To enable direct polygon optimization, we introduce a structured continuous representation and a differentiable polygon shaping model that dynamically optimizes rectilinear module shapes based on overlaps, making continuous shape optimization feasible for gradient-based global floorplanning. item.title: Projected Distillation: On Learning to Solve Hard Problems from Close, Correct Targets
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-20　分类：论文PDF

On-policy learning is central to post-training: training on a model's own generations limits distribution shift and helps preserve existing capabilities.

On-policy learning is central to post-training: training on a model's own generations limits distribution shift and helps preserve existing capabilities. On hard problems, however, on-policy RL provides no reward-based learning signal when all attempts fail. On-policy distillation provides next-token supervision from a teacher, but on hard problems, if a rollout goes wrong early, subsequent supervision is conditioned on prefixes that already contain the mistake. Correct behavior can instead come from a gold or teacher solution, but such off-policy targets can differ substantially from the model's generations and, as we show, may erode existing capabilities. We therefore treat on-policyness as a continuum and propose projected distillation, which minimally edits the student's failed attempts into correct targets. The method uses contrastive updates to favor corrections over failed attempts and refreshes these corrections as the student evolves, enabling near-on-policy learning even when all student attempts fail. Theoretically, we prove that the student's learning regret grows with the edit size: it scales linearly with the horizon under minimal correction, as in DAgger, and quadrat…

item.title: Privacy Accounting for Empirical Denoisers
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-20　分类：论文PDF

Diffusion models have emerged as the foundation of modern generative systems, yet their high memorization capacity raises privacy concerns.

Diffusion models have emerged as the foundation of modern generative systems, yet their high memorization capacity raises privacy concerns. While differentially private (DP) training provides formal guarantees, it comes at a cost in sample quality. In this work, we study a complementary question: how much privacy loss is incurred during the sampling process itself? Directly analyzing modern neural denoisers is challenging because their sensitivity to a single training example is generally intractable. To overcome this challenge, we construct and analyze a clipped privacy-accountable empirical denoiser, a training-free estimator of the Bayes-optimal denoiser, whose per-step sensitivity can be computed explicitly, allowing each denoising step to be a Gaussian mechanism. This perspective enables privacy accounting under Gaussian DP when each training example contributes to each denoising step, and under $f$-DP trade-off functions when each generated sample uses a single randomly subsampled block of the training data. We report every $(\varepsilon, δ)$ guarantee as a certified upper bound from a privacy loss distribution accountant, and use a cumulant-based Edgeworth approximation as a…

item.title: Peak-Memory Schedules You Can Trust: Exact Realization, Certified Optimality, and the Limits of Recomputation for Inference
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-20　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题： 小设备实时推理需要低激活内存但不增加延迟——算子执行顺序是"免费的"内存杠杆，但编译器真的能做到吗？

方法： 不再信任编译器重新生成代码后能达到预测峰值，转而 profiling 已生成程序、从程序语句精确建模内存、对语句做排列搜索，证明在分配不依赖历史时总能精确兑现建模峰值。

关键数字： PyTorch Inductor 在 54 个 CPU 配置中 22 个未达预测峰值，9 个比原程序更差；GPU 上 50 个中 19 个更差且改变数值结果。

为什么值得看： 编译器不靠谱这件事在内存优化上被量化了，方法不依赖特定框架，对任何需要极致内存效率的推理部署都有参考价值。

为什么值得看： 编译器不靠谱这件事在内存优化上被量化了，方法不依赖特定框架，对任何需要极致内存效率的推理部署都有参考价值。

发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-20　分类：论文PDF

Accurate electrical load forecasting supports power-system operation across countries, regions, cities, and buildings, but repeated development of target-specific models is costly.

Accurate electrical load forecasting supports power-system operation across countries, regions, cities, and buildings, but repeated development of target-specific models is costly. Time series foundation models (TSFMs) provide reusable pretrained backbones, although multi-domain pretraining may not fully capture load-specific characteristics. This paper compares pretrained inference, full fine-tuning, and low-rank adaptation (LoRA) in terms of forecasting accuracy and adaptation efficiency across four electrical load aggregation levels. MOIRAI 1.0 Large serves as the primary backbone, while Chronos-2 assesses whether the findings transfer across model families. The evaluation covers both in-distribution (ID) and out-of-distribution (OOD) settings and examines whether compact adaptation provides consistent gains over strong pretrained checkpoints. Pretrained foundation models outperform the implemented seasonal naive and XGBoost baselines across the evaluated aggregation levels. On MOIRAI Large, rank-16 LoRA reduces normalized mean absolute error (NMAE) by 7.5% on average while updating 3.146 million parameters, about 1% of the model, and retains most of the improvement from full fi…

item.title: Pairwise Learning Increases Data Efficiency in Deep Neural Networks
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-20　分类：论文PDF

Deep neural networks often fail at small-sample regression, collapsing to low-variance predictions that miss individual differences.

Deep neural networks often fail at small-sample regression, collapsing to low-variance predictions that miss individual differences. Here, we introduce a pairwise comparison framework that reframes regression as aggregated relative rankings. This method improves data efficiency across model architectures and dataset sizes. On the UTKFace dataset (23k images), pairwise learning generates over one billion training comparisons without additional supervision. The paired ranking allows a lightweight ResNet10 trained from scratch on home hardware to achieve a 3.64-year MAE-surpassing previous models, including those with large-scale pretraining. For classification into categories, pairwise supervision consistently outperforms an otherwise identical 10-way crossentropy model on STL10 with 500-2000 labeled examples, improving accuracy by up to 5.2%. Overall, pairwise supervision enhances data efficiency and enables strong regression and classification performance when labeled data are limited, particularly in clinical settings.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: PairSight: Characterizing and Predicting Operator-Level Interference in GPU Sharing for DNN Inference
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-20　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题： GPU 共享场景下，多个 DNN 推理任务共驻同一 GPU 时，算子级干扰到底来自哪里？能否做到既可解释又准确的慢化预测？

方法： 在 SM 分区下做算子级干扰实验，用硬件计数器追踪到共享内存路径上的争抢是关键根因；提出 PairSight，基于两算子特征联合预测慢化。

关键数字： 干扰取决于两个算子各自的内存带宽需求与计算强度组合，仅靠"算力型/内存型"二元分类远不够用。

为什么值得看： GPU 共享是降本关键手段，但粗暴的共存策略会引入不可预期的延迟抖动——这篇把干扰溯源到了可预测的算子级。

item.title: PaPi: Parallel Picard-Duhamel Integration for Fast Neuro-Spectral Architectures
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-20　分类：论文PDF

Neuro-spectral architectures (NeuSA) are a class of physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) that have proven effective for solving time-dependent PDEs in the frequency domain.

Neuro-spectral architectures (NeuSA) are a class of physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) that have proven effective for solving time-dependent PDEs in the frequency domain. However, training and inference often rely on costly numerical integration of the learned vector field, typically using sequential Runge-Kutta time stepping, which limits temporal parallelism. We introduce PaPi, an integration scheme inspired by weakly nonlinear flows that enables time-Parallel inference through exponential integration and a Duhamel-Picard scheme. We show that the Duhamel-Picard iteration converges exponentially for all flows, and provide explicit error bounds that depend on how close the flow is to linear. Experiments show that PaPi accelerates training and inference by up to two orders of magnitude, achieving training times of under one second for low-dimensional PDE learning problems, while maintaining competitive predictive accuracy.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Orthogonal Boundary Unlearning for Dual-Use Concepts in Large Language Models
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-20　分类：论文PDF

Mitigating catastrophic risks from large language models requires excising hazardous operational capabilities, such as cyberwarfare exploitation and pathogen enhancement, without degrading benign scientific utility.

Mitigating catastrophic risks from large language models requires excising hazardous operational capabilities, such as cyberwarfare exploitation and pathogen enhancement, without degrading benign scientific utility. In these dual-use domains, legitimate defensive science and malicious attacks share vocabulary, syntax, and internal model representations, causing standard unlearning methods to induce severe collateral damage (concept bleeding). In this work, we present Orthogonal Boundary Unlearning (OBU), a mathematically grounded framework designed to eliminate collateral damage on benign dual-use capabilities. OBU extracts a domain-matched capability subspace from paired calibration queries via singular value decomposition on empirical activation covariances, and restricts parameter updates strictly to the orthogonal null space. This guarantees that benign representations experience zero parameter perturbation along the spanned calibration subspace. We present two complementary realizations of OBU: Projected LoRA, which applies the orthogonal constraint during iterative gradient-based fine-tuning, and Closed-Form Weight Surgery, which directly edits model weights in a single analy…

item.title: Observation Assimilation Transformer: Probabilistic Weather Analysis from Sparse Station Observations
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-20　分类：论文PDF

We present the Observation Assimilation Transformer (OAT), a geometry-aware neural process that corrects and refines a prior numerical weather prediction (NWP) field into a high-resolution posterior field by assimilating sparse observations.

We present the Observation Assimilation Transformer (OAT), a geometry-aware neural process that corrects and refines a prior numerical weather prediction (NWP) field into a high-resolution posterior field by assimilating sparse observations. OAT is an encoder-decoder transformer that considers a set of observed locations and their NWP prior to condition predictions at a set of arbitrary unobserved query locations. Its sparse attention mechanism makes it scalable to thousands of station observations and depends on relative positions between locations, never on the absolute coordinates. The model allows for partially missing observations, predictions at arbitrary continuous locations without grid projection, and outputs are parametric distributions. A station-randomized training algorithm is developed with continuous ranked probability score (CRPS) loss. We test OAT on two datasets - one at regional scale with hundreds of stations, and one at continental scale with thousands of stations. On these datasets OAT outperforms several baselines and shows well calibrated predictions. In an illustrative case study, OAT's downscaling capabilities are demonstrated by downscaling ERA5 (~31km) t…

item.title: Near-Duplicate Image Selection Transfers Preferences in Vision-Language Models
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-20　分类：论文PDF

Subliminal learning is the phenomenon in which a model transmits its preferences to another model through data that do not explicitly express them.

Subliminal learning is the phenomenon in which a model transmits its preferences to another model through data that do not explicitly express them. As models increasingly curate training data for other models, we ask whether this transfer can arise from choosing among near-duplicate images while keeping the source photographs and human-written captions fixed. For each photograph, a curator selects one of eight near-duplicate variants by caption likelihood, without target-specific prompts. Students trained on target-preferring curators' selections show higher mean target-versus-alternatives log-likelihood ratios in an image-free readout than students trained on neutral selections. Under a prespecified decision rule, this directional shift appears for an owl target in LLaVA-1.5, Qwen2.5-VL, Qwen3-VL, and Gemma 4, with curators and students initialized from the same base checkpoint, and target rotations move it toward camels, oak trees, and a political figure. The owl target-selected student also scores above all count-matched random-reselection students in three models and above 55 of 60 in LLaVA-1.5, and Qwen3-VL shows the shift again on a new source bank with newly trained curators…

item.title: Multi-Objective Protein Optimization via Modular Diffusion Steering
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-20　分类：论文PDF

Protein engineering often requires improving several properties simultaneously, motivating the search for high-performing sequences that represent useful fitness tradeoffs.

Protein engineering often requires improving several properties simultaneously, motivating the search for high-performing sequences that represent useful fitness tradeoffs. Discovering these sequences is challenging because the design space is combinatorially large and experimental campaigns often permit only a few rounds of batched measurements. We introduce \textit{MODS}, a modular framework for multi-objective protein optimization via inference-time diffusion steering. For each proposal, MODS samples augmented Chebyshev scalarization weights and a fitness-surrogate ensemble member to define a scalar steering reward. Varying the weights directs generation toward different objective tradeoffs, while varying ensemble members diversifies the predictions used for guidance. Because MODS expresses multi-objective acquisition through scalar rewards, it can be paired with different diffusion models and compatible steering procedures. After each evaluation batch, MODS updates the surrogates without retraining the generative model. We evaluate MODS on six protein optimization tasks using predictive oracles trained on experimental assay data, with two diffusion models and two steering proce…

item.title: MuPACE: Learning to Pace Muon for LoRA Fine-Tuning
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-20　分类：论文PDF

Learning rate schedules are typically fixed before training begins, yet when fine-tuning large language models with low-rank adapters (LoRA), the appropriate scale varies substantially with the model, task, and adapter configuration.

Learning rate schedules are typically fixed before training begins, yet when fine-tuning large language models with low-rank adapters (LoRA), the appropriate scale varies substantially with the model, task, and adapter configuration. Practitioners re-tune a schedule for every new problem, yet a tuned schedule still cannot react to the training dynamics it encounters. We instead amortize learning rate selection across LoRA fine-tuning problems. We leave the base optimizer, Muon, untouched, so that its normalized update fixes the direction, and meta-learn only the global step size. Our method MuPACE is a small recurrent policy, meta-trained across a distribution of fine-tuning runs, that conditions on the observed trajectory and emits bounded adjustments to an interpretable analytic schedule. On 64 fine-tuning problems, MuPACE outperforms standard fixed schedules at a strong shared default on 64-78% of problems and is on par with the same schedules with per-task tuned peaks. Meta-trained only on models with up to 16 layers, MuPACE transfers one-shot to unseen tasks on models as deep as 64 layers, such as Qwen3-32B and Qwen3.8-27B, where a single run remains competitive with swept sch…

item.title: Memory Bandwidth, Not FLOPs: Profiling and Accelerating Query-Based Segmentation Decoders on Edge GPUs
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-20　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题： 边缘 GPU 上查询式分割模型（FastInst、Mask2Former）的 Transformer 解码器性能瓶颈究竟在算力还是内存带宽？

方法： 在 Jetson Orin Nano 上用 FP16 roofline 分析 + 硬件 DRAM 计数器做细粒度剖析，确认瓶颈后提出 CompactInst：用无参数 4× 空间池化压缩解码器内激活传输量，辅以双卷积精化头恢复空间细节。

关键数字： 非 Tensor Core 聚合仅占 CUDA-core 理论峰值的 2.5%–6%，却吃掉解码器 53%–70% 时间和 61%–71% 的字节搬运；单 kernel 可占满 90% DRAM 带宽。CompactInst 在 Jetson Orin Nano 上解码加速明显。

为什么值得看： 常见误区是"边缘推理瓶颈在算力"，本文用硬数据证明是内存带宽，且给出了无需重训的轻量解决方案。

item.title: Manifold-Informed Neural Networks for Low-Label ECG Electrolyte Inference
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-20　分类：论文PDF

Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) supervise on the residual of a known differential operator.

Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) supervise on the residual of a known differential operator. Many high-stakes inference problems admit no such operator: clinical signals, behavioral measurements, materials properties. We introduce the Manifold-Informed Neural Network (MINN), a PINN-parallel paradigm that replaces the physics operator residual with a manifold operator residual: a discrete Poisson equation $\mathbf{L}_G \mathbf{H} = s_φ(\mathbf{x}, \mathbf{m})$ on a $k$-nearest-neighbor graph in the learned latent space, with a learned, task-aware source. The construction is a structural parallel to PINNs (squared operator residual plus label data, in place of operator residual plus boundary data); the $s{=}0$ limit recovers the homogeneous Laplace equation $\mathbf{L}_G\mathbf{H}=\mathbf{0}$ (classical manifold regularization solves the same equation but minimizes the Dirichlet energy $\operatorname{tr}(\mathbf{H}^\top\mathbf{L}_G\mathbf{H})$, a different penalty form). The source $s_φ$ takes input features and auxiliary metadata directly, breaking the homogeneous smoothness prior that limits classical Laplacian penalties; gated Feature-wise Linear Modulation separately fuse…

The construction is a structural parallel to PINNs (squared operator residual plus label data, in place of operator residual plus boundary data); the $s{=}0$ limit recovers the homogeneous Laplace equation $\mathbf{L}_G\mathbf{H}=\mathbf{0}$ (classical manifold regularization solves the same equation but minimizes the Dirichlet energy $\operatorname{tr}(\mathbf{H}^\top\mathbf{L}_G\mathbf{H})$, a different penalty form). item.title: Learning Computational Structure for Sample-Efficient Prediction
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-20　分类：论文PDF

Statistical learning in high dimensions suffers from the curse of dimensionality.

Statistical learning in high dimensions suffers from the curse of dimensionality. Fortunately, many functions of practical interest are compositionally sparse, meaning they admit a composition of local functions, each depending on only a few variables, allowing sample complexity to depend on local arity rather than ambient dimension. Yet realizing this benefit requires exploiting hidden compositional structure, which theory does not establish for practical gradient-based training. We study this gap with CSFRBench, a controlled benchmark that hides the target's compositional computation during training but retains it for diagnosis, and find that dense networks and sparsity-based baselines leave much of that benefit unrealized. Inspired by the spatial organization of biological neural circuits, we introduce Learned Wiring (LeWi): each neuron has a learned low-dimensional embedding, only nearby neurons connect, and embeddings and weights are trained jointly. LeWi improves sample efficiency on targets with hierarchical structure, intermediate reuse, or independent modules. Across 32 additional targets generated by independently sampled computation graphs, LeWi is the most sample-effici…

item.title: LEAN: Loss-Engineered Modulation of the Model Weight-Sensitivity Distribution for Efficient, Error-Tolerant Neural Networks
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-20　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 网络权重对精度敏感性并不均匀：1% 最敏感权重承担约五分之一的位置翻转损害。现有方案只能被动接受训练留下的敏感性分布。

方法 LEAN 复合正则器主动调制权重敏感性分布：range 项限制翻转步长、tail 项降低最敏感权重的梯度，单系数 λ 控制分布移动距离；配合 BCH 纠错码使用。

关键数字 9 个视觉模型（ResNet-18/50、VGG-16）上敏感尾部缩小 5-13 倍，精度损失 0.5 点内；1% 权重 BCH 编码下模型在 300 次渐进位搜索翻转全部种子存活、2/3 种子撑到 500 次（3/4 公开防御 300 次即失败）；固定保证下奇偶校验需求降 3.7 倍；8/6/4/3-bit 格式使 ImageNet ResNet-50 权重负载 3.29 bit，比 INT8 小 2.4 倍。

为什么值得看 位翻转容错与低比特存储的交叉前沿，对可靠性敏感部署与存算器件有直接价值。

item.title: Koala: Non-disruptive Reconfiguration for Long-running Stateful Dataflows
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-20　分类：论文PDF

Stateful dataflow systems must decide where state lives relative to the tasks that process it.

Stateful dataflow systems must decide where state lives relative to the tasks that process it. For long-running applications that require frequent reconfiguration due to changes in resource allocation, partitioning, or task placement, this design choice presents a core trade-off between adaptability and performance. Co-locating state with computation ensures low latency at steady state but makes reconfiguration disruptive, as any change forces state migration. On the other hand, keeping state in an external store makes reconfiguration seamless, but incurs overhead on every access. We present Koala, a reconfiguration protocol for distributed dataflow systems that retains the operational performance of embedded-state architectures while matching the disruption-free adaptability of external-state designs. Unlike prior protocols which relocate all state regardless of whether it will soon be accessed, Koala migrates state in a fine-grained, lazy manner. To achieve that, it employs a lightweight ownership transfer mechanism that safely decouples event routing from state location. We implement Koala in a new streaming dataflow system and evaluate it on real-world and synthetic benchmarks.…

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: KPage: Cross-Block Page Compaction for Hardware-Efficient Sparse Attention
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-20　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 长序列视频 Transformer 的稀疏注意力中，3D token 布局常让选中块部分占用、浪费物理 tile 容量——能否跨逻辑块边界把有效 K/V 页压实进大 tile，提升硬件利用率？

方法 KPage 块稀疏注意力方案：加载时直接把有效 16 行 K/V 页跨逻辑块边界打包进大 tile（不在高带宽内存物化压缩张量）；Q 块在 64×256 与 128×128 tile 间路由以减 query 侧填充；精确掩码与 K/V 页打包在前反向保持原稀疏图。

关键数字 五个代表性负载上较 NVIDIA Block-Sparse Attention（BSA）前向 kernel 加速 1.35×–2.06×（几何平均 1.77×），完全占满块上近持平（1.03×）而 3D 部分块布局达 2.29×；物理 QK 对容量从 334.1G 降到 177.5G 而保留 160.6G 有效交互；SVG2 Wan 14B/720p 上较最强精确稀疏基线 1.49×、较 BSA 1.57×。

为什么值得看 系统性解决稀疏注意力"块内浪费"，跨开源稀疏基线全面占优，且合规审查后将开源并提交 PR 给 NVIDIA cuDNN Frontend。

item.title: JAXbounce: A Continuous-Control Pong-Like Benchmark for Active Inference Beyond Low Dimensional Environments
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-20　分类：论文PDF

We introduce JAXbounce, a continuous control pong-like benchmark designed to evaluate active inference beyond discrete, low dimensional environments.

We introduce JAXbounce, a continuous control pong-like benchmark designed to evaluate active inference beyond discrete, low dimensional environments. JAXbounce combines continuous states and stochastic dynamics in discrete time with flexible and composable observation models that allow representing the environment as a state vector or a pixel grid, corruptible through the rich family of noise models we provide. It is fully differentiable and parallelisable in JAX. We run over 10,000 agent simulations on our environment comparing a baseline deterministic solution, to a state-based active inference agent with Unscented Kalman Filter perception and expected free energy planning, and a pixel based agent whose measurement model is a pretrained neural network encoder. All agents are evaluated across three scenarios of increasing difficulty with eight different noise conditions. Our experiments characterise how performance of continuous state agents scales with planning, planning horizons, observation modalities and knowledge of the noise process, exhibiting preference-oriented behaviour even in the presence of increasing uncertainty. We release JAXbounce as a reproducible benchmark for c…

item.title: Is 2:4 Sparsity Still Worth It? Semi-Structured Sparsity versus Quantization in LLM Inference
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-20　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 给定当前精度，下一步应加 2:4 半结构化稀疏还是降到下一档更低精度？两者在 LLM 推理中哪个收益更大？

方法 等比特（计入稀疏元数据）与等名义 tensor-core 档位下，覆盖 transformer 层全部 6 个 GEMM 操作数，三代 GPU 实测内核，含在线剪枝与量化。

关键数字 只要更低精度可用，加 2:4 就是更差的选择（更不准确且更慢）；量化到硬件最低精度后 2:4 仍使线性层快 1.3-1.7x；H100 上重训 2:4 模型 FP8 vLLM 服务 prefill 吞吐比稠密 FP8 高 27%，GSM8K 精度持平。Blackwell 稀疏 FP4 用 4:8 模式损失更大，重训预算未能恢复。

为什么值得看 给"稀疏还是量化"提供量化证据，直接指导推理部署的精度/稀疏路线取舍。

item.title: Interflow: Breaking the Offline-Online Barrier for Private AI at the Edge
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-20　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 隐私保护 ML 在边缘部署受 MPC 非线性推理的高通信、高计算、高数据搬运成本制约，且离线相关随机数生成与在线执行解耦造成巨大内存压力与补货停顿——能否打破离线-在线壁垒？

方法 Interflow 算法-硬件协同：按批流水线化相关随机数生成与在线执行——当前批消耗预生成随机数执行安全非线性运算时，为下一批并行生成；用交错执行、高效数据搬运与硬件加速，把预处理从串行存储密集型变为连续重叠流水线。

关键数字 Zynq UltraScale+ ZCU102 上非线性吞吐 CNN 算子最高提升 1.55×、transformer 算子 1.48×；ResNet-50 加速 1.26×、BERT-base 1.21×；内存占用较基线最高降 37%。

为什么值得看 用软硬协同把 MPC 预处理的"离线-在线壁垒"拆成重叠流水线，边缘隐私推理的工程范本。

item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-20　分类：论文PDF

Photoplethysmography (PPG) enables low-cost and non-invasive heart rate (HR) monitoring but remains sensitive to waveform distortion, physiological variability, and measurement interference.

Photoplethysmography (PPG) enables low-cost and non-invasive heart rate (HR) monitoring but remains sensitive to waveform distortion, physiological variability, and measurement interference. Temporal waveform characteristics and frequency-domain periodicity provide complementary information for HR estimation; however, effectively exploring and integrating these representations within a compact model remains challenging. This paper proposes TF-IG, a parameter-efficient interaction-gated time-frequency learning framework for PPG-based HR estimation. TF-IG employs a dual-branch architecture in which a temporal branch captures pulse morphology via dilated depthwise-separable convolutions, while a frequency branch extracts cardiac periodicity information from bounded log-spectrogram representations. To combine the two domains, we introduce an interaction-gated fusion module that explicitly models feature agreement and discrepancy, while also learning feature-wise weights to balance temporal and spectral information. A parameter-shared regression head further maps the temporal, spectral, and fused representations into the final HR prediction space. Experiments on the benchmark BIDMC PPG …

item.title: How Much Gradient Does Truncated Backprop Lose in Looped Transformers?
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-20　分类：论文PDF

Looped transformers reuse one block of layers many times and are often trained by backpropagating through only the last k loops.

Looped transformers reuse one block of layers many times and are often trained by backpropagating through only the last k loops. We measure how much of the weight gradient this throws away, exactly and for every k from one backward pass, on nine looped language models, and report three findings. First, on a trained model this lost gradient is set near the output: once the loop count is well above k, it barely changes with the loop count (within about 0.03 from 32 to 64 loops on the three models we tested, as a pre-registered test predicted for Parcae). Where the backward signal shrinks, $ρ^k$, with $ρ$ the signal's fitted shrink per loop, approximates it at moderate loop counts but overstates it at long ones, because the fitted $ρ$ drifts up as the fit takes in more loops. On Ouro the signal grows, and keeping two of four loops still loses 81% of the final output's gradient. Second, the lost gradient falls during fine-tuning, by 0.07-0.22 within 300 steps on three of four models, on held-out problems too. The fall is not just the read-out's share of the gradient; training only the layers outside the loop reproduced up to half of it, and it also falls under truncated training. So a …

item.title: GPU-Accelerated Construction of the Gabriel Graph: Parallelization Strategies and Applications to Large-Margin Classification and Graph-Based Clustering
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-20　分类：论文PDF

The Gabriel graph is a proximity graph widely used in computational geometry and geometric machine learning, underlying large-margin classifiers and, as we show in this work, density-aware clustering methods.

The Gabriel graph is a proximity graph widely used in computational geometry and geometric machine learning, underlying large-margin classifiers and, as we show in this work, density-aware clustering methods. Its construction, however, has cubic time complexity $O(N^3)$ in the naive formulation, which severely limits its use on datasets beyond a few thousand samples. This paper presents a set of GPU parallelization strategies, implemented in CUDA, that make Gabriel graph construction practical at scale. We introduce (i) an implicit closed-form mapping from a linear thread index to the corresponding vertex pair $(i,j)$, which removes the need for an explicit $O(N^2)$ adjacency structure and lets every thread locate its pair in constant time and constant memory; (ii) a two-pass, bitmask-based, atomically-compacted edge-list construction that produces a dense edge array proportional only to the number of edges actually found; and (iii) a thread-coarsening strategy in which each thread evaluates several candidate pairs, trading launch and scheduling overhead against load balance. item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-20　分类：论文PDF

The rapid growth of distributed photovoltaic (PV) generation is increasing the demand for accurate forecasting across large numbers of geographically dispersed stations.

The rapid growth of distributed photovoltaic (PV) generation is increasing the demand for accurate forecasting across large numbers of geographically dispersed stations. Existing approaches are commonly developed for individual sites or specific forecasting horizons, requiring repeated training and maintenance as new stations are integrated and limiting direct reuse at previously unseen sites. To address this scalability gap, this paper presents a domain-specific foundation-style pretraining framework that learns a shared forecasting model from heterogeneous multi-site and multi-horizon PV data. NWP-assisted forecasting is formulated as a sequence-completion problem that unifies historical PV power, meteorological observations, future numerical weather prediction (NWP) forecasts, and time encodings. Three pretraining objectives are designed and systematically evaluated, including forecast-aligned reconstruction, generic reconstruction, and mixed reconstruction. Long-horizon agentic reinforcement learning (RL) requires both efficient rollout generation and training on long sequences. item.title: Extreme Low-State Quantized Transformer for Electricity-Load Forecasting
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-20　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 激进的低状态权重量化大幅压缩神经网络表示灵活性，仅剩少数离散权重状态时预测性能难以保持。

方法 对电力负荷预测 Transformer 采用 3/5/7/16 状态权重量化（仅 FFN 与 attention+FFN 两种范围），任务为用前 48 小时预测下 1/24 小时；提出 accumulated-update thresholding，累积优化器提出的权重更新后再提交。

关键数字 直接 PTQ 使平均 NRMSE 相对全精度升 6.25/7.04 个百分点，QAT-FT 恢复约 90.2%/94.5% 的惩罚；累积阈值化相对配对控制减少约 99.7% shadow-weight 更新与 77%-80% 状态转移，平均 NRMSE 仅 +0.042/+0.197 个百分点。

为什么值得看 面向多电平存算器件与低活跃边缘预测的量化路线，QAT 恢复与更新抑制策略有实际启发。

item.title: Evaluating Runtime Prediction and Conservative Walltime Policies in HPC Systems
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-20　分类：论文PDF

Efficient use of large-scale supercomputing systems depends on accurate runtime estimation and walltime selection.

Efficient use of large-scale supercomputing systems depends on accurate runtime estimation and walltime selection. To avoid premature termination, users often overestimate walltime, leading to poor resource utilization and reduced scheduling efficiency. This paper presents a predictor-agnostic framework for safe walltime recommendation in production HPC environments. Rather than proposing a new runtime prediction model, the primary contribution is the SAFE decision layer, which converts predicted runtimes into conservative bounded walltime recommendations suitable for deployment. Runtime prediction is therefore treated as a modular component within the proposed framework. We evaluate the approach using large-scale production job histories from the Fugaku and NREL Eagle supercomputers, comprising approximately 24M and 11M jobs, respectively. Runtime prediction performance is first evaluated using representative predictors, including linear regression, neural networks, and a neural ensemble. item.title: Engineering Low-Latency, High-Throughput Quantum Decoders on NVIDIA GPUs
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-20　分类：论文PDF

We design and optimize a quantum error correction (QEC) decoder for NVIDIA GPUs, combining Relay belief propagation, a state-of-the-art message-passing algorithm, with order-zero ordered statistics post-processing.

We design and optimize a quantum error correction (QEC) decoder for NVIDIA GPUs, combining Relay belief propagation, a state-of-the-art message-passing algorithm, with order-zero ordered statistics post-processing. Our implementation uses CUDA Graphs to control GPU execution, stops updates for converged samples, and collects unresolved samples in queues for post-processing. We optimize sparse traversal through coalesced message accesses, prefetching, and register reuse, and accelerate binary post-processing with warp-level collectives. In addition, mixed FP16-FP32 arithmetic and INT8 quantization reduce message storage and traffic while retaining accuracy using accumulators at higher precision. We evaluate surface, hypergraph product, and bivariate bicycle code workloads on NVIDIA A100 and GH200 data-center GPUs and a commodity RTX 5080. On the bivariate bicycle code at error probability 0.003, INT8 halves amortized decoding time relative to independently tuned FP32 with a negligible logical error rate increase on RTX 5080. With independent syndrome batches submitted back-to-back to concurrent decoder instances, RTX 5080 delivers 91% of GH200's highest measured throughput with an 8…

item.title: Efficient Edge-aware Attention Network for Graph Generation
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-20　分类：论文PDF

Graph generative models commonly use graph-specific Transformer architectures to jointly update node and edge features.

Graph generative models commonly use graph-specific Transformer architectures to jointly update node and edge features. However, these architectures do not directly benefit from recent hardware-aware attention implementations, limiting their scalability. The adaptation is, however, non-trivial: edge and graph-level features must be injected into pairwise attention scores, graph masks must be respected, and dynamic edge updates remain a major source of quadratic memory usage. We propose an edge-aware attention layer for graph generation that incorporates structural information through head-wise score modulation, while updating edge representations with a lightweight residual mechanism that retains attention-score dependent edge updates. This layer can be effectively implemented using PyTorch's FlexAttention. We achieve similar generation quality to our baseline while reducing peak GPU memory by around 65% and substantially improving training and sampling throughput. These results suggest that the proposed architecture is a practical step toward scalable graph foundation models.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Don't Skip the Baseline: A Controlled Comparison of Dynamic Expert Skipping in MoEs
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-20　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 动态专家跳过方法声称保持质量的同时进一步减少激活参数，但校准机制、缩减幅度与评测套件各异让对比失真——它们真能胜过简单的静态 k 缩减吗？

方法 把四种代表性动态跳过方法归入统一分类，与"所有层所有 token 缩到相同 k"的静态基线做匹配专家计算预算的受控对比；覆盖 Gemma4-26B-A4B、Qwen3-30B-A3B 文本与 Qwen3-VL 多模态。

关键数字 简单静态基线难以被动态方法稳定超越，方法常落后基线、即便有增益也很小；校准得到的 effective k 与测试期有效 k 会偏离，导致推理算力被高估或低估；据此推荐免校准、按模态静态 k 缩减并在留出模型/模态上验证。

为什么值得看 纠正"动态跳过"文献的对比幻觉，明确静态控制是任何动态方法必须击败的基准。

item.title: DiffRMST: A GPU-Accelerated Fully Differentiable Rectilinear Minimum Spanning Tree Wirelength Model for Global Placement
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-20　分类：论文PDF

Analytical global placement requires a differentiable wirelength objective that accurately reflects routed interconnect cost.

Analytical global placement requires a differentiable wirelength objective that accurately reflects routed interconnect cost. The widely used half-perimeter wirelength (HPWL) is efficient but overlooks the internal topology of multi-pin nets. The rectilinear Steiner minimum tree (RSMT) provides higher fidelity, but its underlying decision problem is NP-complete, and its discrete construction precludes direct use in gradient-based optimization. The rectilinear minimum spanning tree (RMST) offers a polynomial-time alternative, but remains nondifferentiable because of minimization over discrete spanning trees. To address these limitations, we present DiffRMST, a fully differentiable RMST wirelength model for analytical global placement. DiffRMST combines spatial smoothing with a log-sum-exp relaxation to define a continuous distribution over spanning trees. Based on the Kirchhoff matrix-tree theorem, the partition function and edge marginals can be computed without explicit tree enumeration, enabling a closed-form topology-aware gradient for placement optimization. item.title: Detection of Memorization in Diffusion Models Through Thermodynamic Singularity
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-20　分类：论文PDF

In diffusion models, proper distributional learning entails reversing a diffusion process over underlying density functions, whereas a key failure is memorization, in which the reverse process instead learns diffusion from individual training samples.

In diffusion models, proper distributional learning entails reversing a diffusion process over underlying density functions, whereas a key failure is memorization, in which the reverse process instead learns diffusion from individual training samples. We provide an analytical characterization of such memorized reverse processes, along with a criterion that detects the associated thermodynamic singularity. The proposed criterion reliably distinguishes between properly learned and memorizing networks across a range of neural network models designed to promote or mitigate memorization.

item.title: Data-Driven Prediction of Optimal MPI Rank Placement and Node Count for Memory-Bound CFD on AMD EPYC Clusters
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-20　分类：论文PDF

Users who run a memory-bound OpenFOAM case on an AMD EPYC cluster must decide how many nodes to use and how many MPI ranks to place on each core complex.

Users who run a memory-bound OpenFOAM case on an AMD EPYC cluster must decide how many nodes to use and how many MPI ranks to place on each core complex. The fastest choice is often not the cheapest one. This paper revisits our earlier analytical model of this performance and energy trade-off with 560 measured configurations of the motorBike case on five Zen 4 and Zen 5 EPYC processors, including socket power from processor telemetry. On up to four nodes, small meshes are both fastest and cheapest on a single node on most processors. For the largest mesh the largest node count is both the fastest and the cheapest option, because its speedup is superlinear. A genuine trade-off arises only for medium meshes, where full speed costs a median of 20 to 97% more node hours than the cheapest option. The L3 miss rate and the halo traffic per cell are consistent with this pattern. For a new mesh of the same case, the configuration that was optimal on the nearest measured mesh is near optimal in 75 to 85% of the decisions. Running the two configurations it recommends for speed and for cost raises this share to 85 to 90% for runtime and node hours and determines the trade-off with median error…

item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-20　分类：论文PDF

Vehicular Edge Computing (VEC) reduces latency for computation-intensive vehicular applications by offloading tasks to roadside edge servers.

Vehicular Edge Computing (VEC) reduces latency for computation-intensive vehicular applications by offloading tasks to roadside edge servers. Real vehicular workloads, however, consist of dependent subtasks with stringent reliability needs, while the cross-region collaborative learning used to adapt offloading policies must stay robust to heterogeneous data and secure over open wireless channels. We propose CRAFT, a Constrained Reinforcement-based Adaptive Federated Task Offloading framework that casts Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG)-structured offloading and resource allocation as a Constrained Markov Decision Process. CRAFT couples centralized-critic policy learning with Lagrangian relaxation to explicitly regulate the long-term task-completion constraint, and uses two-tier federated aggregation with proximal regularization to jointly mitigate non-Independent and Identically Distributed (non-IID) drift and stabilize constraint adaptation. Confidentiality and integrity for federated parameter exchange are provided by post-quantum homomorphic encryption and lattice-based signatures with modest amortized overhead. Vehicular Edge Computing (VEC) reduces latency for computation-intensive vehicular applications by offloading tasks to roadside edge servers.

Vehicular Edge Computing (VEC) reduces latency for computation-intensive vehicular applications by offloading tasks to roadside edge servers. Real vehicular workloads, however, consist of dependent subtasks with stringent reliability needs, while the cross-region collaborative learning used to adapt offloading policies must stay robust to heterogeneous data and secure over open wireless channels. We propose CRAFT, a Constrained Reinforcement-based Adaptive Federated Task Offloading framework that casts Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG)-structured offloading and resource allocation as a Constrained Markov Decision Process. CRAFT couples centralized-critic policy learning with Lagrangian relaxation to explicitly regulate the long-term task-completion constraint, and uses two-tier federated aggregation with proximal regularization to jointly mitigate non-Independent and Identically Distributed (non-IID) drift and stabilize constraint adaptation. Confidentiality and integrity for federated parameter exchange are provided by post-quantum homomorphic encryption and lattice-based signatures with modest amortized overhead. On a Virtual Machine-based testbed over a realistic Melbourne Central Bu…

item.title: Combating Catastrophic Forgetting in Continual Domain Adaptation via Knowledge Recasting
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-20　分类：论文PDF

Adapting language models to new domains during post-training risks degrading previously acquired capabilities, a phenomenon commonly known as catastrophic forgetting.

Adapting language models to new domains during post-training risks degrading previously acquired capabilities, a phenomenon commonly known as catastrophic forgetting. Existing mitigation methods largely treat forgetting as a consequence of excessive model drift. They therefore constrain updates by preserving old outputs, replaying old data, or regularizing changes to parameters and representations so that the updated model remains close to its previous state. We take a different view: Rather than pulling the updated model back toward its old state, we translate the new domain into the model's pre-existing knowledge space, making unfamiliar knowledge learnable through familiar procedures. Therefore, we propose Skill Schema Transport (SST), a post-training framework that transports new knowledge into the model's existing skill space. SST abstracts each example type into a skill schema, preserving its essential operations, dependencies, and verification steps while removing domain-specific surface forms. By recasting new examples as instances of reusable procedures, SST turns knowledge update from trajectory memorization into procedural reuse. In continual domain adaptation settings, …

item.title: Coincidence-Maximizing Customer Clustering Using Smart Meter Data
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-20　分类：论文PDF

Electricity distribution planning depends on peak-demand coincidence within customer groups, yet similarity-based clustering of smart-meter data does not optimize it directly.

Electricity distribution planning depends on peak-demand coincidence within customer groups, yet similarity-based clustering of smart-meter data does not optimize it directly. We formulate customer grouping to maximize the average of group coincidence factors, weighted by each group's daily share of summed individual peak demand. We prove that jointly optimizing memberships and group peak times is strongly NP-hard even for two groups. We therefore develop a fixed-peak refinement procedure applicable to any feasible partition. It alternates between identifying group peak times and exactly reassigning customers under minimum group-size constraints. Each polynomial-time reassignment maximizes a lower bound tight at the current partition, so accepted updates strictly improve weighted coincidence. We initialize refinement by clustering individual peak-time distributions and evaluate the method on four public smart-meter panels (27,654 customers) using chronological holdouts and 200 paired replicates with complete refitting. Refinement consistently improves weighted coincidence during fitting and reduces sensitivity to initialization. On held-out days, the method outperforms random group…

item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-20　分类：论文PDF

Machine learning-based fault detectors are often evaluated at the relay locations used for training, although local voltage and current measurements vary across power networks.

Machine learning-based fault detectors are often evaluated at the relay locations used for training, although local voltage and current measurements vary across power networks. This work investigates cross-relay generalization for binary detection of faults anywhere in the network using local measurements, rather than line-selective tripping. Using 50 ms windows from a simulated 110 kV transmission network, we evaluate a multilayer perceptron across all 64 source target combinations of eight relays and five random seeds. A shared simulation-level split and source-only threshold selection provide a controlled held-out evaluation without target-specific calibration. Despite nearly unchanged mean F1-scores (0.730 within-relay versus 0.734 cross-relay), the mean false-positive rate (FPR) increases from 0.088 to 0.341, while the mean false-negative rate decreases from 0.399 to 0.318. The change is strongly directional: models trained at Bus 2 relays yield a mean FPR of 0.670 at Bus 1 and Bus 3 relays, compared with 0.096 for cross-relay transfers within the same bus group. item.title: Can Native Safety Travel? Reusing Safety Pretraining Across Models via On-Policy Distillation
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-20　分类：论文PDF

Safety pretraining has emerged as a promising paradigm for embedding safety deeply into a model during pretraining, yielding robustness to subsequent fine-tuning that conventional safety post-training often lacks.

Safety pretraining has emerged as a promising paradigm for embedding safety deeply into a model during pretraining, yielding robustness to subsequent fine-tuning that conventional safety post-training often lacks. We refer to this safety acquired during model pretraining as native safety. Yet native safety is expensive to acquire, confined to the model in which it was pretrained, and often accompanied by lower general utility. In this work, we rethink the practical value of safety-pretrained models and introduce, for the first time, the native safety reuse problem: Can native safety be transferred from a specialized, potentially smaller, safety-pretrained "teacher" to standard-pretrained "students," enabling them to inherit its robustness while preserving their general utility? We show that native safety can "travel" through on-policy distillation. A standard-pretrained student generates responses to safety-pretraining prompts, while a small safety-pretrained teacher supervises the student's token-level predictions along its own generated trajectories; cross-tokenizer alignment further enables transfer across model families. The resulting students exhibit substantially greater safe…

item.title: Building a Nested LADDER for LLM Unstructured Post-Training Pruning
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-20　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 非均匀分配能改善 LLM 后训练剪枝，但高稀疏度下模型质量仍可能急剧退化，如何随稀疏度上升控制退化？

方法 LADDER（基于损坏驱动的逐层分配与细化）：增量分配稀疏度——每步评估从每个候选层额外剪掉一部分权重的端到端退化，提交"每删除一个参数退化最小"的层更新；产出非均匀稀疏配置与跨预算精确嵌套的掩码，以 SparseGPT 为候选生成后端。

关键数字 在 5 个 OPT/Llama/Qwen 模型、10%-90% 稀疏度上评估：良性稀疏度下与均匀/自适应基线相当或略弱，70% 以上显著更鲁棒；优势在 4/5 模型蒸馏后仍保留，并转化为聚合零样本准确率提升。

为什么值得看 高稀疏度正是端侧部署的关键区间，"损坏驱动+逐层分配"思路简洁实用且与 SparseGPT 兼容。

item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-20　分类：论文PDF

A cluster admission gate can receive a capacity record that no longer matches current schedulability.

A cluster admission gate can receive a capacity record that no longer matches current schedulability. We study one exogenous binary schedulability unit under a bound on the joint probability of admission and unavailability. For a symmetric Markov state, we derive the stationary admission frontier for a fixed observation delay and apply finite likelihood allocation to a delay-tagged delivered record. A one-sided exact binomial endpoint calibrates each fitted policy, and exact enumeration confirms the per-policy confidence target in every tested parameter cell. A separate deterministic guard charges every unresolved admission against the realized allowance and bounds unavailable-state admissions at every prefix under truthful outcome feedback. An executable admission procedure composes the allocation and guard. The controlled system binds source sampling, NATS delivery, randomized admission, Kubernetes objects, and API-derived outcomes in one append-only record. Independent audit finds no missing event, identity mismatch, or state mismatch in the completed functional block. item.title: Binary Discrete Diffusion: Candidate-Set Diffusion for Logic and Planning Tasks
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-20　分类：论文PDF

Discrete diffusion models iteratively denoise a noisy sequence of categorical data such as text, enabling any-order generation with self-correction and in-filling capabilities.

Discrete diffusion models iteratively denoise a noisy sequence of categorical data such as text, enabling any-order generation with self-correction and in-filling capabilities. This makes them promising candidates for reasoning, planning, and constrained-generation tasks like coding and math. Yet masked and uniform diffusion erase a token's identity in a single corruption event, so their noisy states cannot explicitly represent partially resolved uncertainty in which several alternatives remain plausible. We close this gap with Binary Discrete Diffusion, a family of continuous-time discrete-diffusion processes whose noisy state is a set of candidate tokens per position, represented as a binary membership vector. Binary diffusion changes candidate sets through additions and removals, allowing information to be lost and recovered gradually while the diffusion state itself represents partial uncertainty. On Sudoku-Extreme, Boxoban, and graph coloring, the symmetric formulation of binary diffusion consistently outperforms strong, well-tuned masked and uniform baselines under matched architectures and controlled training, sampling, and tuning budgets, with its largest gains on the harde…

item.title: Big Claims, Small Margins: Do Reported GraphLLM Gains Survive Simple Baselines?
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-20　分类：论文PDF

LLM-based methods for node classification on text-attributed graphs (TAGs) routinely report state-of-the-art accuracy.

LLM-based methods for node classification on text-attributed graphs (TAGs) routinely report state-of-the-art accuracy. We ask how these results compare with inexpensive baselines run on the same splits. On the splits of three recent studies, we tune four baseline representatives with validation-only selection and compare them with the highest mean that each paper reports for an LLM-based method in the matched setting. Correct & Smooth on TF-IDF features trails this reference by a median of 2.3 percentage points, and an MLP on frozen e5-large-v2 embeddings by 2.8 points. Correct & Smooth is within 3 points of the reference or better on 15 of 24 tasks, but the reference is significantly higher on 12 of 22 testable tasks, so several reported gains remain substantial. Reading released code next to the papers, we also document evaluation risks: selection of hyperparameters or checkpoints on the test set, labels of test-pool nodes used in training, baseline numbers reused without disclosure, and a text-label misalignment in a released Cora loader. Reports of the same method on the same split also differ by up to 12.5 points across papers whose configurations are not documented to match.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Beyond the Point Mass: Acceptance-Derived Weights and Distributional Losses for Speculative Decoding
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-20　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 推测解码里 draft 模型训练（如 D-PACE）用点质量 CE 损失、只取 draft 对已记录目标 token 的概率——但拒绝采样下 draft token 被接受的概率实为 draft 与目标分布的重叠（1−总变差距离），能否据此导出更准的训练信号？

方法 从期望接受长度的精确式推导 D-PAL：以分布重叠作为接受信号，得到重叠度位置权重 + 每位置 log 接受（LA）损失，点质量目标下退化为 D-PACE；权重 detached 后任意每位置损失可替换 LA；证明 Rényi-1/2 从上下两侧夹住真实接受率。

关键数字 Qwen3-4B 目标下六个基准平均接受长度 D-PACE 4.50→D-PAL 4.57（T=0）、4.20→4.28（T=1），两个温度下吞吐均更高；Rényi-1/2 替换 CE 在 D-PACE 与 D-PAL 两种权重下都提升接受长度。

为什么值得看 从分布重叠而非点质量推导 draft 训练目标，理论推导与实测一致的推测解码加速新配方。

item.title: Benchmarking CPU, GPU, and ML Power-Flow Solvers from 14 to 70,000 Buses
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-20　分类：论文PDF

Learned surrogates for power-flow (PF) computation are usually motivated by speed, compared against a single CPU-based baseline.

Learned surrogates for power-flow (PF) computation are usually motivated by speed, compared against a single CPU-based baseline. We show this comparison is fragile: across 7 open-source CPU-based solvers evaluated on identical inputs, throughput varies by roughly 2.5-3 orders of magnitude, so the choice of baseline alone can flip the conclusion. We build a benchmark spanning 9 physics-based solvers: 7 CPU-based and 2 GPU-based, including a new batched GPU solver, gumsim2grid - and 3 published ML surrogates, evaluated under a shared, independently implemented KCL-mismatch check across 15 grids from 14 to 70,000 buses. On the PF task itself, a sufficiently parallelized CPU solver or gpusim2grid matches or exceeds the throughput of the ML surrogates we test while remaining orders of magnitude more accurate; we find no evidence that these GNN-style surrogates are yet competitive for PF specifically, though prior work reports genuine gains on related but more combinatorial tasks such as optimal power flow or power grid control. Beyond this finding, we hope the benchmark suite, code and reference evaluator released at https://github.com/Grid2op/gpusim2grid helps close a broader reproduci…

Modern large-scale cloud systems continuously generate massive and multimodal observability data, such as time-series metrics, log records, and system dependency graphs, which reflect the health state of the system. To ensure reliable cloud system operation, anomaly detection models identify abnormal states by analyzing these multimodal observations. However, existing approaches rely on simple fusion strategies and graph learning, ignoring the semantic gap among modalities and the asynchronous spatio-temporal dependencies across system instances over time. To this end, we propose BEACON, a framework to Bridge multimodal sEmantics and Asynchronous propagation for Cloud system anOmaly detectioN. Specifically, we introduce a Dynamic Interpretable Multimodal Aggregator (DIMA) that leverages an information-bottleneck mechanism to compress information from the semantics and temporal dynamics of metrics, and aligns them with logs in a shared prototype space. Furthermore, we propose an Asynchronous Spatio-Temporal Propagator (ASTP) that captures temporal dependencies with multi-scale temporal attention and models spatial relations with topology-aware aggregation. item.title: BCT: Bayes-Consistent Tempering for Flow Language Models
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-20　分类：论文PDF

Temperature scaling is typically applied as a post-hoc transformation of model probabilities.

Temperature scaling is typically applied as a post-hoc transformation of model probabilities. In posterior-induced flow language models, this creates two mismatches. First, posterior tempering implicitly changes both the endpoint distribution and the distribution of intermediate noisy states, while the denoiser remains trained on the original states. Second, the tempered posterior weights are combined with transport dynamics derived for the untempered flow. These mismatches are reflected empirically: lowering temperature improves GSM8K performance much less reliably in flow LMs than in discrete diffusion LMs. We introduce Bayes-Consistent Tempering (BCT), which makes temperature explicit in both the distributions and dynamics of the generative flow. Its learned realization trains the denoiser on tempered intermediate states and tempers the endpoint distribution using the corresponding tempered dynamics. We also derive training-free variants for conventionally trained checkpoints. Across hyperspherical flow LMs with two denoiser architectures and a von Mises--Fisher flow LM, BCT improves GSM8K generation across broad temperature ranges and achieves the strongest tempering performanc…

item.title: Auditing Conformal Prediction for Language Models Under Inference-Time Model Shift
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-20　分类：论文PDF

Conformal prediction (CP) for language models is typically evaluated under a matched protocol, in which calibration and deployment use the same post-training inference configuration, such as quantization mode and inference temperature.

Conformal prediction (CP) for language models is typically evaluated under a matched protocol, in which calibration and deployment use the same post-training inference configuration, such as quantization mode and inference temperature. In deployment, these choices often differ from those used at calibration to meet memory or throughput constraints or serving policies. We argue that this exposes a limitation in current CP evaluation protocols for language models. We formalize the underlying phenomenon as inference-time model shift: a change in the conformal score distribution induced by inference configuration rather than by the input--label distribution, and theoretically characterize how it breaks split-conformal exchangeability even when the task distribution and trained model are unchanged. We then evaluate its consequences across 8 language models, 4 finite-label benchmarks, and 12 inference configurations. We find that matched evaluation can substantially overstate deployment-time coverage, and that the effect is heterogeneous across models and datasets. We argue that inference configuration should be reported as a first-class experimental axis in CP evaluations for language-m…

item.title: Attention-based Classification for Indirect Prompt Injection
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-20　分类：论文PDF

Indirect prompt injection (IPI) attacks, in which adversarial instructions are embedded in external data processed by a language model, pose a significant threat to the integrity of deployed LLM agents.

Indirect prompt injection (IPI) attacks, in which adversarial instructions are embedded in external data processed by a language model, pose a significant threat to the integrity of deployed LLM agents. Attention Tracker (Hung et al., 2025) is a recently proposed white-box detection method that identifies prompt injection attacks by monitoring how a model's attention is distributed between user task tokens and data tokens, claiming dataset-agnostic detection via a scalar focus score threshold. In this paper, we provide the first evaluation of Attention Tracker in a realistic agentic IPI setting using the AgentDojo benchmark, finding that the dataset agnosticism claim does not hold. We find that in agentic environments, long structured tool outputs subvert the fundamental assumptions Attention Tracker makes about attention that the method depends on and produces near-chance detection on AgentDojo across most model families. We propose AttnDA, an extension replacing the scalar threshold with a Fisher Linear Discriminant Analysis classifier over the per-head focus score vector, and evaluate both methods in a cross-dataset setting spanning four benchmarks. item.title: AnchorRM: Parallel Intra-Batch State Reconstruction with Anchor-Based Residual Memory for Temporal Graph Neural Networks
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-20　分类：论文PDF

Memory-based temporal graph neural networks (TGN) rely on recurrent node memories to capture evolving interaction histories.

Memory-based temporal graph neural networks (TGN) rely on recurrent node memories to capture evolving interaction histories. However, temporal mini-batching introduces a trade-off between computational efficiency and temporal fidelity: when a node appears multiple times within the same batch, later interactions are evaluated using stale pre-batch memory because the intermediate memory updates have not yet been committed. This problem becomes more severe as temporal batch size increases. To overcome this challenge, we propose AnchorRM, an anchor-based residual memory mechanism that reconstructs event-specific intra-batch node states without executing sequential recurrent updates. AnchorRM treats the last committed node memory at the beginning of each batch as a pre-batch fixed anchor and uses causally preceding same-batch interactions to infer the missing state evolution relative to that anchor. The learned residual then calibrates the anchor to reconstruct an event-specific node memory for each interaction. Because each event-specific residual is predicted directly from the fixed anchor and its causal history, reconstructed states do not depend on previously reconstructed states an…

item.title: Adaptive Pullback: Reweighting Supervision at Penalty Jumps in On-Policy Distillation
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-20　分类：论文PDF

On-policy distillation (OPD) supervises student-generated responses using sampled-token student-teacher log-ratios.

On-policy distillation (OPD) supervises student-generated responses using sampled-token student-teacher log-ratios. A positive log-ratio penalizes a token that the student assigns higher probability to than the teacher, but its current value does not distinguish sustained high penalties from abrupt increases along a response. We examine these local changes by comparing consecutive blocks of tokens within the same response. Our diagnostic identifies penalty jumps, abrupt increases in average penalty that persist on held-out tokens. Across these jumps, penalties rise while teacher confidence decreases. We call this pattern penalty-confidence tension. Boundaries into high-penalty blocks do not exhibit comparable confidence changes, showing that local changes provide information beyond the current penalty value. Motivated by this observation, we propose Adaptive Pullback OPD (AP-OPD). At each detected jump, AP-OPD uses the preceding block as a local reference and uniformly scales all supervision coefficients in the following block so that its weighted average penalty matches the preceding block's original mean. This reference determines the scaling factor without an additional strength…
